description:
**This position is on site daily in Nampa, ID. No remote work availability.**

**Company:** At Cobalt Truck Equipment, we specialize in constructing custom, fully equipped trucks tailored to the unique needs of its clientele. Whether serving the construction, utility, or heavy equipment sectors, Cobalt has earned the trust of industry professionals who rely on their mechanics trucks, lube trucks, utility bodies, platforms, and more.

**Summary:** The Business Systems & Data Analyst works cross-functionally to improve how Cobalt Truck Equipment uses business processes, systems, and data. This role partners with department leaders and employees to understand current workflows, identify process and data defects, improve existing solutions, and help evaluate or implement replacement solutions when current processes or systems no longer meet the needs of the business. A major focus of the position is making operational data more accessible, reliable, and useful to management through business intelligence and performance analytics. The analyst will work across the company’s SQL-backed ERP, Salesforce, SharePoint, and other business applications, with Power BI serving as a primary reporting and analytics platform. This is not simply a reporting position; the analyst is expected to understand the business behind the data and help turn findings into practical improvements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with leaders across Sales, Operations, Accounting, Purchasing, and other functions to understand business processes, information needs, pain points, and opportunities for improvement.
* Document current-state workflows, business rules, data sources, handoffs, dependencies, and recurring process defects to make complex processes easier to understand and improve.
* Perform root-cause analysis to distinguish process problems from system limitations, data-quality issues, training or adoption gaps, and unclear ownership.
* Recommend practical improvements to existing processes and systems, and assist in evaluating replacement solutions when existing approaches no longer meet business needs.
* Translate business needs into clear requirements for system changes, reporting, automation, integrations, and process improvements; coordinate testing and validation with users, IT, vendors, and developers.
* Support continuous improvement of business systems including the company’s ERP, Salesforce, SharePoint, TEQuote, and related applications.
* Develop and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards using approved data sources including SQL, Salesforce, SharePoint, and other business systems.
* Work with management to define useful operational KPIs, consistent business definitions, and reporting that helps leaders understand performance, identify exceptions and bottlenecks, and determine where action is needed.
* Validate data accuracy, investigate discrepancies between systems or reports, and help improve data accessibility and reliability across the organization.
* Reduce dependence on manually assembled spreadsheets and disconnected reporting by establishing repeatable, supportable reporting and analysis where practical.
* Maintain structured improvement and defect backlogs, track completed changes, and measure results to determine whether improvements addressed the original business problem.
* Provide management with objective process and performance information that supports coaching, operational improvement, and organizational change while keeping performance-management decisions with department leadership.
* Help establish the data and process foundation required for future operational initiatives, including improved inventory planning and just-in-time inventory strategies.
* Analyze how information related to sales demand, quoting, inventory, purchasing, work orders, production, and other operational processes moves through the organization and identify gaps that limit timely, reliable decision-making.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Information Systems, Management Information Systems, Data Analytics, Business Administration, or a related field; an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
* Two (2) or more years of relevant experience in business analysis, data analysis, business intelligence, business systems, process improvement, or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated ability to gather requirements, analyze business processes, identify root causes, and translate business questions into actionable analysis or system improvements.
* Experience developing reports, dashboards, data models, or business intelligence solutions used to support operational decision-making.
* Working knowledge of relational data and SQL, including the ability to query, join, aggregate, and interpret data from business systems.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical employees across departments.
* Ability to organize ambiguous problems, manage multiple improvement efforts, document findings clearly, and follow changes through testing and validation.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Microsoft Power BI, including Power Query, data modeling, DAX, and dashboard development.
* Experience working with Microsoft SQL Server or other relational database platforms.
* Experience with Salesforce reporting, data structures, objects, relationships, or business workflows.
* Experience with Microsoft SharePoint, Microsoft Lists, Excel, Power Automate, or Power Apps.
* Experience supporting ERP, CRM, workflow automation, integration, or other business-critical platforms.
* Experience in manufacturing, distribution, supply chain, inventory, purchasing, production, quoting, or order-management environments.
* Ability to communicate complex findings in clear business terms and work with leaders to define measures that support continuous improvement.

This position works in an office setting. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers and phones.

description:
**Job Description Summary**

Raymond James is seeking an experienced Lead Data Analyst to join our Enterprise Data Analytics team. This role is responsible for delivering complex data analysis, reporting, and analytical solutions that support critical business, operational, risk, compliance, and regulatory initiatives across the firm.
  
In this highly collaborative role, you will partner with business stakeholders, technology teams, and enterprise data teams to translate complex business requirements into accurate, scalable, and actionable data solutions.
  
The ideal candidate will bring advanced SQL expertise, strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and experience working with large enterprise datasets across multiple systems. You will lead complex analytical initiatives, provide technical guidance to other analysts, and contribute to data modernization efforts, process automation, and the adoption of emerging AI technologies.

**Job Description**

**Responsibilities:**

  

**Enterprise Data Analysis & Reporting**

* Lead complex data analysis and reporting initiatives supporting business, operational, risk, compliance, and regulatory needs.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, define scope, and translate business needs into technical data solutions.
* Perform data extraction, transformation, reconciliation, and validation across multiple enterprise data sources.
* Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, investigate discrepancies, and deliver actionable insights.
Independently manage multiple high-priority analytical requests while ensuring timely and accurate delivery.  

  

**Advanced SQL & Data Solutions**

* Develop, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries for data extraction, analysis, reconciliation, and reporting.
* Work with enterprise databases, data warehouses, cloud platforms, and legacy systems.
* Apply advanced SQL techniques, including joins, CTEs, window functions, aggregations, and performance tuning.
* Collaborate with enterprise data teams to understand data structures, business rules, data lineage, and source-to-target mappings.
Support enterprise data modernization, cloud adoption, and data integration initiatives.  

  

**Data Quality & Validation**

* Develop and execute data validation and reconciliation processes to ensure data accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
* Investigate data anomalies, perform root cause analysis, and recommend corrective actions.
* Establish reusable analytical methodologies, validation frameworks, and reporting standards.
Ensure appropriate handling of confidential and sensitive data in accordance with enterprise security and governance requirements.  

  

**Technical Leadership & Continuous Improvement**

* Serve as a technical subject matter expert in SQL development, data analysis, and troubleshooting.
* Provide technical guidance, review analytical solutions, and mentor other analysts.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to resolve complex data challenges.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through automation, reusable analytical solutions, and process standardization.
Explore and leverage approved AI-powered tools to support data analysis, SQL development, testing, documentation, and automation.

-----------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

* Experience analyzing, reconciling, and validating large datasets across multiple systems.
* Experience with enterprise relational databases, data warehouses, or cloud-based analytics platforms.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and root cause analysis skills.
* Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into analytical solutions.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and technical documentation skills.
Demonstrated ability to lead complex analytical initiatives and provide technical guidance to other analysts.  

  

**Preferred Experience Includes**

* Experience in financial services, wealth management, brokerage, capital markets, risk management, or compliance.
* Knowledge of financial datasets, including customer accounts, securities transactions, positions, holdings, and balances.

description:
Join Aleron Group, a global workforce and business solutions company that builds relationships and empowers the workplace. Since 1957, we've been at the forefront of the workforce industry. Our renowned portfolio of companies, including Acara Solutions, Acara Solutions India, Broadleaf Results, Lume Strategies, TalentRise, and Viaduct, delivers tailored talent solutions, workforce management, IT services, and more to meet the ever-evolving needs of our clients. We transform the workplace for people and businesses around the world.

**What Aleron has to offer**:

* Full benefits package that includes health insurance, health savings account, dental insurance, disability insurance, life insurance, vision insurance, and 401(k)
* PTO, plus 10 paid holidays

\* \*Pay: $23-$25 per hour  

* Flexible work options available

**Job Summary:**

The Junior SAP Master Data Analyst creates, maintains and validates master data in SAP so that procurement, sales and payroll transactions post correctly the first time. Working under the SAP Master Data Specialist and working with the SAP Master Data Analyst, you will process change requests for vendors, customers and materials, run data-quality checks, and support migrations and mass updates across SAP ECC and S/4HANA. This is a hands-on entry role with a clear path to Master Data Analyst. This is a remote role; however, candidates may also be based in the Williamsville/Buffalo, NY area. The position follows standard business hours, with occasional extended hours required during audits, system go-lives, or other critical business needs. Work is primarily computer-based.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

**Master data maintenance**  

* Create, change, block and archive Business Partner records (vendor and customer roles), including bank details, tax data, payment terms and partner functions.
* Maintain material masters across views (basic, purchasing, MRP, sales) and related records such as purchasing info records and source lists.

**Requests and Controls**  

* Process master data requests from the ticketing or workflow queue within agreed service levels.
* Check each request for completeness, duplicates and supporting documentation before entry.
* Follow segregation-of-duties controls, especially for vendor bank detail changes, and verify changes with the requester where required.
* Keep an audit trail of changes and support internal and external audit requests.

**Data Quality**  

* Run regular data-quality reports to find duplicates, incomplete records and inactive vendors or customers.
* Correct errors and escalate root causes to the Master Data Lead.
* Help build and maintain data standards, naming conventions and field-level rules.

**VMS Interface Loads**  

* Load files received from multiple Vendor Management Systems (VMS) into the custom SAP interface monitor on a scheduled basis.
* Validate each load against source totals, and correct or reprocess records that fail on missing or invalid master data.
* Track recurring file errors by VMS source and escalate format or mapping issues to the SAP Master Data Specialist.

**Projects and Mass Changes**  

* Prepare and validate load files for mass updates and migrations (e.g. LSMW, Migration Cockpit, Excel templates).
* Support testing (unit and UAT) for master data changes in system upgrades and S/4HANA rollouts.
* Update process documentation, work instructions and training material.

**Collaboration**  

* Work with procurement, supply chain and HR to resolve master data issues that block postings, invoices or payments.
* Answer user questions on how to request and use master data correctly.

  

**Required Skills / Qualifications:**

**Required:**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Supply Chain, Business Administration or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 0-2 years of experience in data entry, data analysis or an ERP environment.
* Working knowledge of Excel: VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, filters and basic data cleansing.
* Understanding of basic business processes such as procure-to-pay or order-to-cash.
* Strong attention to detail and comfort following controlled, documented procedures.
* Clear written and verbal communication with business users.

**Preferred:**

* Hands-on exposure to SAP ECC or S/4HANA, especially Business Partner (BP) or material master (MM01/MM02) transactions.
* Familiarity with SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) or a ticket-based request workflow (e.g. ServiceNow).
* Strong Excel skills.
* Awareness of SOX or internal-control requirements around vendor and bank data.
* SAP certification or coursework in MM or SD.

**Physical Demands, Work Environment, and Travel:**

* This is a remote role (candidates may also be based in the Williamsville/Buffalo, NY area) working standard business hours, with occasional extended hours during audits or system go-lives. The work is primarily computer-based.

**Additional Information:**

* This job description is subject to change and may be adjusted to meet the company's needs.
* Upon receiving an offer of employment, candidates will be required to undergo a background check and drug screening.
Depending on the role, additional industry-specific skills testing may also be necessary prior to placement.

Candidates who thrive at Reef bring energy, ownership, and a genuine commitment to raising the bar on everything they touch.

**Position Summary:**

Reef is looking for an AI-forward analytics professional who turns business questions into answers people trust. You will work with leaders across real estate, hospitality, investments, and membership to define the metrics that matter, then build the dashboards and analysis yourself in Reef Analytics, our internal analytics application.

At Reef, AI isn't a side project, but instead, it's how we build. You'll drive your work from the first question to the finished dashboard, using AI agents and coding tools like Claude to get there faster than you thought possible. Work that used to take an analyst weeks takes hours here. We're looking for someone who hands work off to AI without hesitation, takes on projects bigger than anything they've tried before, and owns the result.

If you've been building with Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools, great. If you haven't yet but you're eager to work this way, and you bring strong SQL and data visualization instincts, you'll thrive here. **Stakeholder Partnership**

* Partner with stakeholders, including executives, to gather, clarify, and translate business questions into defined metrics and analytical solutions.
* Own the complexity and ambiguity of data requests: ask the right questions, fill in the gaps, and deliver a finished solution rather than handing the problem back.
* Deliver white-glove work: polished and easy to use, with clear communication from request to delivery and follow-through after launch.
* Analyze business processes to identify key metrics, KPIs, and opportunities for data-driven improvements.

**Data Definition, Modeling, and Quality**

* Define data elements, create and maintain data dictionaries, glossaries, and metadata to ensure consistent understanding and usage across the organization.
* Design logical and conceptual data models to support reporting, analytics, and dashboard requirements.

description:
Everforth ECS is seeking a ***Business Analyst***to work in our **Stafford, VA** office.

The ECS Team provides focused agile software development and maintenance for CODIS, a mission-critical application for the FBI. CODIS is a client server application developed using Microsoft .NET that supports a database repository of DNA profiles from individuals, unsolved crime scene evidence, and missing persons. GXG leverages best-in-class human-centered practices and a design-thinking approach to help federal, state, and local government customers better connect with the people they serve.

The Data Analyst, Customer Analytics serves as the subject-matter expert for customer analytics, measurement, and reporting within GXG. This role owns the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of analytics workstreams that enable government customers to understand program performance, optimize digital communications, and achieve measurable outcomes.

Operating as an advanced individual contributor, the analyst independently leads analytics workstream execution, sets analytics best practices, makes specialized technical decisions, and mentors junior analysts in data quality, visualization, and reporting methodology.

**Who We Are:**

* Data-driven thinkers, grounding our insights and recommendations for growth in measurable data and context.
* Human-centered design practitioners, understanding best practices, regardless of technology or use cases, and always putting people at the center of our solutions.
* Digital content creators and strategists, applying best practices to key message development, evaluation of current client content, and identifying optimization opportunities.
* Innovators, leveraging design-thinking and other frameworks to keep our work fresh and help our customers adopt a mindset for change. We drive toward success with a spirit of experimentation and agility.

**How We Show Up to Work:**

* Demonstrate a polished, professional relationship with colleagues and customers.
* Assume positive intent.
* Be collaborative. Create space for and be open to different expertise and experiences.
* Be dependable and reliable for our customers and colleagues.
* Be organized and manage your own workload.
* Be proactive. Be willing to jump in, not wait to be told.
* Be willing to try something new, not dependent on documented examples.
* Be empathetic. Consider the human experience, needs and motivations of our customers and our colleagues.
* Be open to feedback. Listen with the same passion with which you want to be heard.
* Be curious. Gather information and knowledge. Consider new ideas and approaches. Consider what you might not know.

What Your Impact Will Look Like:

**Essential Function:**

* Lead end-to-end ownership of analytics workstreams for assigned GXG customer engagements — from requirements definition through delivery, insight communication, and optimization recommendations — operating independently without routine escalation.
* Independently design, build, and maintain measurement frameworks that define KPIs, success metrics, and performance benchmarks for government customer digital communication programs across email, web, surveys, forms, and other channels.
* Lead the architecture, development, and ongoing optimization of dashboards and reporting solutions integrating data from multiple sources; own data accuracy, reliability, and governance for all workstream-level reporting outputs.
* Define, document, and champion analytics standards, reporting methodologies, and data governance best practices for GXG's Customer Analytics practice; serve as the team's subject-matter expert and internal escalation point for complex analytical challenges.
* Make independent analytical and methodological decisions within the GXG customer analytics domain, including selection of approaches, metrics frameworks, visualization strategies, and tool architectures — without requiring managerial approval for routine technical judgments.
* Author and maintain owned SOPs, analytics playbooks, reporting specifications, and knowledge-base documentation to ensure consistency, repeatability, and institutional knowledge retention across the GXG team.
* Serve as the primary analytics point of contact for assigned customer engagements; lead requirements-gathering sessions, present data-driven findings and strategic recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences, including government stakeholders.
* Mentor and coach junior analysts on SQL, data visualization, measurement strategy, and analytics best practices; conduct structured peer reviews and quality assurance of team deliverables.
* Own investigation, root-cause analysis, and resolution of data quality and consistency issues across GXG reporting systems; establish preventive controls and documentation standards to reduce recurring errors.
* Identify, evaluate, and introduce emerging analytics approaches, AI-enabled tools (Copilot, Cursor, etc.), and productivity technologies into GXG's analytical workflows; lead research and proof-of-concept efforts to advance the practice's analytical capabilities.
* Lead analytics-related Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, retrospectives, and stand-ups; define and track analytics acceptance criteria and delivery milestones.
* Proactively identify opportunities where data can improve customer program outcomes and GXG service delivery; present evidence-based recommendations that influence customer measurement strategy.

You Will Love This Job If You Have:

**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:**

* Advanced SQL proficiency — complex query design, data modeling, performance optimization, and multi-source dataset manipulation.
* Expert-level BI & data visualization — deep expertise in QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI, or Looker; dashboard architecture and design for executive and operational audiences.
* Measurement framework design — ability to define KPIs, success metrics, and analytics strategies for digital communication programs from first principles.
* Data governance & quality ownership — ability to define and enforce data quality standards, validation frameworks, and governance practices at the workstream level.
* ETL & data integration — strong understanding of data pipeline concepts, ETL processes, and data validation in multi-source environments.
* Digital channel analytics expertise — email, web, survey, social, CRM, and forms analytics; cross-channel measurement and attribution modeling.
* AI-assisted analytics — ability to evaluate, adopt, and integrate AI-enabled productivity and analytics tools responsibly and effectively within data governance requirements.
* Communication & influence — ability to lead analytical presentations and influence customer measurement strategy through data storytelling for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Mentoring & coaching — demonstrated ability to develop junior analyst skills through structured guidance, peer review, and actionable feedback.
* Agile methodology — advanced familiarity with Scrum/Kanban; ability to lead analytics ceremonies and manage workstream-level delivery.

**Experience/Credentials**

* 4–6 years of experience in a data analyst, analytics engineer, digital analyst, or reporting analyst role in a professional services, agency, or technology environment.
* Demonstrated ownership of analytics workstreams, measurement frameworks, or reporting infrastructure — with evidence of leading deliverables end-to-end, not merely contributing.
* Advanced SQL skills with demonstrated experience in complex query design and multi-source data environments.
* Expert-level proficiency in at least one major BI platform (QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI, or Looker), with evidence of dashboard architecture for multiple stakeholder audiences.
* Demonstrated experience designing measurement strategies or analytics frameworks from first principles, including KPI definition and performance benchmarking.
* Experience communicating analytical findings and recommendations to senior or executive-level stakeholders, including government clients.
* Experience working across digital channels (email, web, surveys, CRM, social) with cross-channel measurement design.
* Experience mentoring or coaching junior analysts or reporting contributors, with evidence of structured peer review or quality assurance contributions.
* Experience with AI-assisted analytics tools and productivity platforms, with demonstrated responsible use within data governance requirements.
* Experience working within Agile/Scrum delivery frameworks in an analytics or data context.

**Preferred:**

description:

This role will own and lead complex TA analytics projects that inform hiring strategy, workforce planning, and retention decisions. The role is accountable for end-to-end delivery—from defining business questions, project scope, and analytical approaches to integrating and validating data, developing predictive insights and automated solutions, and translating findings into actionable recommendations. Executive reporting, workforce analytics, and dashboards are key deliverables within this broader project ownership. The successful candidate will partner closely with Talent Acquisition leaders, HR Business Partners, Finance, and business stakeholders to align priorities, manage project delivery, and evaluate how analytical solutions improve hiring and retention outcomes.

**Your Impact**

**What You Can Expect to Do Here**

* Produce executive-level reporting and presentations on key hiring and retention metrics, including hiring demand, requisition volume, candidate pipeline activity, time-to-fill, offer acceptance rates, source effectiveness, attrition and workforce planning trends.
* Lead complex analyses of recruiting, workforce, and workforce planning data, selecting analytical approaches, and integrating multiple data sources to identify trends, risks, and opportunities. Translate predictive analytics, trend analysis, forecasting, and workforce intelligence into actionable recommendations for business growth, talent strategies, and hiring and retention decisions.
* Design, develop, and automate data visualizations, graphs, charts, dashboards, and reporting tools using Power BI, Excel, Power Query, Power Automate, and other reporting technologies.
* Create and maintain automated executive reporting packages and PowerPoint presentations that transform complex recruiting and workforce data into clear, actionable business insights.
* Develop automated reporting processes that reduce manual effort, improve data accuracy, and increase the timeliness and consistency of reporting deliverables.
* Generate weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual Talent Acquisition and retention reporting for Talent Acquisition Leadership, HR Leadership, Executive Leadership, and Business Leaders.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition teams to monitor hiring performance against forecasts, identify hiring risks, and provide recommendations to improve hiring outcomes.
* Own the analytics workstream for hiring acceleration initiatives, workforce planning, strategic workforce projects, and acquisition/integration activities. Define scope, deliverables, milestones, and analytical methods with stakeholders; manage dependencies and risks; and deliver predictive analytics, forecasts, workforce intelligence, executive reporting, and business intelligence solutions that inform workforce and hiring decisions.
* Ensure the integrity, accuracy, governance, validation, and reconciliation of Talent Acquisition, recruitment, retention, workforce, HRIS, ATS, and business intelligence data, ensuring executive reporting, dashboards, and workforce metrics remain accurate, consistent, and aligned across multiple systems, platforms, and data sources.

Lead end-to-end delivery of strategic Talent Acquisition analytics and process improvement projects, exercising independent judgment in problem-solving and taking accountability for analytical quality, stakeholder alignment, implementation of analytics solutions, and measurement of results.

* Timely and accurate delivery of executive hiring and retention reporting.
* Increased automation and efficiency of Talent Acquisition reporting processes.
* Improved visibility into hiring performance, workforce trends, and retention risks.
* Delivery of actionable insights that support business hiring goals, retention objectives, and workforce planning decisions.
Development of executive-ready dashboards, presentations, and analytics that enable data-driven decision-making across the organization.  

**Who You Are**

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Data Analytics, Statistics, Information Systems, or a related field.
* A minimum of 5 to 7 years of experience in Talent Acquisition analytics, people analytics, workforce planning, business intelligence, or a related analytical role.
* Advanced proficiency in Power BI, Excel, Power Query, PowerPoint, and data visualization tools.
* Experience developing executive dashboards, KPI scorecards, automated reporting solutions, and business intelligence reporting.
* Demonstrated experience creating executive-level presentations and communicating complex workforce and recruiting data through compelling visual storytelling.
* Strong knowledge of Talent Acquisition metrics, retention metrics, workforce planning concepts, and recruiting operations.
* Experience working with HRIS, ATS, and workforce analytics platforms.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and project management skills.
* Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable recommendations for senior leaders.
Experience with automation.

title: Business Analyst
description:
**Description**
---------------

**Washington Courts Employment Opportunity**

*Administrative Office of the Courts (AOC)*

  

**Business Analyst**

Court Services Division

***Our Mission****: To advance the timely, effective, and equitable operations of the Washington State judicial branch.*

  

**Location:** Olympia, Washington (AOC requires employees to reside in Washington State).

**Salary:** $86,688 - $113,736per year (DOQ). This position is not eligible for overtime.

**Closes:** November 12, 2026. AOC reserves the right to close the recruitment at any time after seven calendar days.

**In-Office Requirement:** This position requires at least two days per week working in-office.

  

**Position Details**

Transforming user needs into powerful court solutions.

  
  

The Administrative Office of the Courts is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Business Analyst to help shape the technology and processes that support our internal applications. In this role, you’ll dive into the heart of how our staff work, uncovering system needs, translating them into clear business requirements, and making meaningful improvements through thoughtful analysis and User Acceptance Testing. You’ll work closely with teammates across the Court Services Division and collaborate with partners throughout AOC, other state agencies, and technology vendors. Together, you’ll influence how systems are designed, enhanced, configured, and tested to serve users statewide.

  
  

This position offers the opportunity to think critically, work independently, and apply your analytical strengths to real-world challenges. While you’ll rely on established procedures for many tasks, you’ll also navigate situations that require creativity, interpretation, and fresh problem-solving. If you enjoy variety, thrive in a collaborative environment, and want your work to support the effective functioning of Washington’s courts, this role gives you the chance to make a meaningful impact every day.

  

**Duties and Responsibilities**

  

Some of the duties you will perform are:

* Plan, schedule and lead the management of requirements for complex solutions.
* Elicit business requirements from internal and external subject matter experts.
* Serve as a liaison between stakeholders and technical personnel to ensure that business needs are clearly defined, understood and translated into technical solutions.
* Translate business requirements into user stories, use cases and acceptance criteria.
* Develop and maintain requirements documentation.
* Develop and maintain requirements traceability matrices for requirement management and re-use.
* Analyze requirements for completeness and testability.
* Review test results to confirm that test acceptance criteria have been met.
* Provide consultation to project stakeholders.
* Conduct intensive, in-depth systems analysis for new or enhancements for small to large and highly complex applications and systems.

**Required Qualifications**

  

* Eight years of information technology experience, which includes three years of direct experience as a business analyst and/or court user subject matter expert performing business analysis functions such as conducting requirements gathering activities with stakeholders, analyzing and evaluating business functions/processes for deficiencies and enhancements, and recommending solutions to address business needs.

**OR**

* Associate degree in computer science, information systems or related technical/business discipline **and** six years of information technology experience including direct experience as a business analyst and/or court user subject matter expert performing business analysis functions such as conducting requirements gathering activities with stakeholders, analyzing and evaluating business functions/processes for deficiencies and enhancements, and recommending solutions to address business needs.

**OR**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems or related technical/business discipline **and** four years of information technology experience including direct experience as a business analyst and/or court user subject matter expert performing business analysis functions such as conducting requirements gathering activities with stakeholders, analyzing and evaluating business functions/processes for deficiencies and enhancements, and recommending solutions to address business needs.

**OR**

* Master's degree in computer science, information systems or related technical/business discipline with one year of direct experience as a business analyst and/or court user subject matter expert performing business analysis functions such as conducting requirements gathering activities with stakeholders, analyzing and evaluating business functions/processes for deficiencies and enhancements, and recommending solutions to address business needs.
  

  

* *Relative IT Experience includes systems and software requirements development and management, software or systems development following the software development lifecycle and project management practices.*

  
  

**Desired Qualifications**

* Skilled in planning, eliciting, managing, and documenting requirements for complex solutions using established methodologies and tools.
* Translating business needs into clear, well-defined user stories or use cases supported by strong analytical and documentation skills.
* Produces accurate, timely work while staying organized, focused, and efficient in a fast-paced environment.
* Communicates effectively with diverse stakeholders and is proficient in Microsoft 365 applications, with strong presentation and written communication abilities.

* Strong facilitation/negotiation skills; ability to interface with and influence people at multiple levels within the org.

* Current Resume;
* Letter of Interest describing how you meet the specific qualifications for the position;
  

  

To view our current open positions and view benefits information, visit our Jobs Page @ Courts Jobs. To submit an application for this position, click here to APPLY!

**Note:** Employees who are members of certain Unions may be entitled to additional personal leave day(s), please refer to position specific Collective Bargaining Agreements for more information*.*
  
  
Full-time employees who work full monthly schedules qualify for holiday compensation if they are employed before the holiday and are in pay status for at least 80 nonovertime hours during the month of the holiday; or for the entire work shift preceding the holiday.
  
  
Part-time employees who are in pay status during the month of the holiday qualify for the holiday on a pro-rata basis. Compensation for holidays (including personal holiday) will be proportionate to the number of hours in pay status in the month to that required for full-time employment, excluding all holiday hours. Pay status includes hours worked and time on paid leave.
  
  
**Sick Leave**
  
Full-time employees earn eight hours of sick leave per month. Overtime eligible employees who are in pay status for less than 80 hours per month, earn a monthly proportionate to the number of hours in pay status, in the month to that required for full-time employment. Overtime exempt employees who are in pay status for less than 80 hours per month do not earn a monthly accrual of sick leave.
  
  
Sick leave accruals for part-time employees will be proportionate to the number of hours in pay status, in the month to that required for full-time employment. Pay status includes hours worked, time on paid leave and paid holiday.
  
  
**Vacation (Annual Leave)**
  
Full-time employees accrue vacation leave at the rates specified in WAC 357-31-165(1) or the applicable collective bargaining agreement (CBA). Full-time employees who are in pay status for less than 80 nonovertime hours in a month do not earn a monthly accrual of vacation leave.
  
  
Part-time employees accrue vacation leave hours in accordance with WAC 357-31-165(1) or the applicable collective bargaining agreement (CBA) on a pro rata basis. Vacation leave accrual will be proportionate to the number of hours in pay status, in the month to that required for full-time employment.
  
  
Pay status includes hours worked, time on paid leave and paid holiday.
  
  
As provided in WAC 357-58-175, an employer may authorize a lump-sum accrual of vacation leave or accelerate the vacation leave accrual rate to support the recruitment and/or retention of a candidate or employee for a Washington Management Service position. Vacation leave accrual rates may only be accelerated using the rates established WAC 357-31-165.
  
  
**Note:** Most agencies follow the civil service rules covering leave and holidays for **exempt** employees even though there is no requirement for them to do so. However, agencies are required to adhere to the applicable RCWs pertaining holidays and leave.
  
  
**Military Leave**
  
Washington State supports members of the armed forces with 21 days paid military leave per year.
  
  
**Bereavement Leave**
  
Most employees whose family member or household member dies, or for loss of pregnancy, are entitled to five (5) days of paid bereavement leave. In addition, the employer may approve other available leave types for the purpose of bereavement leave.

Position Summary
  
The Risk Adjustment Data Analyst supports end to end risk adjustment and revenue cycle operations by analyzing HCC submissions by ArchWell Health and any rejections at Clearninghouse/payer/CMS level, managing chart retrieval and review workflows, and ensuring accurate ingestion of care gap and clinical documentation data for various sources. This role is critical to maintaining RAF accuracy, reducing submission errors, and enabling continuous monthly reconciliation across MA programs. The role requires flexibility to perform additional tasks as needed, especially as risk adjustment and quality requirements evolve across markets and programs.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
HCC Reconciliation & Submission Validation
  

* Perform monthly validation of all HCC submissions (MAO004, encounters, claims, sweeps).
* Analyze payer acceptance, rejections, and 277CA/999 acknowledgement files.
* Identify new, recaptured, and dismissed HCCs and reconcile against internal systems (VIM, HCC engine).
* Present and route any rejections/gaps for appropriate teams.

Sweeps & Payer Data Management
  

* Review sweeps datasets to ensure completeness, accuracy, and payer acceptance.
* Support ASM workflows and monitor acceptance/rejection trends.
* Track payer healthcare gaps and validate alignment with internal care gap logic.

Chart Retrieval & Review Support
  

* Build and maintain chart retrieval/review prioritization rules (1LR, 2LR, external providers).
* Monitor chart retrieval programs, turnaround times, and vendor performance.
* ROI analysis of various programs
* Manage unlinked charts and ensure proper linkage to members, service dates, and HCCs.

Care Gap & Clinical Data Ingestion
  

* Support ingestion/analysis health plan care gap files and ensure accurate mapping into VIM and analyze suspects conversion rate from various sources.
* Validate care gap completeness and partner with clinical teams to ensure data is actionable.
* Develop or refine member stratification logic for outreach and in home visit prioritization.

Reporting & Analytics
  

* Build/Maintain dashboards and reports to track HCC operations work inclusive of reconciliation, chart retrieval progress, and rejection trends.
* Provide insights to leadership on productivity, throughput, and operational bottlenecks at market/center/payer level.
* Support continuous improvement by identifying recurring issues and recommending process enhancements.

Cross Functional Collaboration
  

* Work closely with Operations, RCM, Coding, Clinical Documentation, Vendor partners, and IT/Data teams.
* Participate in governance meetings to review trends, exceptions, and payer specific issues.
* Ensure alignment across teams to reduce sweeps level escalations and maintain steady state workflows.

Qualifications
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Data Analytics, Public Health, or related field.
* 3-5 years of experience in risk adjustment, RCM, healthcare analytics, or payer operations.
* Strong understanding of HCCs models, RAF, MAO004, 277CA/999/835 files, and encounter submission workflows.
* Deep experience with SQL, Excel, and data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau).
* Ability to interpret clinical documentation and coding outputs (ICD 10, HCC mapping).
* Strong analytical, problem solving, and communication skills.
* Experience working with chart retrieval vendors or clinical documentation teams preferred.

Competencies
  

* Detail oriented with strong data validation skills
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams and deadlines
* Strong cross functional collaboration
* Comfort working in fast paced, evolving operational environments
* Commitment to accuracy, compliance, and documentation integrity

**About the Company**

Arcadia Products, a DMC Global company (NASDAQ: BOOM), makes aluminum storefront, curtain wall, windows, doors, and interior partitions at multi-site fabrication plants in and around Vernon, CA. Our work is high-mix and engineer-to-order, running on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O) as the system of record, Soft Tech V6 for quoting and manufacturing, and Microsoft Fabric and Power BI for data and reporting.

**About This Role**

The Junior Process Analyst is an hourly, operations-first role focused on Power BI reporting and data gathering. You will sit with the business teams (estimating, planning, purchasing, production, shipping, and finance) to learn what questions they need answered, find where the data lives, collect and clean it, and turn it into reliable Power BI reports. You will also be the go-between who turns business reporting and data needs into clear requests for IT, and explains IT changes back to the business in plain language.

* **Power BI Reporting:** Build and maintain Power BI reports. Develop reports and dashboards from requirements to release. Write DAX measures, shape data in Power Query, and build clean star-schema semantic models on governed data in Microsoft Fabric and D365 F&O.
* **Data Gathering & Preparation:** Find and pull data from D365 F&O, Soft Tech V6, Excel trackers, and other business sources. Profile, clean, and reconcile it, and document where each field comes from.
* **Reporting Requirements:** Interview report users, learn the business process behind each request, and write short requirement notes covering purpose, audience, data sources, and metric definitions.
* **Business Liaison to IT:** Turn reporting and data requests into clear tickets with business context. Work with Enterprise Systems on data access, Fabric datasets, and new data feeds, and help test changes that affect reports.

The Warranty Analyst contributes by investigating warranty and goodwill claims, analyzing expense and repair trends, and reviewing vehicle buyback cases to identify and document the defective causal parts or conditions associated with repurchase.

Do you enjoy connecting the dots between vehicle repair records, warranty data, and the technical issues behind them? Are you detail-oriented, analytical, and motivated to turn complex information into actionable findings?

At MSX International, we’re looking for a Warranty Analyst to support HMA’s warranty group through data analysis, technical case review, and accurate documentation. You’ll also support vehicle buyback analysis by reviewing repair histories and related records to identify and document the initial and final defective causal parts and/or conditions that led to vehicle repurchase under applicable lemon laws.

This on-site, hourly role offers direct collaboration with warranty, quality, and engineering teams at HMA headquarters, providing exposure to automotive operations and opportunities for professional development.

* Review vehicle buyback repair records, service orders, and customer communications to identify the initial and final defective causal parts and/or conditions associated with repurchase.

title: Graduate Analyst
description:
**Company Description**

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.  
**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.  
**For everyone, everywhere.**

More about **our mission** and **what we offer**.

 **Job Description**

As a Graduate Product Analyst, you’ll join our North America Regional Analytics team in September 2027.  
  
This full-time role is a chance to make a real impact early and kickstart your career. You’ll be onboarded with the global Graduate cohort in one of our offices and learn the basics of being a Wiser.  
  
**The Role:**  
We’re hiring three graduates to work as analysts inside our North America product teams, which build Wise for personal and business customers in the US and Canada. Our analysts don’t sit in a central reporting team: each one works day to day with product managers & engineers and helps them decide what to build next and whether it worked.  
  
You’ll join one of four teams: Onboarding, Send, Account or Growth. Each owns a different stage of the customer’s journey with Wise, and each is described below. You won’t be on your own. A senior analyst will mentor you, review your work and help you grow, and you’ll be part of a team of analysts covering the whole North America product.  
  
What you’ll be doing:

* Shape Strategy & Prioritization: You’ll help your team understand where customers struggle and what is worth fixing first. That means digging into funnels and customer behavior, reading customer feedback and survey responses, and sizing opportunities so the team can prioritize the work with the biggest impact. As you grow, you’ll lead your own discoveries and present recommendations to your product manager.
* Learn Launch Rigor & Experimentation: You’ll help design and analyze A/B tests and pre/post comparisons for new features, and learn to turn the results into a clear call: roll out, iterate or roll back. You’ll keep an eye on your team’s core metrics and flag when something looks wrong.
* Build on the Semantic Layer: We believe analysts add the most value when they focus on product discovery, not ad-hoc requests. You’ll learn to build and maintain the data models and dashboards that let your team answer their own questions, using Snowflake, dbt, Git, Airflow, Python and Lightdash, and help improve the AI skills that run our routine reporting.
* Share What You Learn: You’ll explain your findings to your team and the wider NorthAm squad, in writing, in charts and in person, so that your work leads to a decision.

**How we work with AI:**  
We lean hard into AI: AI skills produce our routine work and deep dives, so our analysts can focus on discovery. You’ll use AI tools every day, and you’ll own the answer, not the tool: checking the data, the logic and the conclusion before anyone acts on it.  
  
**Where you could join:**  
  
**Onboarding** Onboarding owns the first steps of a customer’s journey: creating a profile, getting verified (Know Your Customer / Know Your Business checks) and taking a first action with Wise. It also keeps financial crime out at the front door. The core challenge is letting genuine customers through quickly while stopping bad actors. You might work on questions like:

* Where do new customers drop out between signing up and their first transfer, and what would bring them back?
* Which verification steps slow genuine customers down without catching more fraud or financial crime?

**Send** Send covers what happens when a customer sends money, and is made up of three teams:

* Pay-in: how customers pay money into Wise, for example by bank transfer (ACH) or card. Which payment methods help customers complete their transfer, and what does each one cost us?
* Payout: how money reaches recipients’ bank accounts in the US and Canada, balancing three levers: cost, speed and conversion. What would make these payouts faster or cheaper, and how much more volume would that bring? You’ll also help track the health of our banking partners.
* Payment Risk: transfer suspensions and ACH and card chargebacks. How do we cut losses from chargebacks and fraud without blocking good customers?

**Account** Account owns how customers use Wise as an account, not only for one-off transfers: getting paid into Wise with USD and CAD local account details, spending with the Wise debit card, and earning a return on money held with Wise. You might work on questions like:

* What makes a customer start getting paid into their Wise account, and what makes them keep doing it?
* Who uses the Wise card, for what, and what stops others from using it?
* Does holding money with Wise change how customers send money abroad?

**Growth** Growth owns the top of the funnel: how people find Wise and decide to try it. That covers landing pages, the promotion engine, corridor strategy (which country-to-country routes we focus on) and pricing, where you’ll work with our Pricing Data Science team to understand how price affects demand. You might work on questions like:

* Did a promotion bring in customers who stay, or customers who leave once it ends?
* Which corridors should we focus on next, and why?

**Your first six months:**

* By three months: you own part of your team’s regular metrics and have delivered your first analysis.
* By six months: you’ve led a discovery or an experiment readout from question to recommendation and presented it to your team.

  
**Qualifications**

Qualifications  
What you’ll bring:

* Education: A bachelor’s or master’s degree in a quantitative field such as economics, statistics, mathematics, computer science or engineering, completed by your start date, or equivalent practical experience.
* Technical Foundations: You’ve used SQL, Python or R to answer a real question with data, in a course, a project, an internship or on your own. You understand the basics of statistics, such as distributions, hypothesis tests and confidence intervals, and can tell when a difference is real rather than noise.
* Curiosity & Product Sense: You want to know why customers behave the way they do, and you ask “so what should we do?” about every result.
* Clear Communication: You can explain a finding to someone who isn’t technical, in writing and in conversation, and you’re comfortable saying “I don’t know yet”.
* Ownership: You finish what you start, ask for help early and act on feedback.
* AI with Judgment: You use AI tools to work faster, and you check their output before you trust it.
* Right to Work: You must be authorized to work in the US. We’re unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

  
**Additional Information**

Nice to have but not essential:

* Hands-on experience with any of Snowflake, dbt, Git, Airflow or Lightdash.
* Exposure to A/B testing or causal inference, in a course or in practice.
* An internship or project in analytics, data science, product or finance.
* An interest in payments, fintech, or how people move and manage money across borders.

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.  
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

**Principal Data Analyst**

At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Analyst at Capital One you will leverage analytic and technical skills to innovate, build, and maintain well-managed data solutions and capabilities to tackle business problems.

About the Team

The Bank Tech Analytics team is a group dedicated to advancing data-driven decision-making and operational excellence across the enterprise, delivering comprehensive services for Bank Tech while actively contributing back to the broader organization. The team provides core capabilities spanning metrics and insights frameworks, applied analytics, operational efficiency automation, and AI integration. Through continuous stakeholder partnerships and automated data pipelines via Snowflake/Onelake and Databricks, Bank Tech Analytics transforms complex information into actionable insights and custom reporting solutions. This work enhances the developer experience, equips leaders to drive strategy, and delivers high-impact value by fostering enterprise-wide collaboration and pioneering innovative analytics transformations.

On any given day you will be challenged on three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:

**Innovation**

* Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms
* Build well-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self-service frameworks for data consumers
* Demonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives

**Business Intelligence**

* Partner with the business to provide consultancy and translate the business needs to design and develop tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for insights and data visualization
* Drive analysis that provides meaningful insights on business strategies

**Data Management**

* Drive an understanding and adherence to the principles of data quality management including metadata, lineage, and business definitions
* Work collaboratively with appropriate Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governance
* Build and execute tools to monitor and report on data quality

**Our ideal candidate will have:**

* Degree specialized in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
* Scripting experience in (Python, R, Spark, and SQL)
* Strong desire and experience with data in various forms (data warehouses/SQL, unstructured data)

* At least 3 years of experience utilizing a business intelligence visualization tool

* At least 4 years of experience coding in Python, R, Spark, or SQL
* At least 4 years of experience working within process management and improvement methodologies – Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, etc.

OnPoint is the largest community owned credit union in Oregon – and we’re growing! Our growth provides great opportunities for you to reach your personal and professional goals. We value enthusiasm, commitment to outstanding performance, and providing opportunities to truly make a difference. If you are looking to join a team of dedicated, collaborative, and passionate individuals, OnPoint is looking for our next Data Analyst Sr. – Fraud & Risk. We invite you to explore and grow your career with us!
  
  
**JOB SUMMARY:**  
The Data Analyst Senior – Fraud & Risk will be responsible for transforming fragmented fraud and risk data into trusted, actionable insights that accelerate fraud detection, investigation, recovery, risk mitigation, and audit readiness. This role operates in an ML enabled vendor environment, partnering closely with Fraud Operations, Risk, and Technology to extract maximum value from platforms like Verafin while laying the data foundation for future in house modeling. The analyst will also perform risk data analysis across fraud patterns, operational controls, exposure trends, and model performance to strengthen organizational decision making.
  
  
**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**  

* Design and maintain fraud and risk analytics datasets in Databricks sourced from Verafin, Accelerant, Q2, Fed files, and other operational systems.
* Build governed, repeatable pipelines and curated tables to replace manual Excel/macros processes.
* Integrate cross channel fraud and risk views, such as member, account, product, transaction, case, exposure, or control effectiveness.
* Perform risk data analysis to identify trends, gaps, typologies, control failures, and emerging threats.
* Conduct quantitative assessments of fraud exposure, loss forecasting, and risk scenario analysis.
* Partner with Fraud Operations to interpret and operationalize vendor ML outputs, such as risk scores, alerts, typologies.
* Analyze model performance, false positive rates, thresholds, and operational impacts on fraud and risk controls.
* Collaborate with first and second line risk teams to ensure model outputs align with broader risk strategies.
* Develop executive ready dashboards and investigator ready reporting with
* Support audit, compliance, and regulatory requests with defensible evidence, through traceable, well documented metrics.
* Contribute to fraud and risk data standards, definitions, metadata, and documentation.
* Collaborate with Technology and Architecture on data ingestion and quality improvements.
* Additional projects, responsibilities, or other duties assigned.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & COMPETENCIES:**  

* Advanced SQL proficiency, including complex joins, window functions, data cleansing, performance tuning.
* Strong proficiency with cloud data platforms, such as Databricks, Delta Lake, and distributed data processing.
* Proven experience with trend analysis, loss/risk modeling, exposure calculations, scenario analysis.
* Deep expertise in data quality and governance, such as data lineage, metric definitions, documentation, and standardization.
* Expert-level knowledge in dashboard and visualization tools, executive reporting, investigator tools, KPI dashboards.
* Knowledge of python/scripting, including data transformation, automation, and analytics (preferred but not required).
* Working knowledge of data engineering fundamentals, including data modeling, pipeline development, ETL/ELT, and building curated datasets.

* Strong ability to convert data into meaningful operational and risk insights that influence decisions.
* Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to communicate complex technical issues to employees at all levels.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including senior leaders.
* Working knowledge of fraud schemes, typologies, transaction flows, loss drivers, and enterprise risk frameworks.
* Knowledge of ML based alerting systems, risk scoring, thresholding, and model performance concepts.
* Strong attention to detail, ensuring accuracy, traceability, and defensibility of analyses and reporting.

* 5 years of experience in data analytics
* Advanced SQL and experience working with large, messy datasets
* Experience with Databricks or modern cloud data platforms

description:
**Company Description**

Since opening our first self-storage facility in 1972, Public Storage has grown to become the world’s largest owner and operator of self-storage facilities. With thousands of locations across the United States and Europe and more than 170 million net rentable square feet, we are also among the largest landlords globally.

Recognized as a Great Place to Work by the Great Place to Work Institute, Public Storage is a member of the S&P 500 and FT Global 500. Our common and preferred stock is traded on the New York Stock Exchange.

As the nation’s leading self-storage provider, we are known for our iconic orange doors and our commitment to delivering simple, reliable storage solutions to millions of customers.

 **Job Description**

The Business Intelligence Lead is a senior individual contributor and a key member of the Operations FP&A and Transformation team. This role transforms operational, financial, and workforce data into actionable insights that improve business performance and support informed decision-making across the organization.

The Lead independently owns assigned initiatives from initial problem definition through solution design, development, testing, deployment, adoption, and ongoing support. The role serves as the primary day-to-day owner for project scope, requirements, milestones, stakeholder coordination, data investigation, technical delivery, documentation, and training. The Lead is expected to operate with limited day-to-day direction and to engage the manager for strategic alignment, approval decisions, and support removing organizational roadblocks.

This is a hands-on technical and business leadership role and the successful candidate must combine strong business acumen with advanced capabilities in Power BI, SQL, data modeling, reconciliation, and analytical problem-solving. They must be able to move effectively from a business question to a technical solution, from analysis to insight, and from insight to a clear recommendation.

Key Responsibilities

* Own assigned business intelligence and analytics initiatives end to end, including problem definition, requirements, scope, project planning, milestones, solution design, development, testing, business validation, deployment, documentation, training, adoption, and post-launch support.
* Serve as the primary day-to-day point of contact for stakeholders across Operations, Finance, HR, and IT, translating business needs into clear analytical requirements, measures, data products, dashboards, and decision-support solutions.
* Build, maintain, and continuously improve Power BI dashboards, scorecards, semantic models, and reporting solutions that support operational, financial, workforce, and strategic decision-making.
* Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, validate, reconcile, analyze, and troubleshoot large datasets across multiple enterprise systems and databases.
* Reconcile disparate data sources and establish trusted, repeatable datasets and metric logic suitable for management reporting and business decision-making.
* Investigate data discrepancies and root causes, resolve issues within the role’s authority, and escalate material risks or cross-functional dependencies with a clear recommendation.
* Analyze performance trends, risks, opportunities, and business drivers; form and test hypotheses; and convert findings into practical recommendations and measurable next steps.
* Manage project scope, priorities, dependencies, and delivery commitments. Identify changes or constraints early and recommend options that balance business value, accuracy, timing, and maintainability.
* Support transformation initiatives through KPI development, process analysis, performance measurement, reporting modernization, and adoption of scalable analytical practices.
* Establish and maintain strong documentation for requirements, metric definitions, data lineage, business rules, testing results, known limitations, operating procedures, and ownership.
* Ensure data quality, accuracy, consistency, usability, and appropriate controls across reporting and analytical environments.
* Mentor project contributors and share technical and business knowledge when appropriate, without formal people-management responsibilities.

  
**Qualifications**

Required

* Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Eight or more years of progressive experience in business intelligence, analytics, reporting, FP&A, financial analytics, operations analytics, or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated experience independently leading complex analytics or business intelligence initiatives from initial problem definition through deployment, adoption, and ongoing support.
* Advanced SQL skills, including experience querying, reconciling, validating, troubleshooting, and analyzing large datasets from multiple sources.
* Strong hands-on proficiency with Microsoft Power BI, including dashboard and report development, data modeling, semantic models, DAX, visualization design, performance considerations, and deployment practices.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and the ability to use Excel effectively for analysis, reconciliation, validation, and communication.
* Strong business and financial acumen, with the ability to connect operational and financial performance, interpret KPI movement, and recommend practical actions.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills, including the ability to identify root causes, evaluate alternatives, and make sound recommendations under ambiguity.
* Exceptional attention to detail and a demonstrated commitment to data accuracy, documentation, and consistent metric definitions.
* Strong project ownership and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, dependencies, stakeholders, and delivery commitments with limited day-to-day support.
* Clear and confident written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to tailor technical and analytical concepts for business and senior leadership audiences.
* Good judgment regarding when to act independently, when to seek approval, and when to escalate a risk, decision, or stakeholder issue.
* Candidates should be able to describe an analytics or dashboard solution they owned end to end, including the business problem, stakeholder requirements, technical approach, data challenges, key decisions, final recommendation, and measurable business outcome.

Preferred

* Experience working with SAP, Workday, payroll systems, and Google BigQuery.
* Experience supporting Operations, FP&A, workforce analytics, or business transformation initiatives.
* Experience establishing or improving KPI definitions, data governance, reporting standards, or analytical operating processes.
* Experience presenting findings and recommendations to Directors or Vice Presidents.

  
**Additional Information**

One of our core values is working as OneTeam. We believe in the value of in-person collaboration while recognizing the importance of flexibility. Public Storage teammates are expected to work in the office five days per week, with the option to use up to three flexible remote-work days each month.

\*\*Sponsorship for Work Authorization is not available for this posting. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without restrictions or requiring sponsorship now or in the future. We do not provide training plans or support for F-1 OPT, STEM OPT extensions, or future visa sponsorship.\*\*

LMI is seeking a Data Analyst to support Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) modernization initiatives. These full-time positions provide hands-on analytical capacity across AI-enabled use cases, operational improvement, workflow modernization, performance measurement, reporting, data-quality assessment, and decision support.

The Data Analysts will use SQL and Python as core day-to-day tools to acquire, prepare, validate, analyze, and automate data workflows. They will also support AI-enabled analysis and solution evaluation by preparing evaluation datasets, assessing AI-generated outputs, identifying data-quality and grounding issues, measuring performance, and helping teams distinguish useful AI-assisted insights from unsupported or unreliable results.

The role works closely with the Senior AI Lead, Data Science Lead, data integration, program evaluation, clinical informatics, delivery, and technical teams. These analysts are not expected to replace data scientists or AI engineers; they provide the scalable analytical execution, validation, and evidence needed to move multiple AI and modernization workstreams forward responsibly.

Candidates should independently execute well-scoped analyses and recurring analytical products. Candidates should own more complex multi-source and AI-enabled analyses, shape analytical approaches, review work, and advise stakeholders. Strong candidates combine practical AI experience with strong SQL and Python skills, disciplined documentation, data-quality judgment, and concise communication.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities:

* Support AI-enabled analytics and modernization use cases by preparing data, defining measures, evaluating outputs, and identifying data-quality, grounding, accuracy, bias, or reliability issues that could affect decisions.
* Use SQL and Python as primary analytical tools to extract, query, join, clean, transform, validate, analyze, and automate data across multiple approved sources.
* Build and maintain evaluation datasets, test cases, comparison analyses, and performance measures for AI/ML or generative AI capabilities under appropriate technical leadership.
* Profile enterprise, operational, workflow, program, survey, and AI-related data for availability, completeness, consistency, lineage, sensitivity, and fitness for intended use.
* Perform exploratory, descriptive, trend, cohort, segmentation, variance, before/after, and exception analysis appropriate to the decision need and available data.
* Build analysis-ready datasets, analytical tables, visualizations, dashboards, and concise decision-support products for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Translate stakeholder and AI-use-case questions into data requirements, metric definitions, filters, denominators, business rules, validation checks, and analytical outputs.
* Support retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI search, or knowledge-based use cases by assessing source coverage, authoritative data, metadata, retrieval quality, and content gaps.
* Reconcile discrepancies across source systems, AI outputs, reports, dashboards, or stakeholder calculations and determine the source and materiality of inconsistent results.

* Partner with AI, data science, and engineering resources when work requires advanced modeling, model development, pipelines, APIs, new integrations, or production deployment.
* Perform quality assurance and reasonableness checks before findings are released; escalate data, AI-output, or methodology concerns that could materially change conclusions.

Tactical Data Link Analyst

Exempt

The Tactical Data Link (TDL) Analyst is responsible for supporting the planning, execution, analysis, and reporting of test and evaluation events for Air Command and Control (C2) systems and associated Tactical Data Link architectures. This role provides technical expertise in assessing Information Exchange Requirements (IERs), TDL interfaces, and system performance against applicable military standards and operational requirements. The TDL Analyst plays a critical role in data collection, synchronization, and analysis, ensuring accurate validation of system interoperability and compliance. The ideal candidate possesses strong analytical skills, deep knowledge of TDL standards and protocols, and the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights that support system verification, evaluation, and mission effectiveness.

* Perform technical assessments of Air C2 systems, including Information Exchange Requirements (IERs), TDL interfaces, and system requirements for verification and evaluation.
* Provide recommendations on test tools, data logging, and post-test analysis solutions, including development of matrices aligned to IERs, TDLs, and system interfaces.
* Support test planning and coordination meetings by providing technical input to Test Directors, Instrumentation and Data Management (IDM) leads, and Technical Support Officers (TSO).
* Configure, connect, and prepare data collection devices; ensure proper time synchronization and report discrepancies to test leadership.
* Organize and manage data files, logs, and artifacts in accordance with command policies and test director guidance.
* Monitor test execution and identify deviations from TDL standards; support tracking and resolution of issues, including Problem Change Requests (PCRs) and MIL-STD compliance.
* Analyze collected data to verify system compliance with applicable standards, including MIL-STD-6016, 6020, 6017, 3011, 6040, and NATO NILE specifications, as well as CJCSM 6120.01 procedures.
* Maintain required certifications and technical proficiency, including CompTIA Security+, Joint Multi-TDL Network (MTN) Operations (JT101), Wireshark analysis, and relevant simulation/training tools (BOSS, NGTS). (Desired)

**Competencies for the role**

The Tactical Data Link (TDL) Analyst demonstrates strong analytical and technical expertise in evaluating Air C2 systems, TDL interfaces, and compliance with military standards. **Working Here | Experience Serving Your Community**
====================================================

If you are looking to foster a fulfilling career path while serving your community, you are in the right place. All careers at CHAS Health allow you to make an impact on patient’s lives and our greater community. No matter what clinic or location you join, you become a part of the bigger picture – providing trustworthy, patient-centered, and attentive care to anyone who walks through our doors. We continue to expand operations and are regularly looking for talented and dedicated individuals to help us continue to make a difference in patient lives. Challenging the status quo starts with you – get started today.

**Everyone Welcome**
--------------------

From the beginning, we strongly believe that all people have the right to high-quality health care. Our goal is to remove barriers to care and provide high-quality, evidence-based care in a place that is convenient – in your neighborhood. We believe everyone deserves to be treated with dignity and respect regardless of their situation.

-----------------------

$30.05 - $44.13

Join a workforce that values your expertise as much as your wellbeing! CHAS Health's comprehensive compensation package\* includes:

* **Annual milestone bonus** for all eligible employees! $500 for every year worked, up to $5,000.
* **Robust health coverage** with employer-offered medical, dental, vision, long-term care, and life insurance.
* **401(k) with up to 6% employer match** for a retirement plan that invests in your future.
* **Work/life balance** —enjoy more than six (6) weeks of paid time off (PTO) annually for full-time employees, to recharge and refresh.

* **CME and license fee reimbursement** —we've got you covered.

***\**** *Offered benefits dependent upon employee eligibility and criteria*
