**Purpose of Job**

Improve the overall health of the communities we serve by leveraging financial, operational, and clinical data, providing analysis and recommendations to CHAS service line leaders, and assisting in assessing the quality of care and services provided by CHAS Health as follows:

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Extracts data from a variety of software programs to design, construct, and analyze reports and dashboards based on the needs of the organization.
* Maintains relationships with business partners to offer proactive solutions and ensure data needs are met.
* Assists in maintaining finance and business intelligence data warehouse and reporting suite.
* Validates source data and end-user reports.
* Participates in CHAS Health collaborative and other special project teams as necessary and/or requested.
* Makes recommendations and reports findings to management and other staff based on continuing analysis of data.
* Assists in researching and creating new reporting solutions.
* Trains new employees on how to use existing reports and dashboards.
* Performs other duties as assigned, including supporting the CHAS Health Mission and Core Values.

**Qualifications**

Education/Experience: Bachelor’s degree in business, Computer Science, Data Analytics or related field preferred. Combination of education and work experience will be considered in lieu of degree. 3 years’ experience working with end users, translating requirements into designing dashboards that address service line needs or questions. Background in user experience, data visualization, and information delivery best practices. Tableau experience and proficiency in Excel required. Experience and a working knowledge of analytic/report writing and data gathering in Microsoft SQL, SSAS, and SSIS preferred.

Skills: Spreadsheet, word processing, database, and presentation software including all Microsoft Office applications experience required. Strong problem solving, communication and customer service skills, as well as commitment to quality required. Ability to self-direct and determine priorities required. Confidentiality, accuracy, and thoroughness required. Commitment to supporting a safe and respectful environment is required. Valid drivers’ license and insurance required.

Required to stand, sit and be mobile up to one-third of the time. Required to use hands to finger, handle or feel over two-thirds of the time; while reaching with hands and arms occurs one-third of the day. Required to read from text and computer screen over two-thirds of the time. Climbing or balancing, stooping, kneeling or crouching occurs less than one-third of the time. Communicating occurs constantly throughout the day. Lifting occurs less than the time up to 10 lbs. Rarely is there a need to lift more than 10 lbs.

Our core values are our foundation, the guiding sense of direction for our organization:

* Social Responsibility
* Patient-Centered
* Entrepreneurship
* Respect for Human Dignity
* Commitment to Continuous Quality Improvement
* Fun

**ATTENTION ALASKA RESIDENTS!**

**The Department of Labor and Workforce Development, Division of Employment and Training Services, is recruiting for an**  
**Employment Security Analyst 2 located in Juneau!**  
**No Cover Letter Required!**

**This position is in the General Government Unit (GGU) at a Range 17.**

  
  
**What You Will Be Doing:**
  
You will be working with a team in the Employment and Training Technical Unit (ETTU) to ensure excellence in Alaska's delivery of employment and training services described in the federal Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act (WIOA) and other statewide programs, with a primary focus on Data Validation.
  
  
You will have opportunities to build and use skills in interpreting and summarizing federal guidance to support statewide job center staff.
  
  
Imagine the rewards you will feel as you are applying your investigative and analytical abilities by conducting research, analyzing interesting data, building relationships with colleagues and agency staff, and discovering new information on the division’s many programs all to support your fellow Alaskans in their endeavors for a better lifestyle through meaningful employment.
  
  
You will also be able to use and build on your skills as a trainer and developer by creating resources, forms, and guidance, on a variety of platforms.
  
  
The work is fast-paced, ever-changing, and challenging, performed both independently and as part of a high-level team.
  
  
**Our Mission, Values, and Culture:**
  
The Division of Employment and Training Services (DETS) works with business and industry to build a trained and prepared workforce by providing labor exchange, employment and training services, and unemployment insurance to Alaskans and Alaska employers, thereby advancing opportunities for employment and economic stability for communities in Alaska.
  
  
The ETTU oversees and coordinates many employment and training programs and ensures compliance with state and federal directives, and your work as an Employment Security Analyst will pave the path for many Alaskans to train for better job opportunities and for Alaskan employers and job seekers to connect successfully.
  
  
The ETTU provides the primary and highest level of technical support and troubleshooting for the Workforce Development and Workforce Services programs in the areas of project/program management, compliance, planning, analysis, training, service delivery, corrective action, and evaluation of program improvements.
  
  
**Benefits of Joining Our Team:**
  
Working as an analyst in employment and training programs will give you the opportunity to delve into and absorb the complexities of program requirements, build your skills as a technical support expert, and communicate with a wide range of professionals including Data Processing, job center and other state staff, and program stakeholders. Outstanding work at this level looks great on your resume and positions you for upper-management jobs with the state and other organizations.
  
  
Your contribution to this team will be integral to ensuring Alaskans can select a variety of services and benefits while balancing performance and data management.
  
  
We provide a competitive benefit package and job stability, including the option for flexible/hybrid telework after passing probation.
  
  
**The Working Environment You Can Expect:**
  
This position is housed at the ETTU office in the Juneau Labor Building, which enjoys sweeping channel views, ample free parking, and proximity to downtown walking, coffee, dining, and shopping opportunities.
  
  
The environment is professional and respectful, but camaraderie and frequent laughter are also encouraged and appreciated.
  
  
This position may require travel within the state annually or semiannually.
  
  
**Who We Are Looking For:**
  
We are interested in candidates who possess some or all of the following position specific competencies:

* Self-Management: Sets well-defined and realistic goals; displays a high level of initiative, effort, organization, and commitment towards completing assignments in a timely manner, with or without supervision; is motivated to achieve; demonstrates responsible behavior.
* Adaptability: Adjusts planned work by gathering relevant information and applying critical thinking to analyze and solve problems to address multiple demands and competing priorities in a changing environment.

* Research: Knowledge of the scientific principles, methods, and processes used to conduct a systematic and objective inquiry; including study design, collection, analysis, and interpretation of data; and the reporting of results.

  

**To view the general description and example of duties for the position, please go to the following link:**
  
https://www.governmentjobs.com/careers/Alaska/classspecs

--------------------------

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Reading: Understands and interprets written material, including technical material, rules, regulations, instructions, reports, charts, graphs, or tables; applies what is learned from written material to specific situations.

The Senior Data Analyst shall collect, process, and analyze data to extract meaningful insights, identify patterns and support decision-making. Utilizing tools and technologies such as data mining, Artificial Intelligence (AI), machine learning, and data visualization, the Senior Data Analyst shall transform raw data into actionable information.

The Senior Data Analyst provides advanced data mining, statistical modeling/analysis, trend analysis, machine learning and Tableau/power BI, serving as a technical lead to monitor and deliver monthly support.

* Analyze trends, performance indicators, inventory metrics, readiness data, and supply chain information to support leadership decision-making.

description:
**Position Overview**
=====================

The Data Analyst support clinical and research programs addressing chronic diseases including obesity and diabetes. The analyst manages program data, develops performance dashboards, and leads the preparation and coordination of required data reporting to support health interventions and continuous improvement.

Working with program leaders, clinical teams, and external partners, the analyst turns complex healthcare and program data into clear, actionable findings across initiatives such as telehealth and value-based care. The role requires strong analytical skills, and extensive familiarity with healthcare systems.

**Core Responsibilities**
=========================

**Data Management and Quality**

  

* Manage and maintain data across several initiatives, integrating approved sources such as program records, electronic health records, claims, enrollment files, and partner submissions as available.
* Develop repeatable processes to extract, clean, transform, link, and validate data. Investigate missing values, duplicates, inconsistencies, and reconciliation issues with data owners and program partners.
* Maintain data dictionaries, measure specifications, source documentation, and version-controlled analytical code to support consistent definitions, reproducible results, and reliable reporting.
  

**Dashboards and Performance Measurement**

* Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards using tools such as Power BI or Tableau to monitor key performance indicators, service utilization, access, quality, and program outcomes.
* Collaborate with the intervention team to define measures, baselines, targets, denominators, and reporting periods. Establish dashboard refresh schedules appropriate to source availability and clearly display data currency and limitations.
* Analyze trends and variation across initiatives, populations, providers, and geographic areas. Assess rural access barriers and disparities while applying appropriate safeguards for small populations.

**Federal and State Reporting**

* Lead data collection, validation, analysis, and preparation of required federal and state reports. Coordinate internal review, approval, and timely submission according to terms, reporting specifications, and program deadlines.
* Maintain reporting calendars, submission instructions, validation checks, and supporting documentation. Reconcile reported results to source data and retain an auditable record of submissions, revisions, and approvals.
* Monitor changes to reporting requirements with program and compliance staff, translate them into data specifications, and help resolve reporting discrepancies and follow-up requests

**Data Governance and Partner Collaboration**

* Support data-sharing agreements and exchange protocols in collaboration with legal, privacy, security, and information technology teams.
* Follow approved data-use restrictions, access controls, secure transfer procedures, retention requirements, and applicable privacy policies. Escalate data access, quality, or security concerns through established channels.
* Provide technical assistance and training on data submission specifications, dashboard use, measure interpretation, and basic data literacy. Work with partners to improve completeness and consistency of submissions.

**Analysis and Program Improvement**

* Use appropriate statistical and analytical methods to identify trends, service gaps, and opportunities for improvement. Distinguish descriptive findings from causal conclusions and communicate limitations, including data lags and incomplete coverage.
* Translate findings into concise reports, presentations, and recommendations tailored to clinical, operational, and executive audiences. Partner with program teams to evaluate changes and monitor progress toward established goals.

**About the Opportunity:**

Melissa is looking for a curious, detail-oriented, and technically capable data professional to help maintain and improve the quality of some of our most important proprietary data assets. At Melissa, we develop data quality and identity solutions that help organizations maintain accurate, reliable, and connected information.

We are looking for someone to take a hands-on role in understanding, analyzing, validating, and continuously improving these identifiers. You will work directly with large datasets, investigate data anomalies, develop quality checks, evaluate changes, and collaborate with technical teams to ensure our identifiers remain accurate, consistent, and reliable. This is an opportunity to develop deep expertise in data quality, identity resolution, and large-scale data management while taking ownership of data assets used by Melissa's customers.

**What You Will Do:**

* Analyze and validate data for accuracy, consistency, uniqueness, and reliability.
* Investigate data anomalies, duplicate identifiers, unexpected key changes, incorrect matches, and other data-quality issues.
* Write SQL queries to compare datasets, identify patterns, investigate problems, and validate results.
* Develop repeatable data-quality checks, reports, and automated validation processes.
* Evaluate changes in data sources, matching rules, and data-processing procedures to identify potential impacts on identifier quality.
* Collaborate with Data Production, Programming, and Quality Assurance teams to investigate and resolve issues.
* Test and validate improvements, corrections, and new capabilities involving Melissa's identifiers.
* Monitor quality trends and recommend opportunities for improvement.
* Maintain documentation of findings, quality standards, known issues, and validation procedures.
* Help establish and maintain data-integrity metrics and reporting.

**What We Are Looking For:**

**Required Qualifications:**

* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
* Ability to investigate complex data issues, identify patterns, and draw meaningful conclusions.
* Strong attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently, take initiative, and follow problems through to resolution.
* Experience working with data in an analytical, operational, or technical capacity.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 2 or more years of relevant experience in data analysis, data quality, data operations, or a related field.
* Experience working with large datasets.
* Familiarity with AI, Python or other scripting tools for data analysis and automation.

* Experience with data profiling, data validation, or quality monitoring.
* Familiarity with ETL processes, APIs, or data-processing pipelines.
* Experience investigating production data issues and evaluating changes between data releases.

**Senior Logistics Data Analyst / Logistics Management Specialist**

**Location:** Indiana National Guard Headquarters, Indianapolis, Indiana

**Position Summary**

LAUKOA is seeking an experienced Senior Logistics Data Analyst / Logistics Management Specialist to provide specialized logistics data analytics, reporting, compliance support, and professional training services to the Indiana Army National Guard (INARNG) J4 Directorate. This position combines advanced technical expertise in Microsoft Power BI and enterprise data integration with extensive knowledge of Army logistics operations, equipment readiness, property accountability, maintenance management, and command logistics discipline programs.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

1. Business Intelligence, Power BI, and Data Analytics

* Administer, maintain, troubleshoot, and enhance thirteen existing interactive Microsoft Power BI dashboards within the authorized Army365 environment.
* Conduct daily monitoring of dashboard functionality, data pipelines, scheduled refreshes, reporting accuracy, and data integrity.
* Collect, integrate, validate, and reconcile logistics information from approximately 51 data sources across 20 automated military information systems.
* Develop and maintain analytical reports, performance metrics, data models, dashboards, and visualizations that support equipment readiness, supply accountability, maintenance performance, and logistics compliance.
* Utilize Microsoft Power BI, Power Query, Power Platform, and authorized analytical tools to streamline recurring reporting and reduce manual processing.
* Identify data discrepancies, incomplete transactions, reporting errors, and emerging operational trends through structured data analysis.
* Maintain technical documentation, source mappings, report definitions, and change records.

2. Army Logistics Information Systems

Extract, interpret, analyze, and reconcile data from applicable Army and federal logistics information systems, including:

* Army Vantage
* Global Combat Support System–Army (GCSS-Army)
* General Fund Enterprise Business System (GFEBS)
* Decision Support Tool (DST)
* Standardized Equipment and Maintenance systems (SEAM)
* General Services Administration (GSA) Fleet systems
* Transportation Coordinators' Automated Information for Movements System II (TCAIMS II)

Coordinate with Government system owners and functional personnel to investigate reporting discrepancies, validate source records, and support accurate and consistent leadership reporting.

3. Command Logistics Discipline Program Support

Provide technical data collection, analytical reporting, and administrative support for the following programs:

Command Supply Discipline Program (CSDP): Analyze property accountability records, inventory discrepancies, hand receipts, supply transaction histories, and compliance information in accordance with AR 710-4.

Command Maintenance Discipline Program (CMDP): Analyze maintenance records, overdue work orders, equipment readiness, preventive maintenance status, and maintenance compliance information in accordance with AR 750-1.

Command Deployment Discipline Program (CDDP): Support the collection and analysis of unit deployment readiness, movement planning, documentation, and deployment compliance information in accordance with AR 525-93.

Command Food Service Discipline Program (CFSDP): Collect, organize, and analyze Government-provided food service compliance information in accordance with AR 30-22.

Compile validated data into leadership reports, compliance summaries, dashboards, and tracking products. All official compliance determinations remain the responsibility of authorized Government personnel.

4. Statewide Logistics Evaluation Support

* Provide technical and administrative assistance to INARNG J4 Government evaluation teams during scheduled logistics assessments.
* Prepare preinspection analytical packages containing equipment accountability information, maintenance records, historical deficiencies, and relevant supply data.
* Assist Government evaluators with reviewing digital hand receipts, inventory records, transaction histories, and supporting documentation.
* Document discrepancies, organize supporting evidence, and prepare analytical summaries for Government review.
* Support evaluations at five Direct Reporting Units, thirteen maintenance shops, Army Aviation Support Facility, Limited Aviation Support Facility, 38th Infantry Division, 81st Troop Command, and Camp Atterbury.
* Prepare post-evaluation reports and recommendations within prescribed PWS timelines, including the fifteen-calendar-day reporting requirement.

The contractor serves exclusively in a technical and advisory capacity. Government officials retain responsibility for inspection decisions, formal compliance ratings, and approval of findings.

5. Training Development and Instruction

* Assist with identifying statewide training needs based on logistics compliance findings, readiness trends, and operational deficiencies.
* Develop and update training presentations, instructional materials, practical exercises, reference guides, and supporting curriculum.
* Coordinate with INARNG subject matter experts to ensure training content accurately reflects applicable Army regulations and policies.
* Serve as a co-instructor during four quarterly regional logistics training events and two annual logistics workshops.
* Provide technical instruction on logistics information systems, property accountability, equipment readiness, maintenance reporting, and data analysis as directed by Government training objectives.
* Support training evaluations, documentation, and continuous improvement of instructional materials.

6. Reporting, Coordination, and Documentation

* Prepare clear, accurate, and timely reports, information papers, briefings, and decision-support products for J4 leadership.

description:
**About Peregrine**

Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA.

We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people.

As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become.

**People first. Ownership always.**

We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else.

At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk.

At Peregrine Advisors, you will turn a federal program's operational data into figures its people can rely on. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are.

This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination.

**Your first project**

Your first project will likely have you building the reporting a federal program runs on. Depending on the assignment, you may:

* Work with the people who own each process to define its measures, and document the business rules behind every figure.
* Write the Structured Query Language (SQL) that turns platform data on Amazon Aurora and related Amazon Web Services (AWS) data stores into clean, reconciled analytical datasets.
* Build the recurring reports, dashboards, and data visualizations the program actually uses, with documented measures, refresh schedules, and access controls, designed to answer the question, load fast, and never mislead with a scale or a label.
* Trace each discrepancy to its source, whether a definition, timing, a filter, or a source system, until the figure is explained.
* Produce the quality evidence behind the reporting: validation checks, reconciliation reports, and issue logs that hold up in an audit.
* Replace manual reporting with repeatable, tested workflows.
* Make AI-assisted analysis standard practice, using coding assistants and language models across the work with your own judgment on top.

You help deliver figures a federal program can run on, each with the provenance to show where it came from, and clean datasets that give every later analysis solid ground.

This is where you start, not the shape of your career here.

 **Requirements**  

* 4+ years of data analysis experience using SQL
* Bachelor's degree
* A strong working command of SQL
* Experience building reports and dashboards in a business intelligence tool, such as Power BI, Tableau, or a comparable tool
* Familiarity with Python or R for analysis scripting
* The ability to own an analysis from the first question to a delivered, documented answer
* Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel

**Preferred**

* Master's degree in a relevant field
* Experience with cloud data platforms on AWS
* Experience with federal program, financial, or performance data
* Familiarity with AI-assisted development and analysis tools

**Who you are**

You are exact with numbers and wary of any you cannot explain: an anomaly is something to run down, not a footnote. You move easily between a stakeholder's question and the data that answers it, and you would rather hand a program one figure it can trust than ten it cannot. You adapt, and you pick up new concepts, systems, and tools fast enough to stay ahead of what the program needs as projects finish and priorities shift. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task.

**What you bring**

* A practical command of SQL and spreadsheets, with Python or R scripting where it makes the work faster or safer.
* The discipline of defined measures: rules written down, sources reconciled, and reports that refresh without surprises.
* The judgment to pick the chart that serves the reader, and the restraint to leave out the one that does not.
* The care to work where accuracy and auditability are not optional.

**When we talk**

Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned.

 **Benefits**

This is a full-time W-2 position with a salary of $67,000 to $123,000 per year.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer-paid life, accidental death, and short-term and long-term disability insurance; a 401(k) with an employer match of up to 4% of salary; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education.

**What we offer**

You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship.

**What we commit to**

As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better.

We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply.

### **Description**

**Position Description**

The Catholic Community Foundation of Minnesota (CCF) seeks an analytical, detail-oriented, and mission-driven Database & Reporting Analyst to serve as the organization's primary resource for CRM data stewardship, reporting and analytics, donor intelligence, and prospect research.

In close partnership with teams across CCF, this position maintains the quality and usefulness of constituent information; develops reports, dashboar4ds, and segmented lists; conducts donor and prospect research; and translates organizational information into practical insights that support donor and client engagement, charitable fund development, stewardship, and organizational decision-making. This role uses Salesforce and related information sources to generate insight, support relationship development, and improve decision-making.

The Analyst collaborates closely with the Data Systems Manager, who is responsible for Salesforce administration, configuration, security, integrations, data governance, and broader systems management. The Database & Reporting Analyst focuses on the quality, analysis, reporting, and practical use of information.

**Key Responsibilities**

Reporting and Analytics

* Develop and maintain Salesforce reports, dashboards, and data visualizations for staff, leadership, committees, and the Board.
* Create pipeline, portfolio, prospect, referral, charitable fund development, and activity reports that support donor and client engagement, stewardship, and relationship management.
* Analyze donor, client, charitable fund, financial, and operational information to identify trends, opportunities, and areas requiring attention.
* Establish and document consistent report logic, key performance indicators, and reporting definitions in collaboration with the Data Systems Manager.
* Identify engagement trends, advisor referral activity, pipeline movement, portfolio opportunities, and other insights that improve visibility into donor and client development, charitable fund opportunities, relationship activity, and organizational performance.

CRM Data Stewardship

* Maintain accurate constituent, household, organization, relationship, opportunity, activity, interest, and communication-preference information.
* Perform data exports, validations, list pulls, record updates, and recurring data-hygiene activities in coordination with the Data Systems Manager and established data-governance procedures.
* Monitor data quality; resolve routine duplicate, incomplete, outdated, or inconsistent records; conduct periodic data reviews and audits; and ensure that reports and lists are based on reliable information.
* Reconcile information across Salesforce and other organizational systems to improve reporting accuracy and reliability.
* Identify data-quality and process improvements, surface recurring issues that affect reporting or decision-making, and escalate systemic, cross-platform, or governance-related issues to the Data Systems Manager.

Donor Intelligence and Prospect Research

* Conduct donor and prospect research to support donor and client development, relationship management, charitable fund opportunities, events, and stewardship.
* Prepare prospect profiles, donor briefings, portfolio reviews, event briefings, and other donor and philanthropic intelligence for development staff and leadership.
* Identify and help qualify prospective donors, fundholders, professional advisors, and institutional partners through research, data analysis, segmentation, and approved screening resources.
* Coordinate wealth-screening activities and analyze giving patterns, interests, relationships, referrals, engagement, and other indicators to identify opportunities for relationship development, charitable fund establishment, professional referrals, stewardship, and appropriate next steps.
* Translate research findings into practical intelligence that helps staff identify cultivation opportunities, prepare for donor and client conversations, and determine appropriate next steps.

Communications Support

* Prepare accurate, segmented mailing, email, event, annual report, and other constituent lists in partnership with Marketing and Communications and other internal teams.
* Develop segmentation approaches for donors, prospective clients, fundholders, professional advisors, institutional partners, event participants, and other constituent audiences.
* Document list criteria, exclusions, communication preferences, and business rules, and resolve data-quality issues affecting organizational communications.

Documentation, Training, and Staff Support

* Partner with staff to understand reporting, list-management, portfolio-management, donor and client development and stewardship needs, and develop practical tools and solutions that support daily work.
* Document reports, dashboards, definitions, and recurring reporting processes.
* Provide staff documentation, training, and support for reports, dashboards, list views, activity tracking, segmentation, and related data practices.
* Coordinate with the Data Systems Manager on reporting-related system enhancements, configuration needs, testing, adoption, and broader Salesforce support.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**Compensation**

The salary range for this position is: $70,000 - $80,000, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

CCF offers a comprehensive benefits package, including 403(b) retirement plan with employer match and discretionary contributions; employer-subsidized medical, dental, and disability coverage; paid life insurance and access to additional voluntary benefits; generous paid time off plus 11 paid holidays; flexible spending accounts, and flexible Friday scheduling in the summer.

### **Qualifications**

**Experience and Skills**

CCF recognizes that relevant expertise may be gained through a variety of educational and professional experiences. Candidates should demonstrate an appropriate combination of the following:

* Bachelor's degree in business analytics, information systems, data science, statistics, business administration, finance, or three to five years of relevant experience in database management, data analysis and reporting, CRM data stewardship, prospect research, philanthropic services, development operations, or a related field.
* Experience developing reports and dashboards in Salesforce or a comparable CRM and maintaining constituent data through imports, exports, validation, and data-quality processes.
* Experience with Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud, Nonprofit Success Pack, or another nonprofit CRM environment; Salesforce certification is a plus.
* Experience conducting donor or prospect research, preparing profiles, briefings, and donor-intelligence reports, and using research or wealth-screening tools such as Kindsight iWave, Insightful Philanthropy, DonorSearch, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with philanthropic giving indicators, prospect qualification, moves management, donor stewardship, portfolio management, and donor and client relationship practices.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and strong analytics, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to translate complex information into clear reports, findings, and recommendations for technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and commitment to accuracy, data integrity, confidentiality, and practical staff support.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and collaborate effectively across teams.
* Experience in a community foundation, philanthropic services organization, nonprofit development office, or financial-services environment, with interest in responsibly using AI and emerging technology to improve reporting, donor intelligence, and organizational insight.
* A commitment to the mission of CCF is also desired.

**Position Title:** Pipeline Intelligence Analyst

**Location:** 633 3 rd Ave, New York, NY 10017

**Reports to:** Director of Strategic Intelligence and Pipeline

**Compensation** : $82,000 - $92,000/Yr ( *based on experience and qualifications* )

**About The Fedcap Group**

For more than 90 years, Fedcap has been turning possibility into reality. As a global nonprofit serving more than 335,000 people each year across the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and Australia, we open doors to economic mobility through innovative, evidence-based solutions in education, workforce development, health, and economic development. Join us and experience The Power of Possible, where your work creates real opportunities for people facing barriers to economic well-being and helps build stronger communities every day.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

Reporting to the Director of Strategic Intelligence and Pipeline, the Pipeline Intelligence Analyst is responsible for maintaining a trusted enterprise pipeline and producing the analysis required to manage growth performance, opportunity priorities and portfolio risk.

The postholder will drive CRM discipline, data quality, reporting and dashboarding, while providing insight on conversion, must-win priorities, recompete exposure, concentration and pipeline risk. The role will turn pipeline data into clear management information that supports governance, financial alignment and action.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Pipeline Data Quality & CRM Discipline**
------------------------------------------

Maintain a complete, accurate and trusted enterprise pipeline by applying agreed data, stage and governance standards. Work directly with opportunity owners to resolve gaps and ensure records reflect the current position.

* Monitor Salesforce and associated pipeline records for completeness, accuracy, currency and consistency.
* Validate opportunity value, stage, timing, probability, ownership, next steps and supporting evidence.
* Follow up missing or overdue updates with opportunity owners and track resolution of data-quality issues.
* Apply agreed pipeline definitions, entry and exit criteria and mandatory data standards.
* Produce data-quality reports and identify recurring control or adoption issues.

**Pipeline Reporting & Dashboards**
-----------------------------------

Produce clear, reliable management information that gives leaders visibility of pipeline value, maturity, movement and risk. Maintain dashboards and reporting packs that support action and decision-making.

* Prepare regular pipeline dashboards, KPI reports, review packs and executive summaries.
* Report pipeline value by stage, geography, service line, customer, owner and expected decision date.
* Highlight material movements, stalled opportunities, overdue actions and changes in assumptions.
* Maintain consistent reporting logic, definitions and reconciliations across reports.
* Improve reporting efficiency through appropriate dashboarding, automation and standard templates.

**Pipeline Reviews & Governance Support**
-----------------------------------------

Coordinate the information and analysis required for effective pipeline governance. Ensure review forums have accurate records, clear actions and timely follow-through.

* Prepare agendas, analysis and opportunity information for pipeline and portfolio reviews.
* Identify records that do not meet qualification, evidence or stage-gate requirements.
* Capture decisions, actions, owners and deadlines arising from governance reviews.
* Monitor agreed actions and escalate unresolved data or process issues to the Director.
* Maintain the governance calendar and supporting documentation.

**Prioritization & Portfolio Analysis**
---------------------------------------

Provide analysis that supports evidence-based opportunity prioritization and must-win management. Help leaders understand pipeline balance, resource implications and alignment with growth strategy.

* Maintain prioritization scores, must-win reporting and portfolio views using agreed criteria.
* Analyze pipeline balance across sectors, commissioners, territories, service lines and maturity stages.
* Identify concentration, diversification and coverage trends within the opportunity portfolio.
* Prepare analytical inputs for resource allocation and investment discussions.
* Track whether priority opportunities continue to meet the evidence required for their status.

**Conversion, Win/Loss & Performance Insight**
----------------------------------------------

Track how opportunities progress through the lifecycle and identify where conversion is improving or weakening. Convert performance data into practical insight for governance and continuous improvement.

* Calculate and monitor stage conversion, win rates, pipeline velocity and ageing using agreed definitions.
* Analyze bottlenecks, stalled opportunities and patterns in progression or attrition.
* Support win/loss reviews by preparing data, trends and opportunity histories.
* Compare performance across relevant portfolio dimensions without overstating conclusions.
* Produce concise recommendations and follow-up measures arising from analysis.

**Recompete, Concentration & Pipeline Risk Insight**

**Data Product Analyst**
========================

**Location:** Charlotte, NC (Hybrid)

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

We're looking for a Data Product Analyst to help transform business needs into trusted, usable data products that power reporting, analytics, and better business decisions. In this role, you'll help bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring data products are thoughtfully designed, well-documented, and built to solve real business problems.

You'll have the opportunity to contribute throughout the data product lifecycle, from discovery and requirements gathering to testing, documentation, and ongoing improvement. If you're curious about data, enjoy solving problems, and like bringing people together to turn ideas into action, this is an opportunity to build your expertise while making a meaningful impact.

**How You'll Make an Impact**
-----------------------------

* **Translate Business Needs into Actionable Requirements:** Partner with business stakeholders to understand their goals, reporting needs, workflows, and data challenges. Document requirements and translate discovery findings into clear user stories, development tickets, and acceptance criteria.
* **Support Data Product Design and Development:** Collaborate with Data Product leads, reporting teams, and data engineers to define data needs, business rules, definitions, dependencies, and expected outcomes.
* **Build Trusted Product Documentation:** Write and maintain product requirements documents (PRDs), data contracts, business definitions, and usage guidance. Partner with Data Governance and engineering teams to document data structures, quality expectations, ownership, and refresh requirements.
* **Validate Data Products and Deliver Quality:** Use basic SQL and reporting tools to explore data, investigate discrepancies, and validate results. Prepare and execute user acceptance testing (UAT), coordinate business participation, document defects, and confirm fixes meet acceptance criteria.
* **Strengthen Stakeholder Alignment:** Communicate requirements, proposed designs, testing results, and product demonstrations to technical and business audiences. Keep partners informed of open questions, issues, and progress.
* **Identify Opportunities for Improvement:** Monitor product usage, performance, and user feedback to identify issues and opportunities to make data products more accurate, accessible, and useful.

**Who You'll Work With**
------------------------

You'll work closely with Reporting, Data Governance, and Data Product leads, business stakeholders, analysts, and data engineers to bring data products from discovery through delivery. This is a collaborative, cross-functional role where you'll help connect business priorities with technical execution, build shared understanding, and ensure the products we deliver are trusted and useful. You'll also have the opportunity to learn from experienced partners as you deepen your understanding of our data ecosystem and product practices.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* A college degree.
* At least two years of experience working alongside data or analytics teams in a business, analytical, technical, or product support capacity.
* Basic SQL skills, including the ability to query, filter, join, and summarize data.
* Experience working with databases or reporting and business intelligence tools.
* Ability to gather business requirements and translate them into clear, organized documentation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain data concepts to business audiences and communicate business needs to technical teams.
* A collaborative approach to working with stakeholders, analysts, and data engineers.
* Strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and the ability to organize work and follow through on open items.

**What Will Help You Thrive**
-----------------------------

* Hands-on experience in analytics, business intelligence, or data engineering.
* Experience writing user stories, development tickets, acceptance criteria, or product requirements documents.
* Experience supporting user acceptance testing or validating reports, datasets, or data pipelines.
* Familiarity with data governance concepts, including data quality, business definitions, ownership, lineage, and data contracts.
* Experience using tools for project tracking, documentation, or data cataloging.
* Curiosity about how data products are designed, developed, governed, and used to solve business problems.
* Comfort using AI tools to support discovery, requirements gathering, data product design, prototyping, and documentation, while validating outputs for accuracy and ensuring responsible data use.
* Experience designing or building AI agent workflows and automations to streamline tasks, connect tools or data sources, and support business processes.
* A proactive mindset, strong relationship-building skills, and the ability to navigate open questions and evolving requirements.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Business needs are clearly captured and translated into actionable requirements, user stories, and development tickets.
* Data products are well-documented, with clear definitions, ownership, usage guidance, and quality expectations that help business users understand and trust the data.
* Testing identifies issues early, discrepancies are resolved collaboratively, and delivered products meet agreed-upon acceptance criteria.
* Business and technical partners stay aligned through clear communication, thoughtful collaboration, and timely follow-through.
* Product usage and stakeholder feedback inform improvements that make data products more valuable, accessible, and effective.

---------------------------

### **Input Sourcing & Data Quality**

* Bring together data and information spread across multiple systems and communication platforms into one reliable source for planning.
* Make sure those sources stay connected and consistent, so every team works from the same accurate data.

### **Output Audit & Approval**

* Audit forecasts, purchase plans, inventory transfers and reporting against their sources on a weekly cadence.
* Catch stale data, unit mismatches, totals that don't reconcile and results that don't fit history.
* Rate each output as acceptable, acceptable with caveats, or not acceptable, and explain why.
* Report findings with the conclusion first, followed by what was checked and what needs attention.

### **Tool Improvement & Automation**

* Automate routine, repetitive work such as transfers, warehouse coordination and data hygiene.

Harris County Public Health (HCPH) includes a network of more than 1,100 public health professionals working together to improve health outcomes for the third most populous county in the United States. The successful candidate will build trusted relationships across the organization, collaborate with a variety of stakeholders, and influence the adoption of consistent data and analytics practices.

This is a highly collaborative role for someone who is curious, comfortable working through ambiguity, and motivated by solving business problems through data, relationships, and continuous improvement.

**This role will be located at our main campus in Wichita, Kansas.**

**What You Will Do**

  

* Partner with Project, Turnaround, and other business teams to understand their needs, challenges, and decision-making processes

* Degree in a Business, Analytics, Engineering, Technical, or related field, or relevant professional experience in lieu of a degree

* Experience collaborating with customers or cross-functional stakeholders to understand needs and develop solutions
* Experience communicating information, recommendations, or insights to stakeholders with different levels of technical knowledge
* Experience building relationships and influencing change or adoption without relying on direct authority
* Experience managing multiple priorities and determining where your work can create the most value

**What Will Put You Ahead**

  

* Experience developing dashboards, reports, visualizations, or other analytical tools used to support business decisions
* Experience with analytics and reporting tools such as Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Alteryx, or similar platforms
* Experience working with project, turnaround, maintenance, operations, industrial, or construction teams
* Experience facilitating conversations with customers to define problems, identify opportunities, and translate needs into analytical solutions

**Description**
---------------

**Job Overview**  
The Analyst Data and Reporting (HRIS) will provide day-to-day support for HR systems, including advanced reporting, troubleshooting and various analysis as well as resolving support issues by working directly with both internal and external customers. The incumbent will fulfill report requests for the Human Resources department and other business units. The incumbent will drive the successful delivery of accurate human capital metrics for the business and ensure data integrity for all HR systems. Develop and implement databases, data collection systems, data and predictive analytics and other strategies that optimize statistical efficiency and quality. The incumbent will drive the successful delivery of accurate human capital metrics for the business and ensure data integrity for all HR systems. The Analyst, Data and Reporting Analyst (HRIS) will also be responsible for documenting system processes and procedures and assist in the training of end-users.

**Position Description**

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**  
  
**Development**

* Develop and maintain standard reports, metrics and dashboards to support the needs of the business
* Automate, generate, analyze, and distribute recurring HR metrics and ad-hoc reports to the appropriate stakeholders
* Maintain, and respond to data and open records requests, etc.
* Design, write, maintain, and support a variety of reports or queries using appropriate reporting tools, including quarterly matrices; assist in the development of standard reports for ongoing customer needs
* Develop and maintain means for data and dashboards to be readily accessible to stakeholders
* Perform User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for all process and system updates and document testing results for director review
* Maintain data integrity in HR systems by conducting routine audits, analyzing and updating data where appropriate
* Document and maintain thorough processes and procedures related to data and reporting through creation of FAQs, standard operating procedures and job aids. Monitor all documentation and ensure accuracy of information
* Reconcile and update system fields and tables associated with business operations
* Recognize, follow and analyze trends in HR transactions to identify patterns, risks and opportunities for the business
* Research historical data and identify trends and present timely reports of how trends will influence and drive business decisions
* Routinely examine methodologies to processes to improve the transformation and curation of HR data and continuously improve predictive accuracy
* Mine and aggregate data from various sources (HRIS systems, Applicant tracking, Learning Management, Benefits Vendors, Engagement Survey Vendor, Exit Survey, etc.)
* Identify correlations and patterns in complicated datasets; validate and reconcile data; understand and explain variances
* Collaborate with HR colleagues, subject matter experts and/or stakeholders to identify reporting needs and leverage HRIS systems to provide data support and expand the HR reporting function
* Evaluate and automate processes, data sources and reports to improve the organization's ability to measure programs and outcomes
* Prepare presentation-ready reports that are visually appealing and easy to follow for all audience types
* Develop business solutions and connect workflows and applications with HCM and other databases

**Support**

* Train team members or stakeholders on procedures, processes or HR updates and in navigating through databases or dashboards
* Assist with overseeing position control, ensuring position, classification and organizational structures are recorded and related databases are administered and maintained
* Provide support and assistance in resolving complex HR data questions and issues before escalating to next level
* Participate in the development of department goals, objectives and systems
* Assist with implementation of system projects, enhancements/upgrades
* Provide ongoing assistance concerning continuous improvement of workflow processes
* Maintain and update HR SharePoint and website as needed

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

* None

------------------

**Qualification Requirements**  
  
*To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each of the above essential duties satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or abilities, required unless otherwise stated as preferred. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essentials functions.*

* Bachelor's degree in Math, Statistics, Computer Science, HR or related field
* Minimum of 2 years experience importing data for use in reporting software, spreadsheets, graphs, and flow charts
* Minimum of 3 years of combined experience in the following areas: report writing, data administration and analysis, HRIS, or similar system experience, and training
* Experience in Human Resources business operation preferred
* Demonstrated knowledge of Power BI
* Demonstrated knowledge in writing SQL queries for data analysis preferred
* Demonstrated knowledge of HCM System
* Proficiency in MS Office skills (e.g. Word, PowerPoint) with advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, vlookup, and other advanced Excel functions and formulas)
* Proficiency in problem analysis, issue resolution, planning and time management
* Excellent administrative and organizational skills with the proven ability to take initiative to complete assignments and responsibilities on time
* Excellent communication skills, both verbally and in writing
* Ability to manage multiple priorities at the same time
* Ability to work in a fast-paced office environment
* Ability to work independently and under minimal supervision
* Ability to maintain confidentiality information, professional demeanor under pressure, and effectively work with employees at all levels

* Support solution testing by reviewing test scenarios, validating results, and helping stakeholders assess whether requirements have been met

* Communicate findings, recommendations, risks, and decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences

* Contribute to change management, implementation planning, and the ongoing measurement of business outcomes

**Required Qualifications**

* Professional experience in business analysis or a related role

* Experience gathering, analyzing, documenting, and validating business requirements

* Ability to map business processes and identify gaps, dependencies, and opportunities for improvement

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to interpret information and develop evidence-based recommendations

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with diverse stakeholders

* Experience producing clear business analysis documentation, such as requirements, process flows, or user stories

* Ability to manage competing priorities, maintain attention to detail, and deliver work to agreed timelines

* Proficiency with common business productivity and documentation tools, such as Microsoft Office or Google Workspace

* Commitment to confidentiality, accuracy, and professional handling of business information

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in an agile environment and using tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps

* Familiarity with data analysis and visualization tools, such as Excel, SQL, Power BI, or Tableau

* Experience supporting software implementations, system integrations, or digital transformation initiatives

* Knowledge of change management practices, process improvement methods, or business analysis frameworks

* Relevant degree, professional certification, or equivalent practical experience in business analysis or a related discipline

* Location: Hybrid In Person Role, DMV Area

title: GTM Data Analyst
description:
Netic is the AI revenue engine for essential services who are the backbone of the American economy. **With $43M in funding from Founders Fund, Greylock, Hanabi, and Dylan Field who led our Series B, we helped our customers book hundreds of thousands of jobs across services industries in North America.** There are now companies operating entirely AI-first on Netic.

You’ll join our team with relentless builders from Scale, Databricks, HRT, Meta, MIT, Stanford, and Harvard in bringing frontier AI to the physical economy, where the problems are hard, the data is complex, and the impact is immediate and tangible.

**The role**
------------

You'll be Netic's first dedicated go-to-market data hire. Nobody owns our account and contact data end to end yet: you will. You'll define the data standards, build the models and checks that keep them accurate, and give the team a foundation for territories, routing, forecasting and commissions.

This is an analyst role with operational ownership. You'll spend as much time writing SQL and building models as you do fixing the processes that create bad data in the first place.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own the GTM data model: define account, contact and hierarchy standards (parent companies, multi-location operators, PE-backed roll-ups), required fields at each stage, and the rules for creating, matching and merging records.
* Build our total addressable market model: map every home services business by trade, geography and location count, score it, and keep it in sync with Salesforce.
* Design and run enrichment workflows that keep firmographics and decision-maker contacts current, and measure the coverage and accuracy of each data source.
* Define data quality metrics (duplicate rate, field completeness, match rate) and build the dashboards and alerts that catch bad data before it reaches a forecast or a commission statement.
* Maintain the data behind territory assignments and lead routing, and give Sales Ops the evidence to resolve ownership disputes.
* Run analyses that answer GTM questions: which segments convert, where coverage is thin, and which accounts we're missing.
* Automate recurring cleanup and validation with our Sales Systems engineer, so hygiene runs as a system instead of a project.

**What success looks like in year one**
---------------------------------------

* A documented standard for accounts, contacts and hierarchies that every team follows.
* A TAM model the sales team uses to plan territories and prioritize accounts.
* Data quality metrics tracked weekly, with duplicate rates and field gaps trending down.
* Recurring cleanup automated rather than done by hand.

**What you bring**
------------------

* 2+ years in sales operations, revenue operations, marketing operations or data analytics at a B2B company.
* Strong SQL and advanced Excel or Google Sheets; Python is a plus. You're comfortable building a model or analysis from raw, messy data.
* Hands-on Salesforce data experience (Data Loader, Workbench or a dedupe tool) and a solid grasp of the object model.
* A detail-first mindset. You notice when a number looks off and you chase it to the root cause.
* The ownership to define standards, not only follow them, and the documentation habits to make them outlast you.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience with ZoomInfo, Clay, Apollo, LeanData, Cloudingo or DemandTools.
* Familiarity with BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Hex) or a data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery).
* Experience using AI coding assistants to automate data work.

**Our values**

* Obsess over the customer
* Every second counts
* Sweat the details
* There are no blockers
* Be self-directed
* Seek and speak the truth
* Enjoy the ride

The BI Developer & Reporting Analyst designs, develops, and supports scalable reporting and analytics solutions that enable informed business and operational decision-making. description:
**Job Description**

**VICTAULIC**

**Spend Analytics & BI Specialist**

Corporate

Full-Time

Global Sourcing, Center of Excellence

Victaulic does not provide immigration sponsorship (e.g., H-1B, TN, or other work visa sponsorship) for this position. All applicants must be currently authorized to work in the applicable country on a full-time basis without the need for employer-sponsored immigration support now or in the future.

**ABOUT VICTAULIC**

Victaulic, headquartered in Easton, Pennsylvania, is the global leader in mechanical pipe joining solutions, delivering advanced technologies and engineering services to address complex piping challenges faced by engineers, site owners and contractors. Since 1919, our innovative solutions have improved construction productivity and reduced risks, ensuring projects are completed safely, on time, and within budget. With over 6,000 employees spanning 50+ locations worldwide, our teams are dedicated to delivering advanced technologies and engineering expertise that address real-world challenges across a wide range of industries.

Our sustainable solutions, made from high quality, graded scrap steel, promote circular construction by making piping systems infinitely reconfigured and minimizing environmental impact. Today, our high-quality products are used in more than 140 countries, supporting some of the world's most critical and prestigious structures.

**AN INDUSTRY LEADER WITH A HEART AS BIG AS ITS AMBITION AND INNOVATION**

At Victaulic, we're committed to constructing a better world for and with our people.

**Let's Build a Better World Together.**

Our commitment to our people is built on four pillars:

* We build from within.
* We stand behind our people.
* We foster an environment for constant learning.
* We engineer change for a more stable and sustainable world.

**YOUR IMPACT STARTS HERE**

We're looking for a Spend Analytics & BI Specialist to own the sourcing-analytics and spend-visibility capability for our Center of Excellence. You'll turn fragmented ERP and spend data into governed, decision-ready insight—centralized dashboards, supplier scorecards, savings tracking, and business-process analytics—so category managers and leadership work from a single source of truth with real-time visibility. In this technical individual-contributor role, you'll partner closely with category teams, Finance, and IT to steward spend taxonomy and data quality, surface cost-savings opportunities, and validate delivered savings.

**WHAT YOU'LL BUILD & OWN**

* Build and maintain Power BI (or equivalent) dashboards for spend, savings, supplier performance, and category KPIs, establishing refresh cadence and data-quality controls.
* Own and steward spend classification and taxonomy so category and leadership views are consistent and trustworthy.
* Analyze spend to surface consolidation, tail-spend, and cost-savings opportunities, and support category strategy with market, benchmarking, and TCO data.
* Assist Category Managers in developing should-cost and cost-model inputs that strengthen negotiations and value engineering.
* Own the savings tracker, reconcile with Finance for validated savings, and report against annual goals.
* Produce and distribute supplier performance scorecards on a standardized metric set and cadence.
* Partner with IT and Finance on data pipelines and integrity, and document methods and definitions.
* Train category teams on self-service analytics so insight scales beyond the COE.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Supply Chain, Engineering, Data/Information Systems, or a related field.
* 5–8 years of experience in procurement/spend analytics or data analytics.
* Advanced Excel and strong data-visualization skills (Power BI or Tableau), with comfort working with ERP spend data (SAP or equivalent).
* Working knowledge of spend classification, TCO/should-cost, and savings methodology.
* Ability to translate complex data into clear recommendations for stakeholders and leadership.

**WHAT SETS YOU APART**

* SQL experience.
* Experience with SAP Ariba, Coupa, or a spend-analytics platform (e.g., SpendHQ); Python or scripting for data prep.
* Industrial-manufacturing spend experience across direct and indirect categories.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

**Build A Better Career**

* Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives
* Career development programs and internal promotion pathways—we build from within
* Tuition reimbursement and continuous learning opportunities

**Build A Better Future**

* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
* Retirement savings plans with company match
* Life insurance and disability coverage

**Build A Better You**

* Paid time off, holidays, and flexible work arrangements where applicable
* Employee Assistance Programs (EAP) and wellness resources
* Inclusive, team-oriented culture where people look out for one another

**Build A Better World**

Join a company whose products contribute to a safer, more sustainable built environment every day.

**IMMIGRATION SPONSORSHIP**

Victaulic does not provide immigration sponsorship (e.g., H-1B, TN, or other work visa sponsorship) for this position. All applicants must be currently authorized to work in the applicable country on a full-time basis without the need for employer-sponsored immigration support now or in the future.

**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**

Victaulic is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EOE/M/F/Vets/Disabled) employer and welcomes all qualified applicants. Applicants will receive fair and impartial consideration without regard to race, gender, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, genetic data, or other legally protected status. (Background checks may be required as part of our pre-employment process).

**VICTAULIC STAFFING PARTNER COMMUNICATION POLICY**

All staffing agencies are strictly forbidden from directly contacting any Victaulic employees, except those within the Human Resources/Talent Acquisition team. All communications, inquiries and candidate submissions must be routed through Victaulic's Human Resources/Talent Acquisition team. Non-compliance with this policy may result in the suspension of partnership, cancellation of the current contract, and/or the imposition of a mandatory probation period before any future business can resume. Additionally, non-compliance may lead to a permanent ban on future business. This policy ensures a streamlined and compliant recruitment process.

**Let's Build a Better World Together.**

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Job Title:** **Data Analyst**

**Reports To:** **Chief Operating Officer**

**Department:** **Operations**

**Location: On-Site/Hybrid – Minimum of three (3) days onsite**

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Data Analyst translates operational, financial and program data into reliable insights that strengthen service delivery, organizational performance and person-centered outcomes at Somerville-Cambridge Elder Services. As the organization modernizes its technology and operations, transitions to a new brand and name, and launches its strategic planning process, the analyst connects data with the realities of delivering integrated, community-based services. The role requires understanding complex services; funding and reimbursement models; tracing workflows across teams and systems; investigating inconsistent information; and recommending practical improvements to workflows, controls, automation and outcomes.

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer and working closely with the fractional Chief Information Officer, CEO, Finance, Quality and Program leadership, the analyst develops reliable measures of access, service quality, compliance, productivity, revenue integrity and organizational performance. The role supports the 2030 strategic planning process, executive decision-making and Board oversight, particularly where systems do not readily integrate. The analyst provides analysis and recommendations, while designated operational, financial and technology leaders retain responsibility for decisions and implementation.

**Job Responsibilities and Performance Standards**

**Program Evaluation and Strategic Analysis**

* Support the design and implementation of evaluation frameworks to assess program efficiency, effectiveness, equity, service quality and person-centered outcomes.
* Partner with executive and program leaders to establish consistent key performance indicators (KPIs), baselines, targets and accountability measures aligned with the 2030 strategic plan.
* Conduct longitudinal, cross-program and comparative analyses to identify changes in demand, access, utilization, outcomes and organizational performance; translate findings into recommendations.
* Develop program scorecards for State Home Care, Community Choices, ECOP, SCO/One Care, Nutrition, AFC, Protective Services, housing and other services, sequencing delivery through the approved analytics workplan.
* Analyze referral-to-assessment-to-enrollment conversion, cycle times, withdrawals, service starts and census trends; distinguish service demand from process bottlenecks and data-quality problems.
* Evaluate caseload distribution, staffing capacity, visit completion, productivity and workflow constraints with the COO and program managers; recommend and measure improvements.
* Support environmental scanning, scenario analysis, growth planning and program redesign by connecting financial and operational trends to service delivery realities.

**Data Management, Visualization and Reporting**

* Develop, maintain and validate accessible dashboards, scorecards and executive reports using Power BI or comparable tools, SQL and advanced Excel.
* Map end-to-end workflows and data lineage across operational, clinical, financial and reporting systems; identify manual handoffs, duplicative entry, gaps in controls and opportunities for automation.
* Clean, reconcile and validate information from disparate or poorly integrated systems, including WellSky and other agency platforms; document data definitions, assumptions, limitations and version history.
* Partner with the CIO on data dictionaries, integration requirements, reporting standards, migration readiness and sustainable reporting processes; escalating infrastructure and security decisions to the CIO.
* Support state system re-procurement, replacement or implementation initiatives by documenting operational reporting needs, validating data conversion and interfaces, testing outputs and identifying continuity risks.
* Create repeatable data quality checks and exception reports, investigate anomalies before distribution and coordinate correction with designated source-system owners.
* Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve process controls and reduce manual reporting; evaluate whether changes deliver measurable benefits.

**Revenue Integrity and Cross-Functional Workflow Analysis**

* Partner with Finance, Operations and the CIO to trace data across service authorizations, encounters, vendor submissions, claims, denials, payments and operational reports, identifying mismatches and broken handoffs.
* Validate source-to-report consistency and develop exception analyses for missing, duplicate, rejected or inconsistent records; help teams isolate root causes and prioritize corrections.
* Design payer-, program- and service-level reporting on denials, unbilled activity, aging and recurring error patterns, clearly identifying data limitations and responsible owners.
* Recommend opportunities for system validation rules, workflow redesign, automation and stronger preventive controls; measure the effectiveness of implemented changes.
* Support cost-per-unit, utilization and program performance analysis with Finance using approved financial data, without assuming responsibility for accounting, billing or collections.

**Compliance, Accreditation and Outcomes Support**

* Support regulatory review and accreditation readiness through reliable datasets, evidence-based reports, compliance indicators and risk analysis for AGE, MassHealth, NCQA and other applicable bodies.
* Analyze required visits, assessments, documentation timeliness, record-review findings, incidents and corrective-action trends; distinguish confirmed findings from preliminary signals.
* Partner with Quality and program leaders to identify systemic issues, track remediation milestones and assess whether corrective actions improve performance.
* Support the development and maintenance of consumer experience, responsiveness and person-centered outcome measures, explaining the limitations of available data.

**Executive Partnership and Organizational Capacity Building**

* Prepare concise, decision-ready performance briefs for the CEO, COO, CIO, executive leadership and Board that explain trends, implications, root causes, recommended actions and follow-up owners.
* Collaborate across Operations, Finance, Clinical Integration, Quality and IT to translate complex business processes into practical data requirements and actionable improvements.
* Coach managers in interpreting performance measures, spotting exceptions and using data to improve service delivery; promote common definitions and consistent reporting practices.
* Maintain a transparent analytics request and prioritization process aligned with the COO/CIO-approved workplan; communicate progress, capacity constraints, dependencies and risks proactively.

**Other Duties**

* Perform other or related duties as assigned.

**INITIAL PERFORMANCE PRIORITIES (FIRST 30–180 DAYS):**

* **First 30 days:** inventory priority systems, reports, operational workflows, data owners and recurring discrepancies; propose a COO/CIO-approved analytics workplan.
* **By 60–90 days:** establish baseline reporting for the programs and measures prioritized in the approved workplan; document data definitions and limitations, validate source data, and identify initial trends, workflow gaps and improvement opportunities.
* **By 90–180 days:** implement an initial monthly enterprise performance scorecard covering agreed priority measures, with documented KPI definitions, repeatable validation controls and an issue/remediation tracking cadence; identify dependencies for expanding coverage and contribute data requirements and testing plans for technology modernization.

**PROFESSIONAL STANDARDS AND CONDUCT:**

* Critical thinking and curiosity ask how processes actually work, tests assumptions, investigates anomalies and challenges incomplete or inconsistent explanations.
* Problem-solving and agility adapt to changing priorities and imperfect systems; recommends practical, scalable solutions rather than simply identifying problems.
* Accountability and reliability: checks accuracy before publishing, meets deadlines, escalates material risks and closes the loop with stakeholders.
* Collaboration and communication builds trust across technical and nontechnical teams, explains findings clearly and respects operational ownership and decision rights.
* Mission and integrity demonstrate commitment to inclusive, person-centered community care, confidentiality and responsible use of sensitive information.
* In all interactions, aids in furthering SCES’s mission and commitment to an inclusive environment.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in data science, public policy, public health, statistics, computer science or a related field; master’s degree preferred.
* At least three years of experience in data analytics, evaluation or applied research in nonprofit, government or healthcare settings; five or more years preferred.
* Proficiency in SQL, advanced Excel and Power BI or a comparable visualization platform, such as Tableau; demonstrated ability to build, validate and maintain dashboards and reports.
* Working knowledge of relational databases, data models, data mining and segmentation techniques, with experience reconciling information across systems and documenting data definitions and quality controls.
* Experience with additional reporting packages, such as Business Objects, programming tools such as R or Python, or extract, transform and load (ETL) processes is preferred.
* Knowledge of applied statistics and experience using Excel or statistical tools to analyze datasets, explain trends and communicate analytical limitations.
* Experience with performance measurement frameworks, outcomes evaluation, and regulatory reporting.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting findings to executive-level audiences.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize deliverables in a fast-paced environment.
* Familiarity with accreditation and compliance data requirements (e.g., NCQA, CMS, EOHHS) is a plus.
* Familiarity with Massachusetts aging services, MassHealth/Medicaid and community-based care is strongly preferred.
* Must meet both CORI/SORI and public health screening requirements.
