title: Data Quality Analyst
description:
**About Imagine Worldwide**
---------------------------

All children have immense potential, but hundreds of millions don’t have access to the learning they need. Imagine Worldwide believes that every child should be empowered with the basic right to literacy and numeracy. We provide an innovative education technology solution and implementation model to the global literacy/numeracy learning crisis using the onebillion application and various toolkits and systems to support implementation. Our model is massively scalable, evidence-based, and can deliver foundational learning to millions of the most marginalized children.

Imagine Worldwide partners with governments, organizations, and communities to provide child-directed, tablet-based learning that is accessible, effective, and affordable. We are incorporated in California (United States) as a nonprofit organization, but operate in Sub-Saharan Africa through locally-registered entities in Malawi, Sierra Leone, and Tanzania. Learn more on our website.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

The Data Quality Analyst focuses on data quality across Imagine’s data ecosystem. The role proactively monitors data from devices, programme systems and field sources, builds and improves the checks that catch problems early, and investigates issues raised across the organisation. Where an issue requires deeper analysis, reporting changes or engineering work, the role provides its findings and works with the relevant team member to resolve it.

Imagine’s data covers learning activity from tablets in more than 1,500 schools, along with programme, operational and field data. Devices sync intermittently and sources don’t always agree, so checking data against what is happening in schools and in the field is central to the work.

The role reports to the Director of Analytics and works closely with the Data Scientist, who provides methodological support. It suits an analyst who enjoys tracing a problem back to its source and wants to keep developing in a small team. As they build context on Imagine’s data, the role takes on more ownership of the team’s data quality reporting and standards.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

The Data Analyst’s responsibilities fall into four pillars: data quality monitoring and improvement, data issue investigation, communicating findings, and analytical practice.

**Data Quality Monitoring and Improvement**

The role takes a proactive approach to data quality, identifying risks and gaps before they affect reporting or decision-making.

* Monitor the completeness, consistency and plausibility of data across Imagine’s sources, and identify issues independently.
* Design and implement data quality checks, and recommend where further checks or controls are needed across pipelines and source systems.
* Develop tooling and automated monitoring that make data quality issues visible, working with the Analytics Engineer on implementation within the platform.
* Reconcile figures across related sources and investigate discrepancies.
* Contribute to the team’s data quality reporting, rules and standards.

**Data Issue Investigation**

The role is the Analytics Team’s first point of investigation when data issues are identified, whether through monitoring or raised by colleagues.

* Investigate data issues and trace them to their root cause across source systems, pipelines and data models.
* Work with the Analytics Engineer, MEAL and country teams to resolve issues at source and confirm their resolution.
* Handle assigned data quality and data export requests from the Analytics Team’s request process.
* Document findings and hand over issues that require deeper analysis, reporting changes or engineering work to the relevant team member.
* Support the team’s data quality incident process by providing the evidence needed for decisions.

**Communicating Findings**

* Write concise summaries of data issues and investigations, covering the cause, the impact and the recommended action.
* Report on the state of data quality to the Analytics Team and, where appropriate, to the teams that own the source data.
* Use clear charts and tables to show the scope and impact of issues.
* State data limitations plainly, so that figures are not over-interpreted when shared further.

**Analytical Practice**

Analysis is only useful to a small team if others can check it, reuse it and build on it.

* Keep checks and analyses reproducible, using version-controlled code and notebooks that someone else could rerun and arrive at the same result.
* Follow the Analytics Team’s standards for code, documentation and data use, and contribute to improving them as the team grows.
* Use the team’s shared data models and agreed metric definitions as the starting point for analysis, and flag where they fall short rather than working around them quietly.
* Ask for review of methods and conclusions from the Data Scientist and Director of Analytics, and give constructive review on colleagues’ work in return.
* Build a working knowledge of Imagine’s data, programmes and operating contexts, so that analyses reflect how the programme actually runs on the ground.
* Handle sensitive data responsibly, in line with Imagine’s data governance and privacy policies.

**Requirements**
----------------

The qualifications below are grouped by importance. Core requirements are needed to do the role from the start. Strongly preferred skills shorten the time it takes to become effective with Imagine’s data. Advantageous experience adds value but is not expected.

**Education**

* A bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, Computer Science or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Experience**

* At least 3 years in a data analyst or closely related quantitative role.
* Experience monitoring, validating or reconciling data, and tracing issues back to their source.
* Experience working with imperfect real-world data, such as missing records, inconsistent sources or late-arriving data, and explaining how those issues affect a result.
* Experience building automated checks or reports that others rely on.
* Experience communicating findings in writing to non-technical readers.
* Experience working with remote teams across multiple countries and time zones.
* Experience in the non-profit, international development or social sector is an advantage but not a requirement.

**Technical Skills: Core**

* Strong SQL, including joins, aggregations and window functions across large tables.
* Proficiency in at least one key programming language (such as Python) for automation, data analysis, and reproducible research.
* Data profiling and validation techniques, including completeness, consistency and plausibility checks.
* Applied statistics for identifying anomalies, including distributions, outliers and trends.
* Clear data visualisation.

**Technical Skills: Strongly Preferred**

* Querying analytical or columnar databases such as ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake or Redshift.
* Data quality testing frameworks such as dbt tests, Great Expectations or Soda.
* Reproducible workflows using notebooks and Git.

**Technical Skills: Advantageous**

* An understanding of data pipelines and how a dbt-modelled data warehouse is structured.
* Education, programme monitoring or field survey data.
* Field data collection tools such as CommCare, ODK or KoboToolbox.
* BI tools such as Apache Superset, Metabase or Power BI.
* Spreadsheet tools for sharing data with stakeholders.

  

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

Salary is competitive and commensurate with experience.

**Location**
------------

The Data Analyst must be based in Africa. The role will frequently collaborate and coordinate with operations teams across Africa, the US, and the UK.

This is a full-time remote position; the role can be based anywhere in Africa with reliable internet access and alignment with core working hours across time zones. If a file contains two items (e.g., a cover letter and writing sample), it must be labeled as such. Applications that do not follow this instruction will not be considered, even if all requested items are included.

WHO YOU ARE:  
TWC’s Information Innovation & Insight (I/3) Division is seeking a creative, experienced, and motivated Data Analyst III to spearhead critical data projects focused on program integrity and fraud prevention in Unemployment Insurance (UI) and Child Care and Early Learning (CCEL). We are looking for a forward-thinking individual who not only executes tasks but also works proactively to identify efficient methods to uncover anomalies, detect fraudulent patterns, and protect agency resources. The Data Analyst III will learn quickly, value public service, and pursue analytical work to unlock the power of data to improve TWC's services for Texas employers, individuals, families, and communities.

The Data Analyst III will work with the Unemployment Insurance, Program Integrity, and Child Care (UIPIC) team, which has eight members. The UI program is designed to help support Texans who lose their jobs through no fault of their own until they can find new employment. The team’s program integrity work is aimed at defending the UI trust fund and Texas childcare system against fraud. Meanwhile, the team helps TWC’s CCEL Division strategically distribute funding and plan subsidized Child Care supports for parents and guardians who are working or looking for work. Members of the UIPIC team operate collaboratively in an environment that encourages cross-training and peer mentorship. They frequently interact with TWC’s Fraud Deterrence and Compliance Monitoring (FDCM) Division on joint initiatives. Staff are mostly self-directed and produce high-quality research and evaluation work to solve system problems and build better fraud detection and fund allocation systems.

The Data Analyst III will work under general supervision with moderate latitude for the use of initiative, creativity, innovation, and independent judgment. Candidates must have excellent active listening skills, be able to deliver constructive feedback, and be master communicators who can distill complex concepts into clear, actionable insights for diverse audiences.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:  
Perform moderately complex to complex (journey-level) data analysis and data research work. Work involves conducting detailed analysis of, and extensive research on, data; providing results; and monitoring and implementing data quality. As a Data Analyst III in this specialized role, you will perform data analysis work from gathering and managing large datasets to identifying anomalies targeted at fraud detection and risk mitigation. Your work will generate crucial insights into program vulnerabilities, directly inform agency leadership, and support complex investigations involving sensitive law enforcement data.

YOU WILL BE TRUSTED TO:  

* Develop, implement, and optimize databases, data collection systems, and data analytics techniques;
* Collaborate closely with internal investigative units and external law enforcement partners to analyze sensitive data, trace fraudulent activities, and support ongoing investigations;
* Conduct multiple simultaneous tasks and prepare ad hoc analyses and reports on short timeframes;
* Formulate and deploy methods for mitigating and correcting data entry, integrity, and collection issues to prevent exploitation;
* Present, interpret, and meaningfully contextualize data for technical and nontechnical audiences;
* Prepare and present concise, comprehensive technical reports that provide clear, audience-appropriate explanations of investigative findings and risk assessments;
* Maintain strict compliance with data security protocols and handle confidential law enforcement data with the highest level of integrity and security;
* Demonstrate proficiency in computer programming and data analytic software use (e.g., SQL, Python, R);
* Commit to continuous professional development to cultivate technical skills and program knowledge; and
* Perform other work duties as assigned and required to cultivate the agency’s programs.

YOU QUALIFY WITH:  

* Two years of full-time experience in data science, business analytics, computer science, computer information systems, management information systems, accounting, finance, mathematics, statistics, economics, or a related field.
* Relevant academic credits may be applied toward experience qualifications for this position.

YOU ARE A GREAT FIT WITH:  

* Graduation from an accredited four-year college or university with major coursework in data science, business analytics, computer science, computer information systems, management information systems, accounting, finance, mathematics, statistics, economics, or a related field is generally preferred.
* Knowledge of SQL, Python and/or R.
* Training and/or experience in applying descriptive and inferential statistical techniques for business and economic decision making, including measures of central tendency/dispersion; probability distributions; sampling distributions; confidence intervals; hypothesis testing; simple linear regression; and correlation analysis.
* Training and/or experience in additional analytical techniques, such as forecasting; general and generalized linear models; nonparametric statistical hypothesis testing; hierarchical models; and interactive data visualization.

title: Real Estate Data Lead Analyst
description:
The Real Estate Data Lead Analyst reports to the Real Estate Strategy & Systems Senior Manager and serves as the primary owner of enterprise real estate data assets. The role is responsible for developing a complete understanding of where real estate data resides, how it is created and updated, which systems are authoritative sources of record, and how data flows across applications, integrations, databases, and analytical platforms. The position acts as the principal liaison between business and process owners, Enterprise Architecture, Data Engineering, application teams, implementation partners, and reporting teams to translate business needs into clear data requirements and ensure that trusted, governed, and timely data is delivered as expected.

### **ESSENTIAL DUTIES:**

The position includes, but is not limited to, the following essential job duties, responsibilities and requirements:

  

* Own and steward enterprise real estate data assets across the real estate lifecycle, ensuring clear business definitions, ownership, authorized use, documentation, quality, lineage, update cadence, and ongoing fitness for purpose.
* Maintain a comprehensive understanding of the real estate data landscape, including where data originates, systems of record, data owners and stewards, critical data elements, dependencies, transformations, integrations, and how data moves across enterprise applications, databases, and platforms.
* Partner with business and process owners to define data requirements, translating business needs, processes, and rules into clear data definitions, defined source-of-record, data structures, transformation and integration requirements, delivery expectations, and reconciliation criteria.
* Serve as the primary liaison between business and technical teams, including Real Estate stakeholders, Enterprise Architecture, Data Engineering, application teams, reporting and analytics teams, vendors, and implementation partners, ensuring data requirements are clearly understood, delivered, validated, and sustained.
* Establish and maintain data governance, quality, and documentation, including data dictionaries, metadata, lineage, source-to-target mappings, critical data elements, validation rules, completeness and timeliness standards, stewardship responsibilities, access requirements, and reconciliation procedures.
* Ensure data is reliably available to authorized consumers through the appropriate systems and platforms, within required timeframes, and in the defined structure and format needed to support business processes, decision-making, reporting, and analysis. Work with Data Engineering and application teams to define and validate data pipelines, integrations, interfaces, APIs, batch processes, synchronization schedules, delivery mechanisms, and operational ownership.

* Use SQL and enterprise data platforms to validate, reconcile, and troubleshoot data, including SQL Server, Databricks, and Snowflake. Develop and maintain appropriate queries, scripts, tables, views, and other approved data structures needed to investigate issues, validate data, and confirm that data is delivered according to defined requirements.
* Support data-related implementations, integrations, migrations, and system changes by defining and validating data profiling, cleansing, conversion, source-to-target mapping, testing, reconciliation, acceptance, cutover, and production requirements, and coordinating with delivery teams responsible for engineering and execution.
* Monitor and resolve data-quality and delivery issues, investigating discrepancies and root causes, coordinating remediation, and escalating material risks affecting business processes, integrations, downstream consumers, reporting, or analytics.
* Support the enterprise real estate technology ecosystem and continuous improvement, including Kalibrate, Mendix, Construction Management platform, SQL Server, Databricks, Snowflake, and related applications, by ensuring data ownership, quality, integration, governance, delivery, and lifecycle expectations are clearly defined and maintained.
* Perform additional tasks, as assigned.

### **JOB REQUIREMENTS:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree required. Major in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, Real Estate, or a related field.
* Minimum of 3+ years of experience in data analysis, data management, business analysis, data governance, or a similar role supporting enterprise data environments.
* Strong SQL proficiency, with experience querying, validating, reconciling, and troubleshooting data across enterprise databases and platforms.
* Working knowledge of data governance, data quality, data lineage, metadata, data ownership, and source-of-record concepts.
* Experience translating business and process needs into clear data requirements, definitions, mappings, and validation criteria.
* Strong understanding of data integration and data flow concepts, including APIs, interfaces, pipelines, batch processes, and data movement across systems.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Comfortable working independently and collaboratively with business stakeholders, technical teams, vendors, and cross-functional partners.

Preferred Qualifications

  

* Experience with enterprise data, analytics, and reporting platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, SQL Server, Alteryx, Power BI, and related technologies
* Experience supporting data integrations, migrations, system implementations, testing, reconciliation, and production deployment.
* Experience with enterprise data governance or data quality programs.
* Experience with real estate, construction, development, or related business processes.
* Experience with geospatial, real estate or construction technology platforms such as Kalibrate, Mendix, Etc.

* Experience working in an enterprise environment with Data Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, application, and reporting/analytics teams.

As a Management Analyst within OCFS, you will play a pivotal role in both the successful management of the many social service programs and the operations of the OCFS Data and Analytics Unit. You will provide monthly, quarterly, annual and ad-hoc data and reporting to both OCFS internal and external customers, DHHS executive management, the State Legislature and the federal government. You will work closely with program management in the development and distribution of data and reporting of OCFS programs. You will also be responsible for developing and supporting management level data and the reporting for evaluation of OCFS practice improvement measures. You will have a direct role in state and federal audits and the support of OCFS processes to meet federal requirements. You will be responsible for receiving new data requests, the timely processing of data requests, providing analysis on data outcomes and creating clear and concise reports.

As a Management Analyst your core duties will include:

• Providing a programmatic perspective in the creation of data sets for the Office of Child and Family Services.

• Producing, reviewing, and auditing all required reporting according to time expectations.

• Reviewing, revising, updating and/or developing OCFS management and performance outcome reports.

• Producing, analyzing, monitoring, and auditing child and family services and child protection data for use by OCFS, DHHS, other State Departments, the Maine State Legislature and Federal partners.

• Collaborating with colleagues and partner agencies in collecting and discussing performance data and feedback to identify problems and support the creation and implementation of solutions that improve quality of service delivery.

• Monitoring and reporting on program performance to ensure overall conformity to established policies and quality standards.

• Monitoring and reporting on changes to federal requirements.

• Preference will be given to candidates with prior experience using PL/SQL, Salesforce, Einstein Analytics and Tableau.

1. The ability to ensure program integrity through the consistent interpretation of policy, procedures, and regulations.

2. A demonstrated ability to complete multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment with minimal supervision.

3. A record consistently demonstrating strong personal attributes and leadership skills including professional integrity, self-organizational skills, and effective decision making and communication skills.

4. A demonstrated ability to analyze and produce data reports.

5. A demonstrated ability to clearly communicate critical information effectively and manage consumers’ responses and feedback.

2. Describe your experience with information extracts and the production of reports. Please provide a sample report.

3. Describe your abilities and experience in gathering, assembling, calculating or analyzing and drawing valid conclusions on data.

* Provide the Head of Service with concise weekly and monthly analysis of significant exceptions, business impact, open actions, adverse trends, and recommended priorities
* Partner with Accounting/Finance to provide validated warranty expense, accrual or reserve inputs, recovery trends and opportunities, cost drivers, and variance analysis while Accounting/Finance retains responsibility for accounting judgments and financial approvals

**Field Quality & Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Monitor early field performance and recurring product, component, installation, service-readiness, and customer-feedback themes for new and existing products

The designated Product Safety, Legal, Engineering, Service, and executive authorities confirm formal reportability, stop-sale, field-action, recall, regulatory-filing, containment, and corrective-action decisions

* Coordinate routine warranty and field-insight information exchange with Truma Group Quality and Service; escalate official positions, resource commitments, product-safety concerns, and significant brand, legal, regulatory, or customer risk
* Own the drafting and lifecycle coordination of written technical and service communications—including technical bulletins, Service Alerts, warranty notices, dealer and service-partner instructions, frequently asked questions, and internal guidance—from fact gathering through cross-functional review, approval, publication, distribution, revision control, and archiving. The designated functional authorities approve technical conclusions, product-safety or regulatory statements, policy positions, and external commercial commitments before release

**Decision Rights**

Engineering and Product Management own technical conclusions and product changes; Operations and Supply Chain own execution, supplier management, inventory, and process changes; Sales leaders own commercial commitments; and Accounting/Finance owns accounting judgments and financial approvals.

**Position Requirements:**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in business analytics, engineering technology, quality, supply chain, business administration, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant education and demonstrated experience will be considered
* Experience: Five or more years of progressive experience in warranty analytics or administration, service operations, field quality, customer care analytics, technical service, or a related function supporting technical or durable products
* Analytical & Financial Capability: Advanced ability to reconcile, classify, analyze, visualize, and interpret data; identify patterns and outliers; quantify customer and financial impact; and communicate assumptions and limitations. Strong Excel capability required; Power BI or similar visualization experience preferred

**Position Summary**

The Recreational Fisheries Data Analyst is responsible for ongoing implementation of state conduct of Marine Recreational Information Program (MRIP) surveys on the Atlantic coast, including the Access Point Intercept Angler Survey (APAIS) and the For-hire Telephone Survey (FHTS). The incumbent provides program support to partner agencies conducting MRIP surveys from Georgia through Maine and acts as a liaison between the Atlantic Coastal Cooperative Statistics Program (ACCSP) partners conducting MRIP surveys. In addition, the incumbent will support other aspects of the ACCSP program and perform related duties as the ACCSP evolves. ACCSP utilizes Oracle and SAS software for data storage and dissemination. See ACCSP's website (www.accsp.org) for comprehensive information about the program.

**Duties**

* Ensures daily aspects of recreational survey components run properly, including state maintenance of MRIP Site registry and vessel directory, perform or upload survey draws, track assignment completion and work with states on data submission and data entry issues.
* Coordinates annual, centralized training of field staff and tracks and field staff training/proficiency as necessary
* Works with Program Partners and ACCSP staff to resolve recreational survey implementation issues
* Coordinates activities between states and NOAA Fisheries
* Responsible for data capture and validation software maintenance
* Develop and maintain data handling programs in SAS and Oracle, including documentation
* Load recreational data into ACCSP databases (e.g., assignments and estimates)
* Works with ACCSP technical committees in guiding the evolution of ACCSP data collection standards
* Follows established quality control/quality assurance protocols, including confidentiality of all data.
* Raises survey implementation and data quality issues to Recreational Program Team Lead for resolution
* Performs additional duties as required as the ACCSP evolves.
* Performs all activities according to Commission policies and procedures.

**Supervision**

The Recreational Data Analyst reports to the ACCSP Deputy Director of Recreational Fisheries Data in collaboration with the ACCSP Director as appropriate.

**Work Environment**

The Recreational Data Analyst will work in the offices of the Atlantic States Marine Fisheries Commission, in Arlington, Virginia. The position will require some overnight travel to attend various meetings with fisheries constituents and ACCSP Partners, primarily along the Atlantic coast.

**Work Schedule**

The typical work schedule is Monday–Friday, 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Flexible workdays and hours and occasional telework may be approved by the supervisor based on operational needs.

**Employment Classification**

This is a full-time, salaried position eligible for participation in the Commission's benefit program. The position is classified as exempt from overtime under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA), provided the applicable salary and duties requirements are met.

**Training and Certifications**

No specific professional certifications or licenses are required. Position-specific training may include fisheries survey protocols, data management systems, data confidentiality, and quality assurance procedures, as determined by the supervisor.

**Qualifications**

A graduate degree in fisheries science, marine biology, or related field. Experience and knowledge of Atlantic coast recreational fisheries surveys, related data collection programs, and data management using relational databases (such as Oracle) is highly desirable. Proven writing and speaking skills, communication, coordination and interpersonal skills should be demonstrated. Must be eligible to work in the United States.

You will turn construction project data into new business. Each day you will review new and updated projects on Dodge Construction Network and similar platforms, identify the ones that need our trades, find the general contractors, construction managers and subcontractors on them, and reach out to get NCCC on their bid list. You own the top of our sales funnel: finding the project, finding the people, and making the first contact. You report directly to the Managing Partner.

* Filter for projects that fit our trades: structural steel buildings needing SFRM or intumescent fireproofing, buildings needing spray insulation, and industrial facilities needing coatings, linings or blasting.

description:
**Company Description**

**Redica Systems** is the Intelligence Cloud for life sciences, transforming regulatory complexity into connected, proactive intelligence. Redica's platform helps the world's leading Pharmaceutical and MedTech companies stay inspection-ready, manage supplier risk, and keep pace with evolving global regulations. Built on the Redica Catalyst Platform and powered by Redica ID, Redica unifies the industry's most complete regulatory and inspection datasets, sourced from hundreds of global health authorities, into trusted intelligence for quality and regulatory teams. The Redica Intelligence Cloud brings data together to anticipate risk, accelerate compliance, and enable smarter, faster decisions across the enterprise.

More information is available at redica.com.

 **Job Description**

Redica Systems is looking for an Associate Data Analyst to develop customer-facing reports and dashboards using our regulatory intelligence data.

You'll translate customer requests into clear reporting requirements, work with data covering inspections, observations, warning letters, and enforcement actions, and present findings through dashboards, executive reports, and compelling data storytelling.

We're looking for someone who's analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable using AI to improve how they work. Just as important is a practical, down-to-earth approach and the ability to communicate clearly with customers and colleagues.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Translate customer reporting requests into precise, scoped queries using Redica tools, including Sigma, Claude, and Redica MCP, to identify and extract the right underlying data.
* Build, customize, and publish customer-facing reports, including workbooks, data elements, and visualizations tailored to each customer’s needs.
* Own the full report lifecycle, from intake and data identification through build, QA, proofing, and delivery.
* Interpret and validate data outputs for accuracy before any customer-facing delivery. This is not a “pull and send” role; judgment about data quality and relevance is required.
* Navigate regulatory intelligence data, including FDA enforcement actions, Form 483 observations, warning letters, and inspection records, to answer customer-specific questions through structured reporting.
* Manage multiple concurrent customer deliverables with accuracy and on-time delivery.

**About You**

* **Business Insight:** You understand customer reporting needs and how accurate regulatory intelligence data helps customers answer business-critical questions. You can connect data outputs to the customer’s underlying need, not just the literal request.
* **Manages Complexity:** You break down ambiguous reporting requests into clear steps, including data identification, query logic, report building, QA, and delivery. You can work through complex regulatory datasets without losing accuracy or structure.
* **Decision Quality:** You use data, context, and sound judgment to validate outputs, identify anomalies, and confirm that the final result answers the question being asked. You know when to escalate unclear, incomplete, or questionable results.
* **Collaboration & Influence:** You work effectively with internal teams to clarify requests, resolve data questions, and deliver accurate customer-ready work. You communicate clearly and help keep deliverables moving without unnecessary back-and-forth.
* **Tech Savvy:** You are comfortable working with BI tools, structured data, SQL, AI-assisted tools, and analytics workflows. You learn new systems quickly and use technology to improve accuracy, speed, and quality of work.
* **Engaged:** You share our values and possess the essential competencies needed to thrive at Redica, as outlined here: https://redica.com/company

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree in data analytics, business analytics, information systems, life sciences, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 1–3 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting, data operations, or a related role.
* Hands-on experience building reports, workbooks, data elements, or visualizations in a cloud BI or analytics tool, such as Sigma, Tableau, Looker, or Power BI; Sigma experience is strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of SQL, including the ability to write, review, and troubleshoot queries against structured data.
* Experience using AI-assisted tools or natural language data interfaces to support data exploration, query development, or analysis.
* Experience producing accurate, polished work product for internal stakeholders or external customers.

  
**Additional Information**

Top Pharmaceutical Companies, Food Manufacturers, MedTech Companies, and Service Firms from around the globe rely on Redica Systems to mine and process government inspection, enforcement, and registration data. This enables them to quantify risk signals from their suppliers, identify market opportunities, benchmark against peers, and prepare for the latest inspection trends.

Our data and analytics have been cited by major media outlets, including MSNBC, *The Wall Street Journal*, and *The Boston Globe*.

description:
**Turn Data into Decisions That Support Families**

At Together for Youth, we believe children and families do best when the people and systems around them work together.

As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you’ll help our teams understand what their data is telling them and use that knowledge to strengthen the work we do with youth and families. **Description**

At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd  
  
**About the Global Environment Facility (GEF)**  
  
The Global Environment Facility (GEF) is a multilateral financial mechanism created in 1991 to provide grant and concessional funds to recipient countries for projects and programs that address biodiversity loss, climate change mitigation and adaptation, degradation of international waters, land and forests, ozone depletion, elimination or reduction of persistent organic pollutants and mercury, all within the framework of sustainable development. Over the past three decades, the GEF has provided more than $27 billion in financing, primarily as grants, and mobilized another $155 billion for country-driven priority projects.  
  
The GEF unites 186 countries in partnership with international institutions, civil society organizations (CSOs), and the private sector to address global environmental issues while supporting national sustainable development initiatives. An independently operating financial organization, GEF is the designated financial mechanism for six multilateral environmental conventions: The Convention on Biological Diversity (UNCBD), the Stockholm Convention on Persistent Organic Pollutants (POPs), the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC), UN Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD), Minamata Convention on Mercury, and Agreement on Marine Biological Diversity of Areas Beyond National Jurisdiction (BBNJ).  
  
The GEF Secretariat, construed for administrative purposes as a Vice-Presidential Unit (VPU) within the World Bank, has over 100 professional and administrative and client support staff.  
  
In 2023, the GEF established the Global Biodiversity Framework Fund (GBFF) in response to decisions taken at the 15th Conference of the Parties (COP) to the Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD). The GBFF is part of the GEF family of funds and has its own governance arrangements and project cycle that differ from other GEF funds. In June 2023, the GEF Council approved the arrangements to establish the GBFF and its Programming Directions. The GBFF establishment decision was ratified at the seventh GEF Assembly in August 2023, and the fund was launched. The GBFF Council is its governing body and has been meeting twice a year since February 2024.  
  
To date, the GBFF has programmed $362.1 million for 82 projects across 87 countries, supporting the achievement of the targets of the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework (KMGBF).  
  
**Duties and Accountabilities**  
  
The GEF Secretariat is seeking to recruit a Data Analyst to join the GEF’s Division on MEAs and Funds, which manages the GEF engagements with six MEAs and the family of funds, including the GBFF. The candidate is expected to support the GBFF's results management, portfolio monitoring, and strategic analytics through the rigorous analysis of qualitative and quantitative data and information, including data visualization. The Data Analyst will play a key role in assessing and monitoring the GBFF portfolio, generating analytical insights to inform programming and decision-making, advancing the GBFF elements of the GEF-9 Country Engagement Strategy, and supporting the implementation of the GBFF Resource Mobilization Strategy. The Data Analyst is expected to have a solid understanding of the GBFF Programming Directions, GBFF Results framework, and of the GEF mission more broadly, and will work with staff across the GBFF team and the MEAs and Funds team, as well as relevant internal and external partners, to deliver timely and quality analytical contributions.  
  
Specific responsibilities and deliverables would include:  
  

* Carry out assessments and analysis of the GBFF portfolio, including along the portfolio-level targets, contributions to the GBFF Action Areas and KMGBF targets, regional and Agency distribution of programming, in addition to any other needed categorization, and regularly update portfolio information.
* Analyze results based on GBFF indicators and assess portfolio-level impact as projects move into implementation. Generate relevant analytical insights to help inform portfolio monitoring and management, and for future programming.
* Spearhead innovative use of data and analytics to build powerful narratives and support the team on their use, including preparing presentations to effectively communicate these insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Contribute to the portfolio and programming analytics for GBFF Council documents, the UNCBD COP reports, and other internal and external purposes.
* Engage with the GEF Portal team to ensure that GBFF data are accurate and accessible and that updates requested by the GBFF team are addressed. Develop familiarity and expertise in navigating, extracting and sorting GBFF programming related data and information in the GEF Portal.
* Contribute to the roll-out of the GBFF- and Division-relevant elements of the GEF-9 Country Engagement Strategy (CES), including through analytical inputs and the development of GBFF-specific materials for Extended Constituency Workshops (ECWs), as well as other strategic outreach activities, and in coordination with colleagues across the GEF Secretariat.
* Provide analytical support for the implementation of the GBFF Resource Mobilization Strategy, including development of analytical products and briefing materials, and presentations, and analysis of biodiversity finance flows. Also contribute to the development of the family of funds resource mobilization strategy and implementation, collaborating with relevant colleagues.
* Contribute to organization and logistical support for GEF engagement at the UNCBD COP as well as events/meetings organized by the GBFF team and the Division.
* Carry out any additional tasks requested by the Manager of the MEAs and Funds division, and/or by the GEF Programs Director.

**Selection Criteria**

* A bachelor’s or master’s degree with 2 years of experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* At least two (2) years of experience in data analysis and project cycle management, preferably working in an international organization in the context of environmental or development finance. Demonstrated experience in biodiversity and ecosystem management is preferred.
* Full proficiency in the use of Excel is required - proficiency in related statistical and presentational software will be a plus.
* Ability to think analytically, strategically, and programmatically. Must be able to work independently on complex tasks.
* The ability to collate, manage, and analyze complex and interrelated datasets, and familiarity with artificial intelligence applications.
* Well-organized, self-motivated, highly efficient, and dependable individual, with a demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, work under tight deadlines, and operate effectively in situations of high demands and pressure.
* Outstanding interpersonal skills to work effectively across a multicultural organization and with external clients as needed.
* Proficiency in the use of PowerPoint, as well as other visualization and digital tools. Demonstrated ability to transform complex data analytics into compelling presentations, infographics, and visualizations would be a plus.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to present and summarize ideas clearly, methodically, and concisely. Spanish/French language skills are an advantage.

  
*This role provides support to a Financial Intermediary Fund (FIF). Roles funded by a FIF are subject to the WBG Staff Directives and Procedures. Additionally, the FIF's governance framework and funding are also relevant to this role.*  

As the World Bank Group continues to evolve, we value candidates who:

* Demonstrate the ability to collaborate effectively across teams, disciplines, cultures, and institutional boundaries.
* Responsibly leverage digital and AI-enabled tools to enhance productivity, learning, and decision-making.
* Bring experience working in fragile, conflict-affected, and violent (FCV) contexts and are encouraged to highlight relevant experience in their application materials, where applicable.

**WBG Culture Attributes:**

1. Sense of urgency: Anticipate and quickly respond to the needs of internal and external stakeholders.  
2. Thoughtful risk-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact.
  
3. Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results.

World Bank Group Core Competencies

*The World Bank Group offers comprehensive benefits, including a retirement plan; medical, life and disability insurance; and paid leave, including parental leave, as well as reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities.*

description:
Analista de Datos

Data Analyst

Horario

Lunes a viernes, de 7:00 a. m. a 3:00 p. m.

Resumen del puesto

El/la Analista de Datos es responsable de crear, evaluar y presentar al área administrativa reportes clínicos, operacionales y financieros del centro de salud. El centro está financiado bajo la Sección 330 de la Ley de Servicios de Salud Pública (Health Center Program de HRSA). Esta posición tiene un rol principal en la preparación, validación y sometimiento del Uniform Data System (UDS) anual.

La persona no solo generará los reportes, sino que también evaluará los resultados e identificará tendencias, brechas y riesgos. Además, presentará hallazgos y recomendaciones a la gerencia para apoyar la toma de decisiones, el cumplimiento con HRSA y el mejoramiento de calidad. Deberá asegurar que la información sea precisa, completa, oportuna y que se maneje conforme a las políticas de privacidad y seguridad.

Deberes y responsabilidades esenciales

Gestión y calidad de datos

Extraer, limpiar, integrar y validar datos de los sistemas institucionales: expediente médico electrónico, facturación, citas, recursos humanos y finanzas.

Identificar datos incompletos, duplicados o inconsistentes, y coordinar las correcciones con las áreas responsables.

Desarrollar y mantener bases de datos, diccionarios de datos y procedimientos de recolección estandarizados.

Asegurar la confidencialidad e integridad de la información, conforme a HIPAA y a las políticas internas.

Reporte UDS (Sección 330)

Coordinar y preparar el reporte UDS anual de HRSA. Esto incluye las tablas de perfil de pacientes, personal y utilización, medidas de calidad clínica, resultados de salud, costos e ingresos.

Extraer y validar los datos del expediente médico electrónico y de los sistemas de facturación y de recursos humanos conforme al UDS Manual vigente, así como las definiciones de paciente, visita y personal que establece HRSA.

Realizar revisiones preliminares y de mitad de año de las medidas UDS para identificar a tiempo brechas y errores de documentación.

Responder a los señalamientos de revisión (edits) de HRSA y de su revisor UDS, y documentar las explicaciones y correcciones hasta la aprobación final.

Comparar los resultados UDS con años anteriores, con las metas del centro y con los promedios estatales y nacionales de HRSA.

Apoyar los datos requeridos para Service Area Competition (SAC), Budget Period Progress Report (BPR), Operational Site Visits (OSV) y otros reportes de HRSA.

Creación, evaluación y presentación de reportes

Crear reportes periódicos (mensuales, trimestrales y anuales) y especiales sobre pacientes atendidos, encuentros, productividad de proveedores, acceso, mezcla de pagadores, calidad clínica y desempeño financiero.

Evaluar cada reporte: interpretar los resultados, identificar variaciones, tendencias y riesgos, y determinar sus posibles causas.

Presentar los hallazgos al área administrativa (gerencia, finanzas, operaciones, calidad y Junta de Directores, según aplique), con resúmenes ejecutivos, gráficas y recomendaciones de acción.

Dar seguimiento a las acciones recomendadas y medir su efecto en los indicadores.

Diseñar y mantener tableros (dashboards) e indicadores clave de desempeño (KPI) para la gerencia y los programas.

Analizar tendencias en utilización, denegaciones, reclamaciones, ingresos, costos y resultados de salud.

Apoyar las medidas de calidad de planes médicos (HEDIS y programas de cuidado basado en valor), así como las propuestas de fondos.

description:
### **ABOUT OUR COMPANY:**

The crushing weight of debt is something that we believe holds people back from reaching their dreams and making a splash in the world. So in 2013, after seeing our friends and family struggle with student loans, we created Splash Financial.

Over the years, our mission has expanded to include helping people with other forms of debt - such as refinancing credit cards, which are at all time highs in the US. And we've been able to refinance $6+ Billion in loans through our network of Splash, powered credit union and bank partners who leverage our marketplace and automated loan processing technology. And we've raised over $135 million from investors like partners of DST Global, Citi Ventures, TruStage Ventures, Northwestern Mutual Future Ventures, Detroit Venture Partners, and more.

But at our core, we're still that little company from Cleveland with a big dream: to make people more powerful than their debt and we're just getting started..

### **ABOUT OUR WORKPLACE:**

Splash is remote-first, and proud of it — though our collections team works in-person at our Arizona location.

We spend our days simplifying financial products and getting them into the hands of people who need them most. Right now, we're focused on building financial technologies that fundamentally transform how the industry lends.

Although Splash has been around since 2013, we still operate like a startup — fast-paced, nimble, and full of heart. We're good people who care deeply about doing meaningful work and we approach challenges with creativity, passion, and urgency.

And to hire the best, we provide the best: great health insurance, competitive salaries, and unique benefits like quarterly meet-ups and access to engagement tools that keep us connected — even from afar.

At Splash, everything we do is guided by our values:

**Own It** – We take full accountability and follow through on commitments.

**Raise the Bar** – We move fast, innovate faster, and push through barriers.

**Say the Hard Thing** – We speak up with honesty, respect, and a desire to solve problems and make things better.

**Elevate Each Other** – We win as a team by lifting each other up.

These values show up in how we work and how we connect — whether we're collaborating on big projects or bonding over everyday moments. Yes, we even have Slack channels for #kids-and-pets and #food because we believe being human makes us better teammates.

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**
-------------------

Splash Financial is seeking an Operations Data Analyst who loves using data to solve problems and drive real business impact. You'll help improve performance across multiple teams by:

* Delivering data-driven insights that inform strategy and decision-making.
* Using AI tools to streamline processes and improve efficiency.
* Building the analysis behind business cases that support growth and operational excellence.

The ideal candidate is highly analytical, eager to connect data to real-world outcomes, enjoys collaborating across teams, and is curious about finding better ways of doing things.

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO AT SPLASH:**

* Analyze servicing and collections performance along with application funnels and contact-center metrics.
* Build and maintain automated reports and data files for our lending partners, investors, and vendors, working with your manager to map partner requirements to our data and deliver on time.
* Maintain and extend data models in Snowflake and dbt, and support the dashboards Operations leaders use to run their teams.
* Apply consistent key metrics definitions, help audit existing models, and reconcile our numbers against partner figures.
* Identify performance gaps, test hypotheses with data, and build the analysis behind business cases and recommendations to leadership.
* Apply AI tools to streamline analytics work (e.g., AI-assisted dbt development, automated request triage).
* Partner with data engineering, product, and business teams to scope requests and deliver solutions.

### **WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO SPLASH:**

* 1-3+ years of experience in a Data Analyst or Business Analyst role.
* Strong SQL skills and experience building and maintaining data models.
* Proficiency with BI tools (e.g., Sigma, Tableau, or Power BI).
* Strong business acumen and the ability to translate data into actionable recommendations.
* Ability to manage your own workload and deliver projects on time with minimal direction.
* Experience working with AI/ML tools or implementing AI-driven solutions.
* Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  

**NICE TO HAVE:**

  

* Experience in fintech, financial services, or a high-growth environment.
* Familiarity with Python or another programming language for data analysis.
* Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud.
* Master's degree in a related field.

**WHAT MAKES YOU STANDOUT:**

  

* Business-Minded: Connects data to business impact, not just analysis.
* AI & Analytics Curiosity: Excited to explore LLMs, predictive modeling, and new tools, and quick to put them to work.
* Operationally Grounded: Uses data to improve processes and outcomes.
* Clear Communicator: Turns data into clear, actionable stories for teams and leaders.
* Collaborative: Builds trust and works well across Ops, Product, and other teams.
* Ownership: Proactive self-starter who raises concerns early and follows through.
* Adaptability: Shifts focus quickly as priorities change while keeping existing work on track.
* Member-Centric: Always ties insights back to improving customer experience.

### **COMPENSATION:**

  

The base salary range for this role is $61,000 to $97,000 annually, based on market data and internal compensation practices. Final compensation will be determined by factors such as location, experience, and skill level.

**SPLASHERS ENJOY:**

* Fully remote work freedom *(for most roles)*
* Competitive salary packages

* Comprehensive and affordable insurance benefits
* Paid parental leave for both caregivers
* Essential modern equipment to get the job done

* Quarterly meet-ups: In person & virtual fun

**PLEASE BE AWARE:**

* Vendor and Product Record Maintenance: Maintain current vendor and manufacturer information tied to catalog items so purchasing, sales, and operations teams can rely on consistent product records.

The Catalog Coordinator position will not have direct supervisory responsibilities.

Work Environment

This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand and walk.

title: Data Analyst – Analytics & Strategy
description:
At cabi, we're redefining what it means to build a fashion brand—one rooted in connection, confidence, and purpose. As a women's retail clothing company, we don't just design beautiful apparel; we create opportunities for women to express themselves, build community, and thrive both personally and professionally. Our culture is collaborative, entrepreneurial, and deeply people-first, and every team member plays a role in creating meaningful experiences for our Stylists and clients. If you're energized by creativity, inspired by empowering others, and excited to contribute to a brand that blends style with substance, you'll feel right at home here.

We are looking for a Data Analyst who can own our recurring reporting and also dig into the open-ended questions that come up across the business. About half of the role is keeping our core reporting accurate, reliable, and increasingly automated. The other half is ad hoc analysis and project work, where you'll partner with teams across the company to answer the questions behind their biggest decisions.

This role is a great fit for someone who enjoys both building things that run smoothly and solving new problems. You should be comfortable taking a loosely defined request, figuring out what's really being asked, and turning it into a clear analysis and recommendation. Because our work goes to executives, the board, and external partners, a high attention to detail is essential.

We also use AI tools every day to work faster and smarter, and we're looking for someone who is excited to do the same.

Ad hoc analysis and projects

This person will be the connective tissue between what our applications log and what Product, Sales, and Customer Success need to know to make a decision.

* Inform feature impact and roadmap sequencing: quantify how individual features move the metrics that matter, giving Product a data backed basis for sequencing the roadmap and giving Customer Success a concrete case for encouraging customers to adopt more features.

* Set instrumentation requirements up front: partner with Product and Engineering before a feature ships to define what needs to be tracked, so measurement is built in from the start instead of added after the fact.
* Explore emerging measurement needs: help scope how our products influence visibility in AI driven and generative search as that channel becomes a bigger part of how patients find providers.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

The Product Business Analyst II is the connection between our business teams and IT. When a stakeholder has a problem to solve or a feature to build, you are the person who figures out exactly what needs to happen before developers writes a single line of code. And you stay with it through launch, making sure what gets built actually solves the problem.

This role is evolving. AI tools are changing the importance of different responsibilities within the role. AI has made writing requirements easier and code development faster. That has resulted in the role focusing more on understanding the business and collaboration. The candidates who will thrive here are the ones who use AI to handle the boilerplate faster, so they can spend more time on the work that actually matters such as building stakeholder trust, asking the question nobody else thought to ask, and owning the quality of the final deliverable.

You don't just take orders. title: Sr. Business Analyst
description:
**City Brewing Company – Who We Are**

With our roots in La Crosse, WI, we are proud to be North America’s largest co-packager of alcoholic beverages with four locations across the United States. Through our focuses on **Safety** throughout our facilities, **Quality** of products produced for our customers, **Communication** at all levels, **Growth** of not just our locations but also of our employees in their careers, and **Performance** with our ability to meet deadlines and goals for ourselves and our customers, we pride ourselves on the brand we have created and continue to grow.

**Job Summary**

The Senior Business Analyst is responsible for understanding business needs across a multi-site brewing and manufacturing enterprise and translating them into clear, actionable requirements and solutions. This role serves as the bridge between plant operations, supply chain, finance, and corporate functions and the IT teams and vendors that deliver technology. The Senior Business Analyst leads discovery, process analysis, requirements definition, solution evaluation, and validation for technology initiatives, reviews vendor deliverables against defined standards, and supports delivery by managing the scope, schedule, and risks of the work they own, in alignment with IIBA (BABOK) best practices and organizational objectives

**Duties and Responsibilities**

**Requirements & Business Analysis**

* Elicit, analyze, and document business needs through workshops, interviews, site visits, and process observation at brewery and warehouse locations.
* Develop and maintain business requirements, functional specifications, use cases, user stories, and acceptance criteria that are clear, testable, and traceable.
* Maintain requirements traceability from initial business need through design, testing, and deployment.
* Analyze, prioritize, and manage changes to requirements, ensuring stakeholders understand trade-offs and impacts.
* Serve as the subject matter expert on business analysis practices, mentoring junior analysts and business partners.

**Process & Data Analysis**

* Map current-state and future-state business processes, identify gaps and inefficiencies, and recommend process and technology improvements.
* Analyze operational and system data to quantify problems, validate assumptions, and support data-driven recommendations.
* Define data, reporting, and integration requirements, partnering with Data and Applications teams to ensure solutions meet business needs.
* Identify opportunities for automation and standardization across plants and functions.

**Solution Evaluation & Vendor Deliverables**

* Build business cases, cost-benefit analyses, and solution options to support technology evaluation, selection, and investment decisions.
* Develop vendor evaluation criteria, scorecards, and requirements-based fit-gap analyses for software and service providers.
* Review and validate vendor deliverables, including requirements, designs, test plans, and training materials, against defined standards and contractual obligations.
* Plan and facilitate user acceptance testing, validate that solutions meet acceptance criteria, and support cutover and go-live readiness.
* Measure and report benefits realization after go-live to confirm that solutions deliver their intended business value.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Change Enablement**

* Build trusted relationships with plant managers, operations leaders, and business sponsors across multiple sites.
* Facilitate working sessions and decision-making among stakeholders with competing priorities, translating technical concepts into business language.
* Support change management, communication, and training activities that drive adoption of new systems and processes.

**Project Support**

* Manage the scope, schedule, and deliverables for analysis and small-to-medium initiatives, from initiation through closeout.
* Support larger projects by maintaining requirements and decision logs, tracking risks, issues, and dependencies, and providing status updates to the project manager and sponsors.
* Partner with Infrastructure, Applications, Data, and Cybersecurity teams to ensure solutions are designed, integrated, and secured appropriately.
* Maintain project documentation and lessons learned, and ensure compliance with IT policies, security standards, and audit requirements.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; or equivalent experience.
* 7+ years of experience as a business analyst in an IT, operations, or supply chain environment. (Required)
* Strong working knowledge of business analysis standards and techniques (IIBA/BABOK), including requirements elicitation, process modeling, and documentation.
* Proven experience supporting enterprise application implementations (e.g., ERP, WMS, MES, CMMS, or similar) from requirements through go-live.
* Experience reviewing vendor deliverables, SOWs, and project plans.
* Working knowledge of project management practices (PMI/PMBOK, agile, or hybrid), with experience managing small-to-medium initiatives.
* Hands-on experience with requirements and collaboration tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Visio, Smartsheet).
* Excellent written and verbal communication, facilitation, and analytical problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities in a fast-paced 24/7 manufacturing environment.
* Certifications such as CBAP, PMI-PBA, or CCBA; PMP, CAPM, or Agile/Scrum a plus.

**Our Benefits**

* Every employee starts with 22 days of paid time off each year plus an additional day each year after that. PTO is meant to be used and is an important part of work-life balance – each manager encourages their employees to use all PTO.
* 401(k) match.
* Health savings account (HSA) option with the choice of three medical plans.
* Dental, vision, legal and disability coverage.
* Gym membership reimbursement and athletic event reimbursement.
* Local discounts with various restaurants, gyms and other companies.

  

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

The Senior Product Business Analyst is the connection between our business teams and IT. When a stakeholder has a problem to solve or a feature to build, you are the person who figures out exactly what needs to happen before developers writes a single line of code. And you stay with it through launch, making sure what gets built actually solves the problem.

This role is evolving. AI tools are changing the importance of different responsibilities within the role. AI has made writing requirements easier and code development faster. That has resulted in the role focusing more on understanding the business and collaboration. The candidates who will thrive here are the ones who use AI to handle the boilerplate faster, so they can spend more time on the work that actually matters such as building stakeholder trust, asking the question nobody else thought to ask, and owning the quality of the final deliverable.

You don't just take orders. You interview stakeholders, dig into how our systems actually work, identify the requirements they didn't know they had, and translate all of it into something IT can build from. Then you watch what gets delivered, review the output against the intent, and speak up when something isn't right.

**ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Build relationships with business stakeholders across Claims, Underwriting, Finance, Marketing, and Operations to become the person they call before they write the ticket, not after.
* Lead requirements discovery by interviewing not just the original requestor, but adjacent teams and anyone else who touches the process to surface the requirements they didn't know they had.
* Use AI tools to accelerate the documentation layer to draft requirements, functional specs, and user stories freeing more time for the high-value stakeholder and quality work.
* Liaise between business and IT throughout the project lifecycle, managing communication, resolving clarifications, and keeping delivery on track.
* Own post-launch quality: review dashboards, reports, and system outputs after every release to confirm the build is performing as intended and escalate clearly when it isn't.
* Track project status across active workstreams and communicate updates proactively so stakeholders are never surprised.
* Ask the question that wasn't asked to surface the "what happens when X?" issues before they become expensive fixes.
* Mentor BA II team members on requirements quality, stakeholder communication, and post-launch ownership.

  

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Finance, or a related field.
* 2–5 years of experience in business analysis, IT project delivery, product operations, or a closely related role.
* Demonstrated ability to independently lead requirements discovery on complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
* Track record of writing precise functional specifications that IT teams can build from correctly the first time.
* Experience managing the business-to-IT relationship through a full project lifecycle.
* Analytical mindset: you can review a post-launch report, identify anomalies, trace them toward a root cause, and communicate the finding in a way that drives action.
* Demonstrated comfort using AI tools professionally.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* Must be eligible to work in the U.S. without sponsorship now or in the future.

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

A reliable traceability view depends on detailed knowledge of how payment instructions, statuses and exceptions move across multiple systems. This role will build that evidence base and help convert it into clear requirements, tested functionality and practical operating procedures.

**Job Description Summary**

The Student Success Data Analyst provides advanced reporting, analysis, assessment, and decision support for the Student Services division. The position develops and maintains reports and analytical tools using Workday and other approved data sources; identifies trends affecting recruitment, enrollment, retention, persistence, and student success; and translates complex information into clear, actionable recommendations.
  
  
Working closely with Student Services leaders, College Strategy, Academic Instruction and Programming, Information Technology, and other institutional partners, the Data Analyst helps departments define meaningful measures, evaluate programs and processes, investigate operational and strategic questions, and assess the impact of improvement efforts.
  
  
The position supports divisional decision-making while adhering to institutional data governance, reporting standards, survey protocols, privacy requirements, and established definitions. The Data Analyst serves as the primary Student Services partner for applying institutional data to divisional priorities and communicating the Student Services impact on student outcomes.

**Job Description**

**Essential Functions and Responsibilities**
============================================

### ***The following duties are primarily performed and are essential for this position. Employees are expected to be able to perform each of these job duties satisfactorily to be qualified for the position. Other duties may be required and assigned.***

**Student Success Analytics & Decision Support**
------------------------------------------------

* Provide analytical support to Strategic Enrollment Management and Retention committees.

* Analyze recruitment, application, admission, registration, enrollment, persistence, completion, and stop-out patterns.

* Conduct cohort, funnel, trend, segmentation, and equity analyses to identify barriers, disparities, and opportunities for intervention.

* Develop forecasting models, risk indicators, and scenario analyses to support enrollment planning and resource decisions.

* Analyze program demand using factors such as application volume, applicant eligibility, application-to-seat ratios, enrollment yield, historical fill rates, wait time, unmet demand, student attrition, program capacity, and labor-market information.

* Assist leaders in evaluating high-demand programs and monitoring the effects of high-demand program processes.

* Investigate emerging operational questions and translate findings into potential actions.

Develop methods for measuring the effectiveness of student-success interventions over time.  

  

**Advanced Reporting & Data Infrastructure**
--------------------------------------------

* Design, develop, validate, document, and maintain advanced Workday reports, dashboards, calculated fields, and related reporting tools.

* Integrate information from approved institutional systems and data sources.

* Develop repeatable reporting processes to reduce reliance on manual spreadsheets and one-time data requests.

* Maintain a Student Services report inventory, reporting calendar, and documentation of methodologies.

* Partner with College Strategy and enterprise systems staff to validate data definitions, resolve discrepancies, and ensure consistency.

Evaluate existing reports and processes for accuracy, usability, duplication, and opportunities for automation.  

  

**Assessment & Continuous Improvement**

* Provide consultation to Student Services departments in developing outcomes, measures, assessment plans, and improvement strategies.

* Help departments distinguish among operational metrics, service-quality measures, student-learning outcomes, and student-success outcomes.

* Coordinate with academic assessment partners to establish feedback loops between Student Services and faculty.

* Track improvement initiatives and evaluate whether implemented changes produce intended results.

Support Student Services contributions to accreditation, strategic planning, annual reporting, and institutional effectiveness efforts.  

  

**Data Storytelling & Communication**
-------------------------------------

* Translate complex analysis into concise reports, presentations, dashboards, visualizations, executive summaries, and decision briefs.

* Develop a coherent narrative demonstrating Student Services contributions to institutional priorities.

* Produce or coordinate a division-wide Student Services impact report.

* Create reusable reporting templates for departmental and divisional use.

* Present findings to audiences with different levels of data literacy.

* Build data literacy within Student Services.

Clearly distinguish findings, assumptions, limitations, correlations, and recommendations.  

  

**Data Governance & Institutional Collaboration**
-------------------------------------------------

* Serve as a liaison among Student Services, College Strategy, Instruction and Academic Programming, and enterprise systems staff.

* Follow established data-governance standards, institutional definitions, security protocols, and approval processes.

* Ensure appropriate handling of student information under FERPA and other privacy requirements.

* Coordinate divisional survey needs with CSEII.

* Help departments prepare focused, well-defined data requests.

Participate in relevant committees and workgroups.  

  

**Non-Essential Functions and Responsibilities**
================================================

Participate in appropriate committee assignments

---------------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in data analytics, business intelligence, higher education, social science, statistics, information systems, business administration, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.

* At least four years of relevant experience in reporting, analytics, institutional research, assessment, business intelligence, or decision support.

* Demonstrated experience developing reports from an enterprise information system, student information system, ERP, or complex relational database.

* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and work across organizational boundaries.

Experience handling sensitive and confidential information.

-----------------------------------------------------

Proven analytical skills and ability to think strategically.

**Who we are looking for:**

We are looking for a detail-oriented payments analyst to support implementation and subsequent BAU operations of the payment anomaly detection capability. The role will perform hands-on business analysis, rule validation, test execution, process documentation and operational readiness, then transition after go-live into day-to-day operations ,rule performance, exception and control support.

  
  

**Why this role is important to us?**

Anomaly detection must identify unusual payments without introducing unnecessary processing delays or additional approval, audit, or client-communication activities. Join us if contributing to our Payments Business Risk and Resiliency Programs is a challenge you are up for.

* Document business requirements, user stories, process maps, decision tables and acceptance criteria under the direction of the workstream lead.
* Develop and maintain detailed rule definitions, thresholds, tolerances, reason codes, expected outcomes and test cases.
* Analyse sample and historical payment data to validate rule logic, identify data-quality issues and assess expected alert volumes and false-positive patterns.
* Execute functional, integration, regression and user acceptance tests across screening, decisioning, case management, UI, reporting and audit functions.
* Capture defects with reproducible evidence, support prioritisation and retest corrected functionality.
* Validate queue prioritisation, time-to-cut-off logic, risk tiers, alert grouping, case statuses, client-contact information, templated communications and implementing Agentic AI.

* Support high-volume events and post-event reviews, ensuring decisions, approvals and evidence are captured.

* Payments operations or payments-control experience with strong analytical and documentation skills.
