title: BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE ANALYST
description:
**Summary**

The Business Intelligence Analyst builds and maintains the reporting, dashboards and automated workflows the company runs on. This role turns data held across the company's operating and financial systems into reporting leadership can act on, and converts manual processes into automated workflows that remove repeated handling.

The work is platform agnostic by design. The person in this seat is expected to hold the concepts and the principles, and to apply them on whichever platforms the company is using at the time.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Reporting & Analytics**

* Design, build and maintain reporting and dashboards for project teams and corporate departments, from a defined specification agreed before development begins.
* Maintain the published reporting portfolio, including refresh schedules, access management and retirement of reports no longer in use.
* Build data models that let business users answer their own follow-up questions without submitting a new request.
* Apply company brand standards to every published report and client-facing deliverable.
* Implement row-level security so that each user sees only the regions, projects and measures appropriate to their role.
* Ensure every published report renders correctly on a phone or tablet for field use.

**Process Automation**

* Design, build, test and maintain automated workflows that replace manual data entry and routing across the company.
* Convert existing form-based and spreadsheet-based intake processes into web-based workflows with proper approval routing, notification and audit history.
* Document every automation with a process map, a named business owner and a defined failure and escalation path.
* Monitor deployed workflows, resolve failures and maintain version control as the systems they depend on change.
* Build automations on the company's low-code workflow platform where it fits and in code where it does not, and record which approach each automation uses and why.

**Data Integration & Quality**

* Write and maintain queries against the company data warehouse and the systems connected to it.
* Maintain the data pipelines that feed the reporting environment from the company's operating, financial and document systems.
* Own the reporting data warehouse end to end: ingestion from the ERP, project management , document and bidding systems; the dimensional data model; refresh schedules; backups; access control; and the documentation of each.
* Own the master-data crosswalk for project, vendor and cost-code identifiers across the operating systems. Detect and resolve identifier conflicts at the source rather than patching them in a report.
* Run automated data quality tests on every pipeline and publish a monthly data-quality scorecard to the Director.
* Run data quality checks, and investigate and resolve discrepancies between a source system and a published report.
* Maintain documentation of data definitions so that a given measure means the same thing in every report that uses it.

**Partnership & Delivery**

* Take requests through the departmental intake process, scope them accurately and commit to realistic delivery dates.
* Escalate competing priorities rather than absorbing them.
* Train end users on what is delivered to them and produce short reference material, so that adoption does not depend on repeat one-on-one support.
* Present findings and recommendations to project teams and department leaders in plain language.
* Measure and report usage of every published report. A report with no use in 90 days is retired or rebuilt, not left running.

**Development & Growth**

* Work to a development plan agreed with the Director covering data modeling, query performance, automation reliability and construction domain knowledge.
* Take on progressively larger scope as capability is demonstrated.
* Stay current on the platforms the company uses and on the direction those platforms are moving.

**General**

* Maintain confidentiality of financial, personnel and client information encountered in the course of the work.
* Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

**Qualification Requirements**

The required list is the working foundation a candidate must hold on day one. The preferred list is capability that is welcome on arrival and will otherwise be developed in the role.

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in information systems, computer science, data analytics, business, engineering, construction management or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Two or more years of experience building business intelligence reporting in a production environment.
* Demonstrated ability to build and publish reporting independently on a major business intelligence platform, including the query and calculation layers.
* Working proficiency writing queries against a relational database, including joins, aggregation and window functions.
* Demonstrated ability to design dimensional data models (fact and dimension tables) and to build version-controlled, tested SQL transformations on top of them.
* Working knowledge of row-level security and data model design on a business intelligence platform.
* Demonstrated ability to build working automated workflows, including approval routing.
* Advanced spreadsheet skills, and the ability to gather requirements directly from non-technical stakeholders and translate them into a defined scope.
* Ability to manage several concurrent requests and communicate status without being asked.
* Ability to explain technical work to a non-technical audience.

**Preferred, not required**

* Advanced calculation work, row-level security and data model design on a business intelligence platform.
* Query performance tuning, indexing and execution plan analysis.
* Error handling in production automations: structured retry, logging and failure alerting.
* Experience reporting against or integrating construction, project management or enterprise resource planning systems.
* Prior experience in construction, engineering, architecture or another project-based industry. Candidates from other industries are encouraged to apply.
* Working knowledge of construction financial reporting: percentage-of-completion accounting, work-in-progress schedules, over and under billings, backlog and margin fade.
* Experience with Trimble Spectrum (Data Exchange / App Xchange), the Procore API, the Egnyte API, BuildingConnected or Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps).
* Experience with analytics engineering tooling (dbt or equivalent) and SQL Server fundamentals: scheduled jobs, backups, access control and query performance.

**Physical Demands**

* Regularly required to sit or stand and walk for extended periods of time, with the occasional ability to stoop or kneel.
* Must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.
* Vision abilities for this position include close vision as well as distance vision.

* This position has no direct reports.

ABOUT THE COMPANY
  
**Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE:** RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. Sustainability Innovation
  
Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.

These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.

The Systems Engineering Division (SED) provides unmatched experience in systems engineering to the U.S. government and to numerous public and private agencies, universities, nonprofit organizations, consortia, and commercial companies involved in the advanced application of space technology. From systems architecture development to system analysis and optimization, astrodynamics, orbital debris, navigation, failure analysis, mission assurance, cost and schedule assessment, and economic market analysis, SED exploits an incredibly broad array of engineering and business disciplines against a diverse and dynamic portfolio of programs and national challenges.

The Acquisition Planning and Decision Analytics (APDA) Department is seeking an Acquisition Data Analyst Specialist to join a diverse, innovative, and highly productive team of acquisition, systems, digital, and data engineering professionals. This growing, geographically distributed department supports a wide range of customers in the National Security, Civil and Commercial, and International Space Communities. APDA applies deep technical acquisition & systems engineering expertise and data-driven capability enablers to improve decision making to form a sound basis for space, ground, and launch system program acquisition lifecycle activities.

  

**Work Model:** This is a full-time position based in El Segundo, CA or Chantilly, VA.

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Collect and aggregate acquisition and systems engineering data to support Program Office and customer technical reviews and activities, and support in-person reviews and meetings as requested

* Research, compile, and validate information on space and launch vehicle systems and launch milestone events entered and maintained in the CAESAR Launch Log and other subdivision capabilities

* Develop and maintain data visualizations for data housed within department/subdivision capabilities

* Research and analyze data and provide analysis of results to support specialized studies and other activities; conduct internal briefings to discuss findings and recommend changes and/or updates.

* Manage, update, and maintain subdivision technical data, databases, and processes

Collect, aggregate, and maintain subdivision business intelligence data and execute processes (e.g., tracking and metrics for projects, deliverables, training) to support decision making, execution, and reporting at subdivision and division reviews

**What You Need to be Successful**

Minimum Requirements:

* Level II: 3 or more years of relevant experience with an Associate degree in a related discipline – or – 5 or more years of relevant experience with a High School Diploma or equivalent

* Level III: 5 or more years of relevant experience with an Associate degree in a related discipline – or – 7 or more years of relevant experience with a High School Diploma or equivalent

* Familiarity with USSF and other National Security Space programs

* Familiarity with configuration management practices

* Strong critical decision-making, organizational and time management skills, detail-oriented, and ability to adapt to changing organizational needs

* Strong written and oral communication skills

* Ability to be flexible, adaptable, and able to manage and perform multiple simultaneous tasks in a dynamic environment

* Effective communication and interpersonal skills to coordinate efforts, work well in a team environment, and interface with others in internal and external organizations

This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance, which is issued by the US government. U.S citizenship is required to obtain a security clearance.  



**How You Can Stand Out**

It would be impressive if you have one or more of the following:

* Bachelor’s or higher degree

* Familiarity using Python or other programming languages (e.g., Java, C/C++)

* Experience using Jira and Confluence

* Familiarity with databases and data management systems (e.g., relational, non-relational, time series)

title: Statistical Reporting Analyst
description:
**About Martin**

Martin is a leading, tech-enabled insurance advisory firm celebrating over 30 years of excellence. We partner with national, regional, and local insurance carriers and Managing General Agents (MGAs) across the U.S. to solve their most critical challenges. Our expertise spans Product Development, Actuarial Services, Regulatory Compliance, State Filings, and Data Analytics. Our mission is simple: build lasting partnerships and deliver technology-driven outcomes that fuel business success.

**The Opportunity**

As a Statistical Reporting Analyst, you will own end-to-end statistical reporting for Property & Casualty insurance programs across multiple jurisdictions and reporting bureaus. You'll prepare, validate, and submit statistical and financial data to organizations such as ISO, NISS, ISS, and other independent bureaus on behalf of our clients.

This role manages reporting from data intake and validation through submission, edit resolution, reconciliation, and final approval. It is ideal for someone with hands-on bureau reporting experience, strong analytical skills, and a solid understanding of insurance data and statistical reporting requirements, who can manage multiple reporting deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Statistical Reporting*

* End-to-End Ownership: Manage statistical reporting processes from data intake, validation, and preparation through submission and post-submission review
* Prepare & Submit: Prepare and submit statistical reports for multiple lines of business, including General Liability, Commercial Auto, Property, Fidelity & Surety, and other P&C lines, to ISO, NISS, ISS, and other state or independent bureaus
* Deadline Management: Monitor reporting calendars and manage multiple submission deadlines across clients, lines of business, and jurisdictions

*Data Quality & Reconciliation*

* Review & Validate: Review source data and reporting output for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable statistical reporting requirements
* Reconcile: Perform data reconciliations and quality checks, including premium, exposure, loss, claim, policy, coverage, and other statistical data
* Root Cause Analysis: Investigate discrepancies and identify the root cause of data issues, including missing or invalid data, coding inconsistencies, mapping issues, and source-system errors
* Edit Resolution: Review, research, and resolve bureau edits, exceptions, and validation errors within required deadlines
* Testing: Test and validate reporting output following system or specification changes prior to production submission

*Client & Team Communication*

* Issue Communication: Communicate data issues and required corrections to clients and internal teams, ensuring questions are thoroughly researched and validated before they are raised

Documentation & Continuous Improvement

* Documentation: Maintain accurate documentation of reporting requirements, specifications, processes, and bureau communications
* Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes, data quality, automation, and operational efficiency
* Regulatory Awareness: Stay current on applicable bureau requirements, statistical plans, reporting changes, and regulatory requirements

**Qualifications**

* 3–5+ years of P&C insurance statistical reporting, data analysis, or related insurance operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Analytics, Business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
* Direct experience with ISO, NISS, ISS, state-specific, or independent bureau statistical reporting
* Strong understanding of P&C insurance data, statistical reporting requirements, and bureau specifications
* Strong Excel skills, including formulas, lookups, pivot tables, data validation, and data reconciliation
* Experience working with flat files, fixed-width files, delimited files, and large data sets
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate discrepancies, identify root causes, and resolve data issues
* Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate technical and data-related issues
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines while working independently and collaboratively with clients and internal teams
* Strong organizational, documentation, regulatory, and compliance skills
* Legal authorization to work in the United States is required

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting multiple P&C lines of business and reporting bureaus
* Experience with SQL, SQL Server, or other data-querying tools
* Experience with reporting systems, data conversions, system implementations, or reporting process development
* Experience troubleshooting reporting output and collaborating with software development teams
* Familiarity with bureau edit packages, statistical plan changes, and reporting specification updates
* Experience with JIRA, Wrike, or other project/workflow management tools

**Why Join Us**

* Growth-Oriented Culture: Work with a leadership team committed to innovation and revenue expansion
* Competitive Earning Potential: Base salary plus bonus potential, profit sharing, and a comprehensive benefits package that rewards expertise and contributions
* Legacy of Excellence: Be part of a well-respected organization with over 30 years of leadership in the insurance industry
* Dynamic Team Culture: Work alongside talented colleagues who are passionate, driven, and committed to success

**Salary and Benefits**

The base salary for this position is $61,000 to $76,000. Final salary offer will be based on several factors, including commensurate experience, qualifications, and skills. Our salaries are complemented by an extensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and work-life balance. These benefits include:

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan options
* Generous, flexible paid time off (PTO) policy
* Professional Development and Growth Opportunities

title: Data & Reporting Analyst
description:
Advance Hawaiian Humane’s mission by ensuring accurate, timely, and well-governed organizational data that supports informed decision-making, operational effectiveness, grant reporting, and process improvement. This position analyzes and reports data from key systems, maintains data integrity, and serves as a collaborative resource for departments across the organization.

  

ESSENTIAL DUTIES/FUNCTIONS:

* **People Care.** Ensuring internal and external patrons (employees, volunteers, Hawaiian Humane partners and community members) and their needs are a primary focus. Communication and contact must be clear, understandable, cooperative, professional and respectful in all circumstances and will occur face to face, telephone, and electronic mail. Employees are expected to actively support a positive team environment, directly address conflict with the goal of problem solving, and appropriately express concerns. This position interacts with and collaborates with employees and volunteers at all levels of the organization.
* **Customer Care.** Deliver high-level customer service to Hawaiian Humane internal customers and community members. Communicate with a diverse group of people in a consistently compassionate, informative, respectful, and professional manner. Manage emotionally difficult situations with strong communication skills and empathy.
* **Statistical Reporting & Data Analysis.** Compiles, analyzes, and reports organizational statistics for Senior Leadership and supports ad hoc reporting needs across the organization. Sources data from PetPoint, Clinic HQ, and other systems; verifies accuracy; and investigates variances and anomalies. Produces reports, graphs, trend analyses, and Excel trackers, including data mapping for the annual Legislative session. Writes and runs SQL queries leading to report development. Documents analytical methods, trains others on data collection practices, and provides data-driven recommendations for process improvement.
* **Data Confidentiality & Governance.** Handles organizational data with the highest degree of discretion and integrity. Maintains confidentiality of sensitive operational, financial, and programmatic information and ensures data is accessed, stored, and shared in accordance with organizational policies and applicable regulations.
* **Grant Reporting Support.** Collaborates with the grant writer and relevant departments to pull, compile, and format statistical data required for grant applications, reports, and funder deliverables. Ensures accuracy and timeliness of data provided in support of the organization’s fundraising and compliance obligations.
* **Database Management & Data Entry.** Maintains accurate and up-to-date records in PetPoint, Clinic HQ, SQL and other organizational systems. Performs routine and ad hoc data entry as needed to ensure data integrity across platforms**,** supports and trains staff in proper data entry practices and system utilization.
* **Reporting Calendar & Distribution Management.** Maintains a reporting calendar to ensure timely preparation and delivery of recurring reports. Manages distribution lists and ensures the appropriate reports reach the correct stakeholders on schedule.
* **Interdepartmental Communication & Collaboration.** Serves as a key resource across departments for data needs, and process improvement initiatives. Builds and maintains effective working relationships with staff at all levels, proactively communicating findings, timelines, and data-related updates to support informed decision-making organization-wide.

OTHER DUTIES/FUNCTIONS

* **Operations Support.** Work with other departments within the organization to resolve issues of mutual concern and improve operations.
* **Other Duties as Assigned.** May include organization-wide support as needed, including but not limited to participation in events, public speaking, fundraising, covering other operational departments, and assisting with Hawaiian Humane’s role as a first responder to disasters.

* Work Environment: Indoors in an air-conditioned office.
* Equipment Use: PC (Google, Word, Excel, Adobe, Canva, PetPoint or Animal Shelter Management systems, SQL Server Management Studio, Microsoft Visual Studio), copy machine, scanner, fax machine, telephone, and other office equipment.
* Work Hours: Regular 40-hour work week, Monday – Friday typical schedule, with other hours based on operational requirements and other needs.

MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND COMMUNICATION DEMANDS:

* Strong organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to handle sensitive information with discretion, the highest degree of integrity, and maintain professionalism in appearance, conduct, and workspace.
* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and work accurately in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively across all levels of the organization.
* Ability to lift up to 30 lbs. with reasonable accommodation.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and ability to learn new systems quickly.
* Must exercise compassion, patience, professionalism, flexibility and tact when dealing with a broad range of employees, volunteers and the public including difficult, emotional or angry people.
* Must be detail oriented with problem solving skills.
* Must be committed to developing a deep knowledge of progressive animal welfare issues.
* Must agree with and be committed to Hawaiian Humane goals, objectives and programs.

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS:

***Please note that ParetoHealth does not provide employment visa sponsorship for this position. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship both now or in the future.***

**About The Team:**
===================

At ParetoHealth, the Analytics team sits at the intersection of healthcare data, business strategy, and decision-making. We work with rich medical, pharmacy, stoploss, and business datasets to generate insights that directly influence product strategy, client outcomes, underwriting, and internal operations. The team partners closely with a varied set of stakeholders to move from questions to action, promoting data-driven decision making across the organization. We do this within a team culture of collaboration, shared responsibility, mutual respect, and growth.

**Position Summary:**
=====================

This role is designed for a senior, analytically sophisticated individual contributor who feels most at home in the space between data science and traditional BI analytics.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will partner closely with other Analysts, Data Scientists and cross-functional stakeholders to tackle complex, ambiguous analytical problems, focusing on the operationalization and maintenance of solutions. You will contribute to and sometimes lead analyses end-to-end, with a focus on long-term sustainability and enterprise-wide utilization of solutions.

This role is not focused on building predictive models or machine learning systems for production, and it does not include people management responsibilities. Success in this role comes from analytic rigor, a deep interest in efficiency and standardization, and the ability to turn complex data into decisions.

You will report to the VP of Analytics.

**Key Responsbilities:**
========================

* Lead Delivery of Analytic Insights
  + Partner with Analysts/Data Scientists to understand business priorities and translate them into analytical approaches
  + Design, test, and refine appropriate methodologies for complex analytical questions with an eye toward long term sustainability
  + Work directly with large, messy healthcare datasets, including medical and pharmacy claims
  + Build and maintain robust SQL queries and analytical datasets

* Deliver Decision-Ready Insights
  + Develop and support clear visualizations and summaries that communicate findings to technical and non-technical audiences
  + Translate complex analyses into actionable recommendations, with support from Lead Analysts
  + Document methodologies, assumptions, and limitations to ensure transparency and repeatability

* Collaborate Within the Team
  + Work closely with Data Scientists and other Analysts to support exploratory analyses, hypothesis generation, and interpretation of results
  + Partner with Analytics teammates to align definitions, methodologies, and data quality standards
  + Contribute through collaboration and shared problem-solving

* Drive Business Impact
  + Lead stakeholder-identified opportunities where analytics can improve business outcomes
  + Support teams across the organization, including underwriting, product, account management, and cost containment

===========================

* A *problem-solver* with a natural sense of curiosity, analytic rigor, and a deep interest in understanding complex healthcare data
* An *adaptable utility player* who can flex across operationalization, analysis, visualization, QA, and documentation as needs evolve
* A *collaborator* with proven ability to work cross-functionally across many different stakeholders to create and deliver insights
* A *strong communicator* who effectively shares information at the appropriate level across a wide variety of audiences
* A *self-starter* with a demonstrated track record of owning projects from idea to execution
* A *critical thinker* with demonstrated ability to be creative, strategic, and to apply strong business judgement
* A *translator* who can turn complex analysis into actionable insights and recommendations for the business

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* 5-8+ years' experience in a healthcare-based analytics role, preferably in the health benefits space/insurance industry, with a solid understanding of the US-based health insurance system
* Extensive hands-on experience working with administrative healthcare data (medical and pharmacy claims)
* Strong mathematical and statistical foundations, including familiarity with quantitative reasoning, distributions, rates, and variability as applied to real-world healthcare data
* Strong SQL skills, including building, optimizing, and validating complex analytical queries
* Advanced proficiency in data visualization tools such as Tableau
* Significant experience using programming languages, such as Python, for analysis and data wrangling
* Significant experience in data cleaning, validation, and exploratory analysis using large, complex datasets
* Understanding of analytical concepts, including descriptive statistics, cohort analysis, risk assessment, trend analysis, and causal thinking
* Strong analytic judgment: knowing which method to use, why, and when
* Bachelor's degree in a quantitative/analytic field, Master's (or equivalent work experience) preferred

**Bonus Qualifications:**

* Deep knowledge of Python (advanced modeling not required)
* Experience analyzing Salesforce data, healthcare vendor-reported utilization and savings data, and/or stop loss insurance data
* Familiarity with underwriting and actuarial risk assessments for healthcare insurance coverage
* Familiarity with AWS Serverless Services and data tools, such as S3, Lambda, Glue, Sagemaker and EMR

* Engaging hybrid work environment

The drive to learn, to improve, and to deliver outstanding value every day.

The ability to see the big picture and prepare to meet tomorrow's needs.

**Get it done right**

The passion to produce at higher rates and to the highest standards.

A united community creating better health benefit solutions for all.

Job Description
  
  
The Lead Data Analyst is responsible for translating business opportunities, customer needs, and operational challenges into actionable data requirements, integrated data solutions, and analytical deliverables.
  
This role partners directly with business customers, Digital Product, Analytics, AI, Data Operations, and Technology teams to understand business processes, document requirements, assess data, validate solutions, and ensure delivered capabilities solve the intended business problem.
  
The Lead Data Analyst serves as a key bridge between business stakeholders and the DataOps Engineering organization, providing hands-on expertise across business analysis, data profiling, solution validation, customer enablement, and process improvement so data and engineering investments align to measurable business outcomes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Business Engagement Functional Analysis
  
  

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand business objectives, operational processes, decision-making needs, and desired outcomes and how data supports them.
* Facilitate discovery sessions, requirements workshops, and stakeholder interviews to translate customer needs into clear functional requirements, business rules, acceptance criteria, and value measures.
* Ensure business context, intended use, process requirements, and expected outcomes are understood and documented before solution development begins.

Data Analysis, Profiling Requirements
  
  

* Perform data discovery, profiling, and analysis to evaluate quality, completeness, metadata, usability, and fitness for purpose, identifying gaps and remediation needs early in the lifecycle.
* Define and document business semantics, data definitions, transformation logic, source-to-target mappings, data relationships, and readiness criteria.
* Develop clear functional and data requirements that enable efficient solution development.

Data Product Integration Validation

Business Process Automation Optimization

description:
**Senior Data Marketing Solution Analyst****- Full Time (Remote)**

**Our Organization**

CDP, a Boston-based public benefit corporation, uses the collaborative fundraising model to improve the operational efficiency and revenue generation capacity of the public media system. CDP currently provides more than 230 NPR and PBS public media organizations (PMO’s) with outsourced marketing, data analytics, fundraising, and technology services. These services help PMO’s raise more net income, grow their donor files faster, lower their fundraising costs, and free up development talent allowing stations to better focus on local engagement. Since its inception, CDP has delivered more than $1 billion in membership revenue for local PMO’s participating in its services and has become the most widely adopted Public Media service in the history of public media.

Just as CDP is committed to supporting public media organizations around the country, we are equally committed to supporting each of our team in their own professional development.

For more information visit www.cdpcommunity.org

**The Business Data Operations Team (BDO)**

Business Data Operations is one of six teams within the Fundraising OPS Department, which supports critical fundraising functions for CDP including the Member Service Bureau (MSB) cooperative, Partner Services, and Audience Activation Platform (AAP). The BDO Team is primarily responsible for data marketing operations including data delivery for the MSB cooperative's direct mail program, which sends more than 10 million+ solicitations annually on behalf of 50+ public media clients. Responsibilities

**Position Overview**

The Senior Data Marketing Solution Analyst builds and improves scalable omni-channel marketing data models, metadata frameworks, and process automations driven by marketing strategy and service requirements. This role’s work includes identifying opportunities to enhance existing model efficiency and design, test and implement new models that support evolving and growing CDP marketing strategy for the MSB Cooperative, AAP and Partner Services.

This role works closely with the Data Marketing Specialists on the BDO team to provide production data delivery and support coverage when needed and collaborates on data model development and process improvements. This role also partners with Quality Control to identify opportunities to automate manual processes and continually improve error rates.

Key Responsibilities:

* Translate marketing strategy, fundraising, and audience selection and segmentation requirements into reusable SQL code and components in Snowflake.
* Identify, develop and maintain workflow-based automations for repetitive, manual, high-volume, or error-prone processes involving data preparation, quality control, file generation and handling, and analysis, reducing manual effort without sacrificing data quality or operational controls.
* Design validation, exception handling, monitoring, alerts, and recovery procedures so automated processes remain reliable and supportable after implementation.
* Partner with service owners and business stakeholders to define data requirements, business rules, success measures, and acceptance criteria for new or enhanced models.
* Manage assigned data projects from discovery through implementation by defining scope, work plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, testing activities, and status communications, while coordinating across BDO, Marketing Strategy, Service Teams, Fundraising OPS, Tech Solutions, and other partners to keep initiatives aligned and moving forward.
* Explore unfamiliar datasets, identify appropriate tables and fields, and determine how data sources relate before developing outputs.
* Evaluate query logic and results for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and alignment with documented business rules; troubleshoot discrepancies by tracing query steps, comparing source records, and identifying likely causes.
* Assess query performance and make improvements to filters, joins, calculations, and query structure; escalate platform or pipeline issues when appropriate.
* Document reusable data sources, assumptions, query logic, business definitions, validation steps, known limitations and implementation decisions so work can be reviewed and reused.
* Communicate findings, risks, and data limitations clearly to marketing, operations, quality, and technical partners.

**Essential Functions**

* 40%: Data marketing model and framework development - design, test, document, and implement SQL-based models in Snowflake supporting audience selection, segmentation, quality control, reporting, reconciliation, and marketing operations needs across the MSB coop, AAP, and Partner Services.
* 25%: Process scale and automation - use Snowflake components, SQL, Python, and approved workflow tools to identify automation opportunities and design, implement, monitor, and continuously improve solutions that scale, reduce manual work, errors, and cycle time.
* 20%: Data delivery and quality control - provide coverage when needed for data delivery and production work. Research data questions, perform root cause analysis, validate model and automation outputs, troubleshoot discrepancies, and communicate findings and limitations.
* 15%: Collaboration and projects - participating in regular, ad-hoc and project meetings with Fundraising OPS, Marketing, Tech Solutions, and other cross functional teams, including the database conversion team and other data working groups. Participate in planning sessions for on-boarding new stations, campaign kick-offs, vendor and client interfacing (as applicable), and production meetings

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Demonstrated ability and hands-on experience working with large data sets to build audience selection, segmentation, a/b split logic and integrating scoring data for omni-channel marketing campaigns including text, email, direct mail, phone, and canvassing, and outcome analysis.
* Demonstrated ability and hands-on experience independently writing complex SQL queries; experience must extend beyond executing or making minor edits to prewritten scripts.  
  Expertise building and using views, models, relational data structures, procedures, notebooks, and functions effectively employing joins, common table expressions, subqueries, aggregate and window functions, conditional logic, data-type handling and other SQL techniques.
* Demonstrated ability and hands-on experience writing, testing, troubleshooting, and maintaining Python scripts for data file manipulation, including structured file handling, validation, logging, and error handling.
* Experience identifying process-automation opportunities and converting current-state workflows into clearly defined future-state requirements and maintainable solutions.
* Ability to design automation controls and assess results using validation, exception handling, monitoring, alerts, recovery procedures, effort saved, error reduction, cycle time, adoption, reliability, and increased service capacity.
* Demonstrated project-management skills, including requirements gathering, scope definition, work planning, milestone tracking, risk and dependency management, testing coordination, and status reporting.
* Ability to lead cross-functional work without direct authority and move projects from an ambiguous business need to an implemented, documented solution.
* Experience validating output from large data sets through record-level review, reconciliations, control totals, and comparison to business requirements.
* Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate ambiguous data questions.
* Ability to translate nontechnical requirements into query logic, explain data output analysis and conclusions to business stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail and proven ability to prioritize multiple requests in a deadline-driven environment.
* Clear written documentation practices and an organized approach to query files, definitions, assumptions, and revisions.
* Proficiency with Microsoft tools such as Excel, Word, Teams, Outlook, and SharePoint.
* Ability to work effectively in a remote environment with minimal direct supervision.

**Preferred Qualifications (Not Required)**

* Experience using Snowflake tools and features like Workspaces and Notebooks.
* Experience with digital marketing tools like Iterable.
* Experience working with fundraising, direct mail, donor analytics, and nonprofit data.
* Experience working with fundraising CRMs such as RevolutionCRM, Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud, Raiser's Edge, or a similar platform.
* Experience with reporting or analysis tools such as Tableau and advanced Excel functionality.
* Experience supporting new or growing data-enabled services, products, or operational programs.
* Experience automating recurring data preparation, validation, reporting, file generation, or operational workflows.
* Familiarity with DBT, GitHub, scheduling tools, APIs, or other modern data and automation tools sufficient to develop governed analytical models and controlled workflows; software engineering expertise is not required.
* Experience using project-management tools such as Asana and maintaining clear project plans, decision logs, or status reports.
* Passion for supporting the mission of public media and nonprofit organizations.

**Role Boundaries:**

The Senior Data Marketing Solution Analyst owns query-based analysis, SQL-based analytical data models, Python-enabled process automation, data marketing framework development and projects for assigned data marketing initiatives. The role is expected to recommend, develop, and implement improvements within the analytical and operational workflow layers using approved tools. It is not expected to build or administer enterprise source-data pipelines, manage Snowflake infrastructure, define enterprise architecture, or own database security. Those responsibilities remain with the appropriate technical teams, with whom this role partners closely.

**Educational Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant work experience.

**Commitment to Inclusion**

We value diverse perspectives, lived experiences, and commitment to public service. All CDP people have unique talents and experiences that create our company culture where we can all thrive and bring our whole selves to work each day.

* Partner with Operations, Account Management, Product, IT, and Data management teams to align data solutions with business needs
* Apply critical thinking to identify root causes of issues and recommend practical, data-backed solutions
* Ensure accuracy and reliability of all analyses through thorough validation and quality checks

Role Overview:

The Quality Data Analyst turns quality data into decisions. This role analyzes the company’s quality data, including warranty return rates, customer feedback, product reviews, and factory operational KPIs, to identify trends, uncover root causes, and drive improvements in products, operational processes, and business strategy.

Working closely with Quality, Engineering, Operations, Customer Service, and Supply Chain teams, the analyst builds dashboards that give clear visibility into how current systems and products are performing, designs experiments to determine the best configurations or operational changes, and applies predictive modeling to improve customer experience, operational excellence, and other business outcomes. The analyst tracks quality performance over time and delivers clear, data-backed recommendations to stakeholders at every level of the organization.

Key Responsibilities:

**Data analysis and preparation**

* Collect, combine, and analyze quality data from multiple sources, such as warranty claims, returns and RMA records, customer service tickets, product reviews, factory inspection results, and supplier data.
* Review data structures and identify errors, inconsistencies, and gaps before analysis begins.
* Clean and prepare data by correcting errors, removing duplicates, and handling missing values, documenting each step so results are repeatable.
* Identify trends, patterns, and outliers in failure modes, defect rates, and return reasons, and dig into the root causes behind them.

**Validation and testing**

* Run validation checks to confirm data meets business rules and quality standards.
* Build and maintain automated data quality checks so issues are caught early rather than discovered in reports.
* Design and run experiments (A/B tests, process trials, design-of-experiments studies) to evaluate proposed product or operational changes and measure their impact.

**Dashboard development and reporting**

* Develop and maintain dashboards that give leadership and cross-functional teams real-time visibility into quality performance, from the factory floor to the customer’s hands.
* Automate recurring reports (weekly, monthly, and quarterly quality reviews) to reduce manual work and improve accuracy.
* Translate complex findings into clear, concise summaries and visuals for both technical and non-technical audiences.

**KPI monitoring and predictive analytics**

* Track key quality metrics such as warranty return rates, customer returns, defect rates, first-pass yield, and other operational KPIs, and flag negative trends early.
* Build predictive models to forecast warranty exposure, anticipate emerging product issues, and support proactive decisions that improve customer experience and operational excellence.
* Set baselines and targets for quality KPIs in partnership with Quality and Operations leadership.

**Cross-functional collaboration and continuous improvement**

* Partner with Engineering, Operations, and suppliers to investigate quality issues and support corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Share insights from customer feedback and field returns with Product Development to inform future designs.
* Provide data-driven recommendations and follow up to measure whether implemented changes delivered the expected results.

Qualifications:

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience in data analytics, preferably in consumer goods, consumer electronics, or a related industry.
* Strong proficiency in SQL, plus experience with a scripting or programming language (such as Python or R) for data analysis.
* Hands-on experience with data visualization tools (such as Power BI or Tableau) and building dashboards for business users.
* Solid knowledge of statistical techniques and concepts (regression, probability distributions, hypothesis testing and their proper use) and experience applying them to real business problems.
* Experience working in a fulfillment, production, or other operational environment.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with strong attention to detail.

**Preferred**

* Familiarity with quality tools and methodologies such as Six Sigma, Statistical Process Control (SPC), 8D, or root cause analysis.
* Experience analyzing warranty, returns, or customer feedback data, including text analysis of reviews or service tickets.
* Experience with predictive modeling or machine learning techniques.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment and to work independently.

description:

Department: Information Technology | Reports to: Reporting and Analytics Manager

Onsite Monday – Thursday (Remote Friday) 8:30AM – 4:30PM CT

**Position Summary**

NANI is seeking a Data Reporting Analyst to develop, maintain, and improve reporting and analytics that support clinical care, operations, finance, reimbursement, auditing, and management. This position works with data from multiple electronic health record (EHR) systems, databases, and data warehouses to deliver accurate, timely, and actionable information.

The successful candidate will use SQL, Microsoft Power BI, and Excel to build reports, interactive dashboards, data extracts, and automated reporting processes. This is a hands-on role with accountability for data quality, stakeholder communication, and dependable delivery, with an emphasis on reducing manual reporting and improving access to current information.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Reporting and dashboard development: Develop and maintain clinical, operational, financial, reimbursement, auditing, and management reports. Build interactive Power BI dashboards and Excel-based analytical tools that help teams monitor performance and make informed decisions.
* Data extraction and integration: Write and maintain SQL queries, stored procedures, views, and extraction processes. Combine and reconcile information from Epic, NextGen, athenahealth, SQL Server, and other available data sources.
* Clinical and coding analysis: Analyze patient populations, providers, encounters, diagnoses, procedures, laboratory results, and medication records. Incorporate ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS, and relevant medication classifications into reporting logic; evaluate laboratory dates and values and medication names, brands, and classifications.
* Business requirements and delivery: Partner with clinical, operational, billing, reimbursement, auditing, finance, and management teams to define reporting needs, business rules, and acceptance criteria. Prioritize requests, communicate progress, and deliver against agreed deadlines.
* Data quality and troubleshooting: Validate results, reconcile source-system differences, and investigate discrepancies in clinical, laboratory, medication, billing, reimbursement, and encounter data. Resolve reporting, database, and application issues with the appropriate teams.
* Automation and standardization: Automate recurring reports and data-processing workflows, improve refresh processes, and reduce manual effort. Maintain consistent definitions and update reports as business, clinical, and regulatory requirements change.
* Quality and performance analytics: Identify trends in outcomes, utilization, cost of care, reimbursement, and operational performance. Support value-based care, population health, and quality reporting, including Kidney Care Choices (KCC) reporting when applicable.
* Documentation and change readiness: Document data sources, calculations, business rules, SQL logic, and reporting processes. Test and validate reporting impacts from EHR, database, interface, and process changes; provide backup for critical reports and reporting-team responsibilities.
* Privacy and security: Protect confidential information and protected health information (PHI). Follow HIPAA and NANI requirements for data access, handling, storage, and sharing.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience in healthcare reporting and data analysis using EHR systems such as Epic, NextGen, and athenahealth, including large datasets from multiple sources.
* Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, subqueries, transformations, stored procedures, and validation; experience with Microsoft SQL Server or a comparable relational database platform.
* Experience developing Microsoft Power BI reports and dashboards, along with strong Excel skills in PivotTables, formulas, data analysis, and data manipulation.
* Experience reporting on laboratory and medication data, with an understanding of patient, provider, encounter, diagnosis, procedure, scheduling, billing, reimbursement, and operational information.
* Working knowledge of ICD-10, CPT, and HCPCS coding systems and their application to healthcare reporting and analysis.
* Demonstrated ability to validate data, reconcile differences across source systems, investigate root causes, and deliver accurate reporting solutions.
* Ability to translate business questions into reporting requirements and explain findings clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities independently and collaboratively.
* Knowledge of HIPAA requirements and appropriate handling of PHI and confidential healthcare information.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Epic Caboodle certification; experience with Epic Caboodle or Clarity data; additional Epic reporting and analytics certifications or proficiencies.
* Experience with nephrology billing and coding, healthcare claims, reimbursement, revenue cycle, or auditing.
* Familiarity with value-based care and the Kidney Care Choices (KCC) Model, including quality measures, population health, patient outcomes, utilization, cost of care, and performance monitoring.
* Familiarity with Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) codes, medication terminology, generic and brand drug names, and drug classification systems.
* Experience integrating or reconciling data across Epic, NextGen, and athenahealth; experience with ETL processes, enterprise data warehouses, and data pipelines.
* Advanced Power BI skills in data modeling and DAX; experience automating recurring reporting and data-processing workflows.
* Experience with Visual Basic or VB.NET, Python, or Microsoft Visual Studio for reporting tools, application development, or automation.
* Bachelor’s degree in information systems, computer science, data analytics, healthcare informatics, business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

**Measures of Success**

Performance will be evaluated against agreed baselines and priorities, with an emphasis on reliable reporting and practical business outcomes:

* Accurate, validated reports and dashboards delivered within agreed timelines.
* Reduced manual reporting effort through automation and standardized processes.
* Reliable data refreshes and timely investigation and resolution of discrepancies.
* Clear request ownership, stakeholder communication, and documentation of reporting logic.
* Reports and dashboards that meet stakeholder needs and support clinical, operational, financial, and quality decisions.

**Work Expectations**

Work independently and collaboratively with clinical, business, and technology teams. Maintain ownership of assigned requests, provide backup for critical reporting processes, and follow NANI privacy and security requirements. Continue developing knowledge of healthcare systems, analytics tools, coding, medication classifications, and value-based care reporting.

**Compensation and HR Finalization**

Annual base salary: $75,000–$82,000 USD, depending on relevant experience, certifications, and qualifications.

Since our founding 2012, APTNEXUS has empowered federal agencies and commercial enterprises to navigate the complexities of the digital landscape. As a quality-driven small business, we specialize in the seamless delivery of IT modernization and elite cybersecurity solutions. We help our clients modernize and fortify their technology stacks —ensuring their most critical data and assets remain resilient, optimized, and secure in an evolving threat environment.

**Clearance:**

Ability to obtain and maintain a Minimum Background Investigation (MBI) for our Department of Treasury customer. **Candidates must reside in, and perform all work from, the continental United States or its outlying territories.**

**Location:**

Remote (United States)

**Work Schedule:**

Full-time, remote. Must be available during core business hours (Eastern Time) to support team meetings and stakeholder working sessions. Occasional travel may be required.

**Salary Range:**

$65,000 to $80,000 annually, commensurate with experience

**Position Overview:**

AptNexus is seeking a Business Data Analyst to support a risk analytics team within a cybersecurity compliance program for our Department of Treasury customer. The team maintains a risk-based model that prioritizes which government partner organizations receive compliance reviews. In this role, you will bridge the customer and the analytics team by gathering and documenting requirements, maintaining the team’s work plan, supporting planning meetings, validating data, and keeping dashboards current. The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented self-starter with a business or finance background, strong writing skills, and a growing interest in data analytics.

**Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Gather, document, and track business requirements for risk model and dashboard enhancements, working with customer stakeholders and the Senior Data Analyst.
* Develop, maintain, and update the team’s work plan, defining tasks, owners, and deliverable deadlines as priorities change.
* Schedule and coordinate quarterly planning meetings, prepare and distribute meeting materials in advance, and document discussions, decisions, and action items.
* Track action items and enhancement requests through completion, and report status to the team.
* Validate the accuracy of automated data outputs and rankings, and research and resolve discrepancies.
* Maintain and update risk dashboards and reports, and prepare clear summaries for stakeholders.
* Maintain data definitions, process documentation, and user guides.
* Format and quality check deliverables for accuracy, consistency, and conformance with customer templates.
* Comply with all customer security, privacy, and records management requirements, using only Government-furnished equipment and approved systems.

**Required Skills**

* One to three years of experience in business analysis, data analysis, reporting, or a related role.
* Demonstrated experience in accounting or finance, gained through professional work or internships.
* Demonstrated experience in technical writing and document formatting, including requirements documents, plans, and meeting records.
* Experience gathering and documenting business requirements and translating stakeholder needs into clear specifications.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, and data validation; exposure to VBA is preferred.
* Experience with Tableau or another data visualization tool is preferred; familiarity with Python or R is a plus.
* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy when validating data and reviewing results.
* Detail-oriented self-starter who takes ownership of assignments, manages competing priorities, and drives work to completion with minimal supervision.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a professional and courteous approach to customer stakeholders.
* Sound professional judgment and integrity in handling sensitive information.
* Must meet federal eligibility requirements for a position of public trust, including U.S. citizenship or lawful permanent residency, federal tax compliance, Selective Service registration (if applicable), a credit check, and fingerprinting.
* Must complete customer-required security awareness training upon onboarding and annually thereafter.

**Education Requirement:**

Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, economics, or business from an accredited college or university.

***AptNexus*** ***is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.***

description:
**How You'll Make An Impact**

At Strive Health, patients come first. We're on a mission to transform chronic conditions by identifying risk earlier, coordinating thoughtful care, and supporting people through every stage of their health journey.

Our work reduces emergency visits, improves outcomes, and helps patients live fuller lives. You'll work alongside passionate Strivers who care deeply about making an impact, show up for one another as One Team, and find ways to elevate the everyday.

If you're looking for meaningful work where your contributions truly matter, you'll feel right at home at Strive!

**Benefits & Perks**

* **Hybrid-Remote Flexibility** –Work from home while fulfilling in-person needs at the office, clinic, or patient home visits.
* **Comprehensive Benefits** – Medical, dental, and vision insurance, employee assistance programs, employer-paid and voluntary life and disability insurance, plus health and flexible spending accounts.
* **Financial & Retirement Support** – Competitive compensation with a performance-based bonus program, 401k with employer match, and financial wellness resources.
* **Time Off & Leave** – Paid holidays, vacation time, sick time, and paid birthgiving, bonding, sabbatical, and living donor leaves.
* **Wellness & Growth** – Family forming services through Maven Maternity at no cost and physical wellness perks, mental health support, and an annual professional development stipend.

To learn more about our offerings, click **here**.

**What You'll Do**

The Senior Data Analyst will work across the organization to support new and ongoing initiatives. This person will join a highly experienced and passionate team and will play a key role in defining the future of the organization. The analyst's primary focus will be Enterprise-wide and operational performance analytics, including clinical performance and outcomes measurement, developing and maintaining key performance indicators (KPIs), building dashboards for executive, operational, and clinical leaders, identifying trends and opportunities for improvement, and supporting cross-functional initiatives with data-driven insights.

The analyst will work closely with operational and clinical leadership, Market Stakeholders, and the broader Technology team to develop a robust suite of analytics that supports clinical decision-making, quality improvement, and value-based care performance.

**Essential Functions**

* Develop and maintain key performance indicators (KPIs) using SQL and enterprise data sources to support strategic, operational, and clinical decision-making.
* Design, build, and manage dashboards that provide actionable insights to medical directors, clinical teams, and operational leaders across the organization.
* Partner with operational stakeholders to evaluate the effectiveness of Strive's operating models, including patient engagement, scheduling, visits, productivity, and risk adjustment.
* Conduct root cause analysis to investigate data anomalies, performance trends, clinical variation, and operational variation, delivering clear, data-backed recommendations.
* Collaborate with technical teams to troubleshoot data pipeline and quality issues, ensuring accurate, timely, and reliable reporting used in clinical and operational contexts.
* Maintain clear, accessible documentation of metrics definitions, data sources, and dashboard logic to support transparency, consistency, and knowledge transfer, including alignment on clinical definitions and assumptions.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree with strong academic achievement.
* Located in Denver.
* 4+ years' experience in healthcare data analysis.
* Internet Connectivity - Min Speeds: 3.8Mbps/3.0Mbps (up/down): Latency <60 ms.
* Ability to travel and be onsite to meet business needs.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Working knowledge of analyzing medical claims, lab data, EMR data, and other clinical data sources to assess quality, utilization, and outcomes.
* High degree of proficiency in Microsoft SQL, Excel, PowerPoint, and visualization tools.
* Entrepreneurial spirit and comfort in ambiguity; a self-starter. Desire to work in a start-up environment. Previous experience at a start-up is a plus.
* Experience supporting physicians, medical directors, or clinical leaders with analytics is a plus.

**Annual Salary Range: $85,500 - $104,000. This position is also eligible for a target annual bonus of 10%.**

Final compensation will be determined based on location, experience, and qualifications.

description:
**Our Mission:** **Hospital-Quality Care, Everywhere.**
=======================================================

The healthcare industry still relies on faxes and phone tags to coordinate critical care for patients at home. We think patients and the clinicians who serve them deserve better than a system stuck in 1995.

Verse Medical is building the modern software infrastructure to make it happen. We're a well-funded Series C company (backed by General Catalyst, SignalFire, and Sapphire Ventures) on a mission to heal a fragmented system. Our platform connects the dots between providers, payors, and patients, ensuring people get the high-quality care they need, reliably and right where they live. We’re growing fast and looking for people who are driven by this mission to join us!

**Our Values:** **The Principles That Guide Us**
================================================

Our values are the operating system for how we work together and with our partners. They aren't just words on a wall; they are the principles we bring to every decision, every day.

* **We are transparent, upfront and direct.** We operate with honesty and clarity. We share information openly, the good and the bad, and believe that direct, respectful feedback is the foundation of trust and progress.
* **We value speed of iteration.** We are building something new, which means we learn by doing. We prioritize rapid iteration and getting solutions into the hands of users, believing that progress is more valuable than perfection.
* **We give 110% effort, 30% of the time.** We are passionate about our mission, and there are moments that require us to go the extra mile. We believe in focused intensity when it counts, balanced by a sustainable pace that keeps our team energized for the long run.
* **We empathize with customers to a fault.** When our users face a problem, we own it. Instead of asking them to change, we ask ourselves, *"How can we make this better?"* We believe true innovation comes from deep empathy and a relentless focus on solving the real-world challenges of healthcare.

We’re hiring a **Data Analyst** to turn Verse's data into decisions. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role where you'll partner directly with functional leaders to build the metrics, dashboards, and analyses that drive how the business operates. Not only are you offering the “what,” but also the “why” and the “what now,” translating messy, ambiguous business questions into clear, defensible, self-serve analytical assets.

If you enjoy high ownership, solving open-ended business problems with data, and having direct influence on a mission-driven company’s trajectory, this role is for you.

**What You'll Achieve: A Glimpse into Your Contributions**
==========================================================

* Spearhead end-to-end analytics across business domains.
* Understand trends in operational and customer data to influence how teams prioritize their own roadmaps

* Partner with cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Ops, Product, Leadership) to define new metrics, standardize reporting, and surface insights proactively.
* Automate recurring reporting and manual data-quality checks using Python and SQL, reducing turnaround time on regular audits and deliverables.
* Design and build algorithms/models (e.g., scoring, classification, similarity, or risk-adjustment models) that solve specific business problems, from provider mapping to fraud detection to cost-of-care scoring.

**What You'll Bring: The Skills and Experience You’ll Leverage**
================================================================

We believe that diverse experiences and backgrounds lead to better solutions. While we have an idea of what will help someone succeed in this role, we are open to being convinced by your unique story and skills. If you believe you can achieve the outcomes above, we encourage you to apply.

**Core Skills & Experience:**

* 3+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or analytics engineering, with experience owning reporting and metrics end-to-end.
* Strong experience writing SQL and Python for analysis, automation, and lightweight modeling
* Experience building and driving adoption of dashboards (Metabase, Looker Tableau, PowerBI, or similar)
* Experience developing custom metrics, scoring algorithms, or classification models to solve specific business problems.
* Experience performing exploratory analysis with minimal direction on ambiguous, open-ended business questions
* Proactive communicator with experience working with stakeholders
* **Preferred**: Experience with dbt modeling.
* **Preferred**: Experience with Snowflake.
* **Preferred**: Familiarity with healthcare or other regulated data (HIPAA compliance).
* **Preferred:** Experience working closely with engineers to triage and resolve issues.

**Benefits:**
-------------

* Competitive compensation.
* Opportunities for rapid career advancement in a growing company.
* 100% premium coverage for health insurance.
* 401(k) with no matching at this time.

*This is a hybrid role based in our New York office and will require you to be in the office 4x in a week.*

**Our Pledge for an Equitable Future**
======================================

At Verse Medical, our mission is to deliver equitable, hospital-quality care to everyone, regardless of their background or where they live. We can only achieve this if our own team reflects the diversity of the patients we serve. We are committed to building a workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, where their contributions are valued, and where they can do their best work. We embrace diversity of all kinds: race, gender, age, religion, identity, experience. We are actively working to build a more inclusive and equitable world, starting from within our own walls. We are an equal opportunity employer.

We are also committed to providing a positive and accessible interview experience. If you require any accommodations to participate in our process, please contact us at recruiting@versemedical.com.

LexisNexis® Risk Solutions provides customers with solutions and decision tools that combine public and industry specific content with advanced technology and analytics to assist them in evaluating and predicting risk and enhancing operational efficiency. We use the power of data and advanced analytics to help our customers make better, timelier decisions. By bringing clarity to information, we ultimately help make communities safer, insurance rates more accurate, commerce more transparent, business decisions easier and processes more efficient. Data Insight is a team that consists of two unique groups. The Data Questions Group and the Data Evaluation Team. The Data Questions Group is responsible for answering nearly 2K questions monthly from across of all of RISK. We provide solutions to a variety of data questions and data linking concerns. The Data Evaluation team reviews and analyzes test data from vendors to ensure the data is unique, relevant, and provides lift to our organization’s products. description:
**About the Organization**

Now is a great time to join Redhorse Corporation. We are a solution-driven company delivering data insights and technology solutions to customers with missions critical to U.S. national interests. We’re looking for thoughtful, skilled professionals who thrive as trusted partners building technology-agnostic solutions and want to apply their talents supporting customers with difficult and important mission sets.

### **About the Role**

Redhorse transforms the way government uses data and technology. To support this vital mission, we are seeking an IT Business Analyst – National Security Systems to provide Executive Staff-level support to the FBI National Security Branch (NSB) and senior priority technology programs.

In this role, you will be the critical link connecting operational field agents, legal authorities, and software engineering teams. You will drive enterprise systems modernization, conduct business process re-engineering (BPR), and lead Agile requirements engineering for foundational national security systems—including FISA platforms, National Security Letter (NSL) applications, the National Data Review Repository (NDRR), and Sentinel. Your efforts will directly optimize legal-process workflows, ensure technological alignment with mission needs, and accelerate the delivery of mission-critical software capabilities.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Support end-to-end national security systems development, including FISA, NSL, and NDRR project management, user requirements elicitation, system architecture design, data conversion, technical documentation, training, and deployment.
* Drive strategic planning and business process re-engineering (BPR) to modernize legacy IT systems across the federal intelligence and law enforcement communities.
* Define, validate, and document detailed business and functional requirements gathered through stakeholder interviews, technical workshops, and system documentation.
* Assess existing software systems and monitor ongoing development efforts to evaluate technical risks, identify cost-saving opportunities, and recommend system consolidations or retirements.
* Interface with the Department of Justice (DOJ), FBI Headquarters, and field office stakeholders to collect, track, and manage operational requirements for enterprise IT capabilities.
* Produce national security business and technical documentation for FISA systems, Sentinel legal process tools, and collection applications—including Agile user stories, acceptance criteria, use cases, CONOPS, cost-benefit analyses, privacy impact assessments, operating models, workflow diagrams, and SOPs.
* Manage Agile product backlogs in Jira by decomposing complex technical and operational problems into clear, prioritized user stories with defined acceptance criteria.
* Support IT project planning, integrated master schedules, and milestone execution to ensure predictable, on-time software delivery.
* Author high-level position papers, briefing books, executive presentation decks, training curricula, talking points, and Power BI dashboards under tight deadlines for NSB IT lifecycle reviews.
* Provide expert technical support, user guidance, and troubleshooting for NSB Technical Bridge applications (FISA, NSLs, NDRRs) and collaborate with back-end engineering teams to resolve operational issues.
* Deliver polished oral briefings and written status reports to FBI executive leadership regarding current IT initiatives and system roadmaps.

### **Required Experience/Clearance**

* 5+ years of experience in national security IT requirements management (development, review, and analysis), systems development, systems management, or IT business analysis.
* 5+ years of experience with U.S. national security operations, U.S. Intelligence Community (USIC) mission sets, national security policy frameworks, and case management workflows.
* 3+ years of experience authoring technical documentation and presenting system architectures, functional requirements, and methodologies to executive-level government audiences.
* 2+ years of experience operating within a federal interagency environment, collaborating with multiple U.S. government departments and agencies on joint IT programs.
* 2+ years of experience managing multiple high-visibility tasks in fast-paced environments and building consensus across diverse stakeholder groups with competing priorities.
* 2+ years of demonstrated experience translating complex technical IT concepts into clear, actionable language for non-technical leadership.
* 2+ years of demonstrated experience taking initiative, leading in place, and operating independently with minimal guidance.
* 2+ years of hands-on experience utilizing Atlassian Jira, Microsoft Project, Excel, Power BI, PowerPoint, Word, and SharePoint.
* Active Top Secret (TS) security clearance with SCI eligibility and willingness to undergo an FBI suitability determination/polygraph.

### **Desired Experience**

We encourage all candidates who meet the basic requirements to apply, even if you do not have any of the following experience:

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Information Technology, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related analytical/computational field.
* Professional certifications such as Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Project Management Professional (PMP/CAPM), ITIL, or Agile Product Owner.
* Specialized experience supporting FBI operational programs and enterprise case management systems such as Sentinel, FISAMS, or DIVS.
* Direct experience briefing Senior Executive Service (SES) and executive management audiences on technology roadmaps and enterprise IT governance.
