**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.**

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

### **Department Overview**

The AI for Business Functions organization uses data science, machine learning, sophisticated analytics, and AI technologies to address intricate business issues across functions such as Finance, Sales, Supply Chain, and Operations. The team transforms data into actionable insights, develops intelligent solutions, and drives data-driven decision-making through predictive analytics, optimization, and AI-enabled technologies.

### **Position Overview**

As a Data Scientist Intern, you will work with business partners and data science professionals to develop analytical solutions that address real-world business challenges. You will apply statistical modeling, machine learning, optimization techniques, and generative AI technologies to analyze data, generate insights, and support strategic decision-making across the enterprise.

### **Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with business partners to understand requirements and develop data-driven solutions that address complex business challenges.
* Design, develop, and implement predictive models, forecasting solutions, machine learning algorithms, and statistical analyses.
* Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, risks, opportunities, and actionable business insights.
* Apply generative AI, large language models (LLMs), optimization techniques, and simulation models to improve decision-making and business outcomes.
* Develop visualizations, reports, and presentations that communicate analytical findings and recommendations to partners.

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* 0–2 years of relevant experience through coursework, internships, research projects, academic projects, hackathons, or data science competitions.
* Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
* Experience using Python and common analytics libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar tools.
* Knowledge of statistical modeling, machine learning, data mining, data visualization, and analytical problem-solving techniques.
* Experience using SQL and AI-enabled technologies, including generative AI and large language models (LLMs), to support data analysis, business insights, or solution development.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with cloud platforms such as Snowflake, Google Cloud, AWS, Azure, or similar environments.
* Familiarity with predictive analytics, forecasting, optimization, simulation modeling, or machine learning solution development.
* Experience applying generative AI, LLMs, prompt engineering, AI agents, or AI-assisted analytics within business contexts.
* Knowledge of data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Plotly, or similar platforms.
* Strong communication, presentation, and partner engagement skills with the ability to translate technical findings into business recommendations.

This position is based at our headquarters in Mooresville, North Carolina. Our corporate office is a space where you can collaborate and do your best work. Take a walk, grab a bite (or a cup of coffee), work out or get a check-up – we invest in you so you can find your inspiration.

The role will analyze large data sets to isolate trend and business opportunities, conduct advanced modeling and build solutions and recommendations to drive performance improvement for Environmental Health and Safety. The Safety Data Science Consultant will also be responsible for developing and delivering effective, interactive presentations and reporting solutions for operational/front line leaders and associates. This position is also responsible for identifying opportunities and coordinating projects across EH&S. Being a subject matter expert in advance statistical, econometric and quantitative analytical techniques, the Safety Data Science Consultant will play a pivotal role in enhancing the cohesive collaboration of EH&S across the enterprise. This position will be required to work some weekends due to data reporting needs.  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Analyze the fundamental components of problems and communicate the correct course of action to the team and the resolution to the field.
* Develop and implement changes that improve overall store operations processes that are likely to add value to the stores’ bottom line. Manage/drive core store operations projects and/or process improvements.
* Manage day to day processes related to their areas of responsibility. Create and maintain project work plans.
* Manage issues and roadblocks that arise related to their area of responsibility.
* Provides real-time information and guidance to stores and AP teams requiring assistance with day-to-day procedural questions.
* Assists Manager with development of process improvement solutions based on field feedback.
* Leverages customer facing technology to improve productivity and efficiency.
* Executes the process of documenting policies, procedures, and processes for new store initiatives.
* Administrator and supports Safety software systems

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree Business, Management, Operations, Technology, or related field or equivalent years of experience in lieu of education requirement, if applicable
* 2 Years R Software, Tableau, PowerBi
* 3-5 Years Experience in data analytics

$102,400 - $199,700

description:
The University of Tennessee's Office of Innovative Technologies is seeking a Senior Research Consultant to lead the design, execution, and analysis of research projects in support of faculty and graduate researchers across campus. This senior-level, highly independent role spans the full research lifecycle from developing research questions and experimental designs, determining appropriate statistical/machine learning methods and calculating sample sizes, to conducting data analysis, interpreting results, and co-authoring and, where appropriate, leading or serving as senior author on manuscripts for peer-reviewed journals. The position also partners with investigators to lead the development of grant proposals, including research design and analysis plans, including power and sample size calculations. The position also solves complex computing problems by selecting and configuring appropriate software and hardware, writing and debugging code, mentoring colleagues through workshops and one-on-one consultations on advanced statistical and computing methods, and managing university research software licensing.

The ideal candidate holds a master's degree (Ph.D. preferred) and seven or more years of experience as a statistician, data scientist, or research analyst, with a record of peer-reviewed publications. The candidate will also possess strong programming and analytical skills across tools such as R, Python, SAS, SPSS, Stata, MATLAB, ArcGIS and JMP along with deep knowledge of statistical methodology, data visualization, and the mathematical foundations underlying advanced analytic techniques. This role carries significant influence over departmental research strategy and direction, serves as backup for the manager when needed, requires occasional overnight travel, and operates with a high degree of autonomy, consulting with a supervisor primarily on priorities and complex or high-impact matters.

  

This position will be responsible for assisting researchers with experimental design, sampling and data collection methods, and sample size determination; managing and restructuring research data, including identifying and correcting data errors; and performing statistical analysis, machine learning, including creating data visualizations and graphics to communicate results according to journal standards. The role also involves writing and editing methods and results sections of manuscripts, grant proposals, and client documentation on statistical computing, including defending analytic approaches to journal reviewers; and helping clients select appropriate computer software and hardware to solve their research problems. The position leads the development of the methods and analysis components of grant proposals and may serve as lead statistician on funded research projects.

In addition, the position develops and teaches workshops and one-on-one tutorials on research computing and statistical methods, acts as a subject matter expert in statistics and computing topics for diverse clientele across campus, and manages university software site licenses, including installation, testing, and documentation. The position also takes an active role mentoring and critiquing the work of students and colleagues, providing guidance on complex statistical and computing problems, and contributes to departmental budgetary, research funding, and compliance discussions.

description:
**About Coinflow**

Coinflow is the next-generation payment service provider revolutionizing global financial infrastructure with stablecoins, AI-driven fraud prevention, and instant settlement. Coinflow enables businesses to grow faster with instant settlement, fraud & chargeback indemnity, global pay-ins, multi-currency FX, and unified payouts. Since our seed round in 2024, we’ve achieved 23x revenue growth and scaled to multi-billion-dollar annual transaction volume. In response to this growth, Coinflow announced a $25M Series A in October 2025—led by Pantera Capital, CMT Digital, Coinbase Ventures, Jump Crypto, and Reciprocal Ventures—accelerating our mission to power the world’s fastest-moving businesses with innovative, reliable global payments.

Coinflow is proudly headquartered in Chicago, IL. Learn more at coinflow.cash.

**About The Role**
------------------

We're hiring a Fraud Data Scientist to be the analytical brain behind our fraud models. You'll dig into how our models and rules are performing, spot where fraud is shifting, and tell the team exactly which features, signals, and strategy changes will move the numbers.

You'll work on fraud across card, bank, and alternative payment rails, for merchants in gaming, marketplaces, remittance, and ecommerce, where fraud patterns shift weekly. You'll partner closely with the engineers who build and deploy our models, plus risk operations and compliance, turning data into decisions they can act on. You'll be hands-on with AI-native tooling as a force multiplier for analysis, feature exploration, and experimentation.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

**Model Performance Analysis:** Track how our fraud models and rules perform over time and by merchant segment. Dig into approval rates, fraud loss, false positives, and drift, and explain what changed and why.

**Fraud Trend Analysis:** Spot emerging patterns early, from fraud rings and account takeover to card testing, friendly fraud, and bonus abuse. Size the impact and get ahead of it before it shows up in chargebacks.

**Feature Recommendations:** Explore transaction, device, behavioral, identity, and network data to find new signals. Prototype and validate features, then hand engineering a clear, evidence-backed case for what to add to the models.

**Label Quality & Feedback Loops:** Own the ground truth. Make sense of delayed and noisy labels from chargebacks, disputes, and manual review, and flag where bad labels are misleading the models.

**Experimentation & Evaluation:** Design and analyze backtests, shadow tests, and champion/challenger experiments. Evaluate third-party fraud vendors against our own models on our data, and give a clear answer on what to trust.

**Rules & Strategy:** Partner with risk operations to tune thresholds, rules, and step-up authentication. Recommend decision strategies per merchant segment and quantify the tradeoff between loss and approvals.

**Reporting & Explainability:** Turn analysis into clear reporting for leadership, merchants, banks, and auditors: what drives model decisions, how performance is trending, and what we're doing about it.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 4+ years as a data scientist or analyst working on fraud, risk, or abuse, ideally at a payments company, fintech, or marketplace
* You've used analysis to measurably improve production fraud models or rules: new features, better thresholds, lower loss, higher approvals
* Strong SQL and Python. Fluent with the stats and ML concepts behind fraud models (gradient-boosted trees, calibration, imbalanced data) even if you're not the one deploying them
* Solid grasp of the fraud problem space: card-not-present fraud, account takeover, card testing, friendly fraud, chargeback reason codes, and how fraudsters adapt
* Comfort with messy, imbalanced, delayed-label data and the judgment to evaluate model performance honestly on it
* Experience designing and analyzing experiments where a false positive and a false negative cost very different amounts
* A strong feature intuition: you can look at a fraud pattern and propose the signal that would have caught it
* Ability to explain model behavior and tradeoffs to merchants, risk ops, banks, and auditors in plain language
* Familiarity with graph or network analysis for detecting linked accounts and fraud rings is a plus
* Comfort working with AI-native tooling as a daily driver, or genuine excitement to start
* A bias toward action. We'd rather have a clear recommendation this week than a perfect analysis next quarter

The base salary range for this role is $120,000 - $180,000 USD + equity. The actual base salary offered depends on a variety of factors, including but not limited to experience, education, skills, qualifications, and business needs.

Join the team rewriting how money moves worldwide—and become a driving force in the $194 trillion cross-border payments market.

description:
Overview:

Systems Planning and Analysis, Inc. (SPA) delivers high-impact, technical solutions to complex national security issues. With over 50 years of business expertise and consistent growth, we are known for continuous innovation for our government customers, in both the US and abroad. Our exceptionally talented team is highly collaborative in spirit and practice, producing *Results that Matter*. Come work with the best! We offer opportunity, unique challenges, and clear-sighted commitment to the mission. SPA: Objective. Responsive. Trusted.

Veracity Forecasting Portfolio (VF) is part of the Sea, Land, Air Division within Systems Planning and Analysis, Inc. Our unique processes result in authoritative, data-driven analyses that assist enterprise managers with complex decision making. We offer our customers proven expertise in descriptive, predictive, and prescriptive analytics; advanced mathematics and computational techniques (a.k.a. data science); and software engineering. Our mission is to help enterprise leaders make complex, fully informed decisions and save money in the process.

SPA has an immediate need for a Data Scientist. This full-time position is based in Alexandria, Virginia. Opportunity for remote work in the DMV area. #KS

Responsibilities:

Everybody’s view of data science is a little different, and we are no exception. In our team, we view data science as a way of understanding “how the world works.” We make assumptions and models then use data of all sorts to validate or disprove them. Our customers ask tough questions about managing their multifaceted enterprises; we build and operate complex models and simulations to provide the answers that best address the decisions they face.

We don’t expect you to come in with all the subject matter expertise needed to completely understand the data analysis or to create models with the fidelity we require. We do expect you to get there quickly, though. We look for traits such as how you solve problems when you’re stuck. Do you look for creative ways to apply different techniques from tangential disciplines? Do you crack open a book and teach yourself how to do something new? Do you collaborate with your colleagues? If you take initiatives like these, you would fit in well with our team of analysts.

We would love to tell you that we spend all our time developing elaborate algorithms for regression, survival, kernel weighting, etc., but honestly, we spend a lot of time wrangling data. This includes combining data from disparate data systems, manipulating formats, and cleaning—all of which are required to make the modeling happen. For this critical work we need someone who is precise, efficient, and tenacious.

Qualifications:

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in physical science, engineering, or mathematics
* Demonstrated experience (minimum three years) in operations research or numerical analysis in a technical field
* Two+ years of professional experience using Python for scientific programming and mathematical modeling
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong analytic curiosity, attention to detail, and the desire to learn and apply new skills to projects
* Ability to work well with other technical and scientific professionals in a research environment
* U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance throughout employment

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Master’s Degree in physical science, engineering, or mathematics
* Department of Defense, U.S. Navy, or U.S. Air Force experience
* Active DoD Secret Clearance

As a data scientist, you’re excited at the prospect of unlocking the secrets held by a data set, and you’re fascinated by the possibilities presented by IoT, machine learning, and artificial intelligence. R0121951

10/29/2026

**Why USAA?**

At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.

Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.

We are proud to support active-duty military spouses. USAA roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs.

**The Opportunity**

  
  

We are seeking a dedicated Data Scientist II (Mid Level) – Pricing and Product Analytics.

  
  

We have multiple remote-eligible opportunities available on our Auto and Property Data Science teams that build loss, acquisition, retention, and lifetime value models.

This role is remote eligible in the continental U.S. with occasional business travel. However, individuals residing within a 60-mile radius of a USAA office will be expected to work on-site four days per week.

  
  

**What you'll do:**

As a Data Scientist, you will translate business problems into applied statistical, machine learning, simulation, and optimization solutions to inform actionable business insights and drive business value through automation, revenue generation, and expense and risk reduction. In collaboration with engineering partners, you will deliver solutions at scale, and enable customer-facing applications. You will leverage database, cloud, and programming knowledge to build analytical modeling solutions using statistical and machine learning techniques. You will collaborate with other data scientists to improve USAA's tooling, expanding the company's library of internal packages and applications and work with model risk management to validate the results and stability of models before being pushed to production at scale.

* Gathers, interprets, and manipulates structured and unstructured data to enable analytical solutions for the business.
* Selects the appropriate modeling technique and/or technology with consideration to data limitations, application, and business needs.
* Develops and deploys models within the Model Development Control (MDC) and Model Risk Management (MRM) framework.
* Composes technical documents for knowledge persistence, risk management, and technical review audiences. Consults with peers for guidance, as needed.
* Translates business request(s) into specific analytical questions, executing on the analysis and/or modeling, and communicating outcomes to non-technical business colleagues.
* Consults with Data Engineering, IT, the business, and other internal stakeholders to deploy analytical solutions that are aligned with the customer's vision and specifications and consistent with modeling best practices and model risk management standards.
* Seeks opportunities and materials to learn new techniques, technologies, and methodologies.
* Ensures risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.

**What you have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Finance, Actuarial Science, Science, Engineering, or quantitative field; OR 4 years of relevant education and/or experience.
* 2 years of experience in predictive analytics or data analysis OR Advanced Degree (e.g., Master's, PhD) in mathematics, computer science, statistics, economics, finance, actuarial sciences, science and engineering, or other similar quantitative discipline.
* Experience in training and validating statistical, physical, machine learning, and other advanced analytics models.
* Experience in one or more dynamic scripted language (such as Python, R, etc.) for performing statistical analyses and/or building and scoring AI/ML models.
* Ability to write code that is easy to follow, well documented, and commented where necessary to explain logic (high code transparency).
* Experience in querying and preprocessing data from structured and/or unstructured databases using query languages such as SQL, HQL, NoSQL, etc.
* Experience in working with structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data files such as delimited numeric data files, JSON/XML files, and/or text documents, images, etc.Familiarity with performing ad-hoc analytics using descriptive, diagnostic, and inferential statistics.
* Experience with the concepts and technologies associated with classical supervised modeling for prediction such as linear/logistic regression, discriminant analysis, support vector machines, decision trees, forest models, etc.
* Experience with the concepts and technologies associated with unsupervised modeling such as k-means clustering, hierarchical/agglomerative clustering, neighbors algorithms, DBSCAN, etc.
* Ability to communicate analytical and modeling results to non-technical business partners.

**What sets you apart:**

* A passion for creative and innovative work that improves existing processes and creates new, repeatable and automated workflows that enhance team productivity.
* Personal Lines Experience
* Strong understanding of GLM and GBM modeling algorithms
* Experience with rating platforms like Earnix, Ratabase, or Radar
* Basic knowledge of Model Risk Management, Model Governance, and supporting regulatory needs
* US military experience gained through military service or gained as a military spouse / domestic partner.
  

  

**USAA does not provide visa sponsorship for this role. Please do not apply for this role if at any time (now or in the future) you will need immigration support (i.e., H-1B, TN, STEM OPT Training Plans, etc.).**

Compensation range: The salary range for this position is: $93,770-$179,240.

  
  
  

**Compensation:** USAA has an effective process for assessing market data and establishing ranges to ensure we remain competitive. You are paid within the salary range based on your experience and market data of the position. The actual salary for this role may vary by location.

Employees may be eligible for pay incentives based on overall corporate and individual performance and at the discretion of the USAA Board of Directors.

The above description reflects the details considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the job and should not be construed as a detailed description of all the work requirements that may be performed in the job.

**Benefits:** At USAA our employees enjoy best-in-class benefits to support their physical, financial, and emotional wellness. These benefits include comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans, 401(k), pension, life insurance, parental benefits, adoption assistance, paid time off program with paid holidays plus 16 paid volunteer hours, and various wellness programs. Additionally, our career path planning and continuing education assists employees with their professional goals.

For more details on our outstanding benefits, visit our benefits page on USAAjobs.com.

Join us and discover a rich selection of health care options, robust retirement plans and the flexibility to work, relax and rejuvenate as you reach your fullest personal and professional potential. Click here to see comprehensive information regarding County employee benefits.
  
  
LA Health Services seeking a dedicated Senior Data Scientist to join our team. Whether you’re working in community clinics or hospitals, this is an opportunity to grow your career while serving diverse communities across LA County.
  
  
**Our Mission:**
  
To advance the health of our patients and our communities by providing outstanding care.
  
  
**The Team Member We Are Looking for Will:**

Under general supervision, leads the development and application of methods to identify, collect, process, organize, and analyze structured and unstructured data using advanced statistical prediction, inference, and optimization; effectively communicates results to County, departmental, and divisional decision makers and provides ongoing support to strengthen data-driven program design and management.

**Essential Job Functions**
---------------------------

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Develops and maintains inpatient bed utilization and staffing forecast models and scenario-planning tools to support capacity planning and operational decision-making.
* Develops clinical notes Natural Language Processing (NLP) and machine learning-based anomaly detection to identify trends and potential coding gaps affecting data quality, specifically KPIs and quality measures.
* Collaborates with division, departmental, and countywide partners to solicit, define, and manage highly complex data science projects from conception through implementation; ensures that projects result in actionable insights and recommendations that can be used to support business decisions and allocate resources; and provides ongoing consultation during program implementation of recommendations as necessary to ensure program fidelity.
* Conducts and coordinates statistical inference of data and conveys findings and conclusions orally, in writing, visually, in presentations, and by developing interactive tools as appropriate to communicate effectively with a wide range of audiences, including technical and nontechnical staff, partners, and members of the public.
* Provides technical oversight to small teams of Data Scientists and Predictive Data Analysts as necessary to ensure project success.
* Recommends ongoing improvements to methods and algorithms that lead to findings, including new information.
* Creates and monitors performance of automated-detection systems and provides business metrics for overall project to show improvements initially and over multiple iterations.
* Leads the discovery process with departmental partners to document business requirements and frame business problems so that appropriate corresponding data science techniques and products can be identified and deployed.
* Develops and maintains a high level of expertise in statistical programming languages and packages and other software tools; provides training and support to Data Scientists and Predictive Data Analysts as necessary; and ensures the quality of code and programming logic generated by the data science team.
* Works with program staff to understand the implications of analyses and to ensure that findings are actionable and support data-driven program, policy, and operational decision-making.
* Develops and maintains operational and service line KPI dashboards spanning clinical operations, quality and patient outcomes, patient experience, and financial sustainability to support data-driven decision-making.
* Collaborates with other department subject matter experts to understand, identify, and select available and relevant sources of data for use cases, including internal, external, structured, and unstructured data sources; and provides guidance to other department data experts in the selection and transformation of such sources.
* Maintains version-controlled notebooks, model cards, technical documentation, and reproducible workflows within the Azure data environment.
* Coordinates with various functional teams to develop and implement products, services, tools, or business process changes resulting from the analysis.
* Troubleshoots deployed analytical solutions and implements corrective enhancements to maintain data and model accuracy.
* Assists in implementing recommended business process changes in ways retain fidelity to standard methodologies identified through the analysis and recognize the operational realities underlying existing business processes; provides ongoing consultation as recommended changes and new programs grow and evolve, including recommending modifications to adopted goals and metrics.
* Tracks and manages data science project activities, landmarks, and blockers through Jira and established sprint cycles.
* In conjunction with the Information Technology organization, supports collection, integration, and retention requirements for large sets of structured and unstructured data from disparate sources; acts as a resource for senior data engineers and architects in the selection and design of systems for use by the data science team.

**Requirements**
----------------

**REQUIREMENTS TO QUALIFY:**

**Option I:**

Two (2) years of experience carrying out complex data science projects that included independently developing and applying methods to identify, collect, process, structure, and analyze data using statistical prediction, inference, and optimization to support data-driven program design and management, at a level equivalent to the Los Angeles County class of Data Scientist. Classification Specification Details

  

* You may still qualify even if your job title isn’t exactly the same as the ones listed. What matters is that your experience is at a similar level — meaning your job involves similar responsibilities, requires comparable skills and knowledge, and takes place within a similar organizational structure. Please provide a clear explanation of your experience to demonstrate that it is at the appropriate level.

  
  
  
**Option II:**
  
A bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in a field of applied research such as Data Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Statistics, Business Analytics, Psychology, or Public Health that included 12 semester or 18 quarter units of coursework in data science, predictive analytics, quantitative research methods, or statistical analysis **-AN****D-** Six (6) years of experience, including two (2) years in a lead capacity, applying and overseeing the application of machine learning, predictive analytics, data management, and hypothesis-driven data analysis to make actionable recommendations to support program, policy, and operational decision-making.
  
  
A master’s or doctoral degree from an accredited college or university in a field of applied research such Data Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Statistics, Business Analytics, Psychology, or Public Health may substitute for up to two (2) years of experience.
For this examination, lead capacity is defined as assigning, coordinating, and reviewing the work, ensuring proper work methods are followed and providing technical assistance and training. A lead person is a Senior member of the Data Science team that provides technical assistance to other team members but does not supervise.

A valid California Class C Driver License or the ability to utilize alternative method of transportation when needed to carry out job-related essential functions

  
  
**Physical Class II – Light:** This class includes administrative and clerical positions requiring light physical effort that may include occasional light lifting to a 10-pound limit and some bending, stooping, or squatting. Considerable ambulation may be involved.
  
  
**DESIRABLE QUALIFICATIONS:**

Additional credit will awarded to applicants who possess the following:

* If you are qualified under option I: Additional years of experience beyond the requirements.
If you are qualified under option II: Additional experience in excess of two (2) years of experience in a lead capacity* applying and overseeing the application of machine learning, predictive analytics, data management, and hypothesis-driven data analysis to make actionable recommendations to support program, policy, and operational decision-making.

  
**SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS INFORMATION:**  

**In order to receive credit for the required degree, license, and** **certificate/s from an accredited institution,**you must include a legible copy of your official diploma, official transcripts, or official letter from the accredited institution which shows the area of specialization. **Y****our** **official** **transcripts from an accredited institution must show the degree conferred, the area of specialization, and the relevant course work specified in the requirements.** The required degree should show the date the degree was conferred and be in English. If not in English, then translation is required. International degrees must be evaluated for equivalency to U.S. standards. Include official copies of all relevant documents. For more information on our standards for educational documents, please visit: https://file.lacounty.gov/SDSInter/dhr/070812\_PPG123.pdf.

If you are unable to attach the required documents to your application at the time of filing, you may email them within **s****even (7) calendar days** from the application date to Darlene Beamon-Thomas at DBeamon-Thomas@dhs.lacounty.gov. description:
**Description**

Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions.

Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance.

**About the Role:**

The Data Science & Analytics organization at Realtor.com is looking for a Staff Data Scientist to build the scoring and optimization engine behind Lead Intelligence & Revenue Optimization.

This is a revenue management problem at national scale. Our inventory is consumer intent, and every lead is a perishable unit of it. You will determine what each lead is worth, who it should go to, and how the full supply should be distributed across clients, products, and geographies to maximize revenue. That means scoring likelihood to transact, valuing inventory by geography and intent signal, and solving allocation and distribution as an optimization problem rather than a set of static rules.

The constraints are real: product eligibility, client commitments, and the experience of both the consumer and the client. The signal is noisy and arrives continuously. You will define the objective function, build the models that feed it, and work with Engineering to put the results into production decisioning.

You will work at the intersection of lead quality and revenue outcomes, partnering with Product, Marketing, Pricing, Finance, Tech, and Client Engineering to turn models into automated decisions across the Realtor.com ecosystem.

**Top Reasons to Apply:**

* **High-Impact Marketplace Optimization:** You will directly influence revenue routing and inventory allocation strategies across a massive, national two-sided marketplace.
* **Operations Research Applied to Revenue:** Formulate and solve the valuation and allocation problems that determine what each lead is worth and where it earns the most, with pricing as a direct partner at the table.
* **Full Ownership of Next-Gen Data Layers:** Take full ownership of our predictive close models and Lead-To-Transact pipeline, and set the standard for how these models are built, validated, and deployed.
* **Complex Data Problem Solving:** Uncover non-obvious revenue streams, such as identifying low-priority land-listing leads that actually convert into high-value single-family home transactions.
* **Direct Stakeholder & Executive Visibility:** Partner directly with Product, Tech, Pricing, Marketing, and Engineering, and bring your results and tradeoffs to VP and SVP audiences who act on them.
* **Scale and Consequence:** Work with clickstream, lead, and transaction data across a national marketplace, where the decisions your models make are measured in revenue and in client outcomes.

**What You'll Do:**

* **Lead Quality & Scoring:** Own and advance the predictive close models that score likelihood to transact, as part of the Lead-To-Transact pipeline, so that the leads we deliver generate revenue for the clients who pay us for them. Extend scoring beyond conversion to the expected value of a lead.
* **Inventory Valuation:** Build the models that value lead inventory by geography, product, and intent signal, and establish that valuation as the common currency for allocation, distribution, and pricing decisions.
* **Allocation & Distribution Optimization:** Formulate lead distribution as a constrained optimization problem across clients, products, and geographies, using methods such as mixed-integer programming and stochastic optimization, and move the business from rules-based allocation toward optimized allocation.
* **Price and Inventory Together:** Partner with Strategic Pricing to model how price and inventory interact, including price elasticity and willingness-to-pay, so that allocation and pricing decisions are solved against the same revenue objective.
* **Demand and Supply Alignment:** Work with the teams that own demand forecasting and marketing acquisition, contributing lead valuation and conversion insight by market so that supply is acquired and committed against where it is worth the most. Perform scenario analysis to maximize outcomes while optimizing the consumer and client experience.
* **Impact Simulation:** Simulate and report on the knock-on effects of changes to product eligibility, allocation rules, and price across various business units before they are implemented.
* **Experimentation:** Design and analyze experiments and structured test-and-learn programs to validate scoring models and allocation logic in market, and establish statistical best practices for the function.
* **Production and Adoption:** Work with Tech and Client Engineering to take models from development into production decisioning, ensure the standardized implementation of rules across the Realtor.com ecosystem, and monitor performance after launch.
* **KPI Development & Monitoring:** Build and track the KPIs that measure lead quality, delivery, and revenue yield, and build the dashboards that make them self-service for stakeholders.
* **Communication:** Translate complex statistical and optimization results into clear narratives, assumptions, and tradeoffs for business and executive audiences, and document methodologies through reproducible code.

**What You'll Bring:**

* **Education & Experience:** 8+ years of experience in data science, applied statistics, or machine learning and a Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) in computer science, statistics, mathematics, operations research, or a related quantitative field. (6+ years with a Master's, 3+ years with a Ph.D.)
* **Optimization Mindset:** Demonstrated experience formulating business problems as constrained optimization problems and delivering solutions with measurable revenue or margin impact. This is the core of the role.
* **Inventory and Allocation:** 2+ years of inventory optimization, allocation, or capacity and revenue management experience, ideally in a digital marketplace, SaaS, or another industry with perishable inventory.
* **Predictive Modeling:** Experience building models that score likelihood of an outcome such as purchase, conversion, or churn, and validating them against realized results.
* **Technical Mastery:** Advanced SQL required. Python proficiency (pandas, numpy, scipy) with 4+ years, and hands-on experience with optimization solvers such as Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools, or Pyomo.
* **Analytical Rigor:** Strong understanding of experimentation and statistics (hypothesis testing, regression analysis, power analysis, causal inference, statistical modeling) and of modeling and simulation.
* **From Model to Production:** Experience moving models out of development and into systems that make decisions, and measuring the business impact once they are live.
* **Cloud Platforms:** Experience working within cloud-based environments such as AWS and Snowflake.
* **Data Visualization:** Experience with tools like Tableau, Shiny, or Streamlit to create impactful data stories for executive stakeholders.
* **Strategic Thinking:** Ability to handle operational complexity and move from "what" the data says to "why" it is moving, enabling data-driven decisioning for the entire organization.
* **Agility:** Comfort working in a highly agile, intensely iterative environment where you must manage multiple priorities and ambiguous concepts.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Ph.D. in Operations Research or Industrial Engineering
* Revenue management experience combining inventory and pricing, including price segmentation, price optimization, or dynamic pricing, in sectors such as hospitality, transportation, travel, or retail
* Forecasting experience at scale, including forecasts by geography, using time series, machine learning, or Bayesian methods
* Marketplace or property tech revenue analytics, lead generation, or CRM/Salesforce expertise

**How We Work:**

We balance creativity and innovation on a foundation of in-person collaboration. For most roles, our employees work four or more days in our offices, where they have the opportunity to collaborate in-person, adding richness to our culture and knitting us closer together.

**How We Reward You:**

Realtor.com is committed to investing in the health and wellbeing of our employees and their families. Our benefits programs include, but are not limited to:

Here, you’ll partner with a diverse team of experts as you use leading-edge tech to empower everyone to meet a crucial goal: finding their way home. And you’ll find your way home too. **About AbbVie**

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow.  **Job Description**

The Global Research, Informatics & Platform Solutions team within the Information Research (IR) Division partners with scientists and research organizations across AbbVie to unlock the value of scientific data. By enabling effective management, integration, and use of high-quality research data and delivering informatics platforms and decision-support capabilities, the team helps transform complex scientific information into actionable insights that accelerate discovery, strengthen scientific decision-making, and improve the efficiency and effectiveness of research and development. The role serves as a key bridge of expertise between laboratory scientists and technology teams and is responsible for defining, stewarding, and expanding our bioassay knowledge graph, translating scientific workflows into data solutions, and building data visualizations/AI-enabled solutions that accelerate drug discovery.

**Responsibilities:**

* Harmonization – apply previous biology/biochemistry wet lab experience and strong knowledge of biology data to harmonize knowledge graph data & derive knowledge statements.
* Communicate – ability to communicate with scientists from Discovery teams to understand existing workflows, data flows & gather requirements.
* Collaborative Design – understand the client’s needs, propose solutions, and independently develop appropriate solutions.
* Build – Conceive, design, and implement technology solutions that integrate, visualize, and analyze complex multi-platform data; build pipelines to integrate data into systems/warehouses.
* Integrate – understand the value in capturing data properly, integrating internal & external data sets and leveraging ontologies.
* Support – provide solutions to performance-related issues and work with downstream systems to support bioassay-data-driven demands.
* Technical Proficiency - Demonstrate high proficiency in technologies for data storage, transfer, integration, visualization, and advanced analytics.
* Adaptability – ability to work on multiple, sometimes very different, projects at one time.
* Breadth – contribute independently to a wide variety of projects related to enhancing drug discovery & development.

* Background in life sciences, biology, or equivalent required,
* Working knowledge of drug discovery and development process
* Understanding of biological ontologies

* Understanding of knowledge graphs with ability to enhance our existing biology data

* Strong familiarity with data visualization and pipelining tools such as Spotfire, or equivalent
* Demonstrated data visualization skill and experience with flexible plotting libraries (D3, ggplot2, plotly) and/or visualization platforms.
* Ability to work independently, multi-task, and work within timelines.
* Outstanding verbal, written and interpersonal skills for cross-functional collaboration, including documenting and presenting technical solutions to non-technical stakeholders.
* A self-motivated learner and thinker with a hands-on approach

**Preferred:**

* Demonstrated technical proficiency in the pharmaceutical industry highly preferred.
* Previous in vitro biology wet lab experience preferred.
* Experience with LIMS, ELN, and other scientific software preferred.
* Strong programming proficiency in Python (and other modern languages) desired.

**Overview**
------------

At Orange County Government, we are proud to serve the public with integrity, honesty, fairness, and professionalism. We develop innovative policies and services that impact Central Florida and shape the future of our community. We believe in hiring the very best. Our workplace experience sets us apart and makes us a great place to work. Our goal is to create an environment of exceptional organizational values, customer service standards, and employee satisfaction. Orange County Government is committed to providing equal opportunity in employment and services to all individuals.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**General Functions**

The Research Statistician for Strategic, Performance, and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Systems is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining data-driven systems that support strategic planning, performance measurement, and customer relationship initiatives within the organization. This role involves managing data collection, statistical analysis, and reporting processes to ensure accurate, actionable insights that inform decision-making and enhance customer relationship strategies.The ideal candidate will have a strong background in statistical analysis, experience with performance and CRM software, and the ability to translate data insights into strategic recommendations.

This position has ultimate responsibility for all statistical information concerning the assigned division. Performs decision support and public policy analyses as needed. Provides planning, research, and needs assessment data related to the development of programs and services.

The position also supports the ongoing administratrion, configuration, optimization, and enhancement of the department's Customer Relationship Management (CRM) platform, including Salesforce Public Sector Solutions. This includes translating evolving departmental, County, and grant-related requirements into system improvements, maintaining data integrity, and supporting reporting and operational needs across divisions.

Work is performed with independence under the general supervision of assigned supervisor. Performance is reviewed through observations, conferences, reports and results achieved.

**Representative Duties/Assignments**

**Data Management and Statistical Analysis:**

* Design and manage data collection methodologies, including surveys, performance metrics, CRM data, and other sources, to track organizational and customer relationship performance.
* Perform statistical analysis to identify trends, relationships, and insights within customer and performance data sets.
* Apply advanced statistical techniques to forecast outcomes, conduct simulations, and build predictive models for both strategic and customer engagement purposes.
* Collects and analyzes demographic and needs assessment data related to programs and services.
* Conducts research projects by establishing research methodology, conducts analysis and produces summary findings.
* Provides data and analysis to assist management in identifying appropriate courses of action regarding a variety of issues.
* Provides data to substantiate public policy position of concern to external governmental bodies and the media.
* Recommends modification or elimination of various programs and procedures as they affect departmental information based on research, statistical modeling, and analysis.
* Support the accreditation efforts of the Department, Divisions and Business units.

**System Development, CRM Configuration, and Maintenance:**

* Collaborate with software developers, County technology staff, and system stakeholders to develop and maintain departmental performance management and CRM systems.
* Support the department's Salesforce Administrator in the ongoing administration and configuration of Salesforce CRM, including the creation and modification of data fields, page layouts, record types, forms, validation rules, workflows, and other system components.
* Gather and translate business, operational, grant, and regulatory requirements into functional system specifications and recommend appropriate CRM configuration changes.
* Assist with configuring, testing, and implementing approved system modifications, including low-code automation and workflow improvements, in coordination with County technology staff and implementation partners.
* Collaborate with division representatives and external vendors to evaluate system enhancement requests, identify limitations, and recommend improvements to meet evolving departmental needs.
* Participate in system testing, user acceptance testing, troubleshooting, and deployment activities to ensure modifications meet documented business requirements.
* Support updates and improvements to departmental performance management systems to ensure they meet evolving strategic, operational, and reporting needs.
* Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and security of data stored within departmental systems, in accordance with County policies and procedures.
* Develop and maintain planning databases and resource collections.
* Maintain documentation of system configurations, business rules, data structures, and approved changes to support ongoing system maintenance and administration.

**Reporting and Visualization:**

* Generate clear and insightful reports on performance and CRM metrics, including customer engagement, satisfaction, and strategic outcomes for senior leadership and stakeholders.
* Develop, configure, and maintain reports, dashboards, and performance indicators within Salesforce and other approved reporting platforms to support program operations, grant compliance, strategic planning, and departmental decision-making.
* Collaborate with divisions to establish consistent data definitions, reporting requirements, and performance measures across programs, and modify reports and dashboards as operational and regulatory requirements evolve.
* Present findings and recommendations based on statistical analysis and CRM insights to diverse audiences.

**Strategic Planning, Performance Management, and Customer Relationship Support:**

* Support the development and implementation of strategic goals and objectives by providing data-driven insights for both organizational and customer-focused initiatives.
* Collaborate with departments to align performance and CRM metrics with strategic and customer engagement initiatives.
* Identify performance trends, customer preferences, and engagement gaps, providing recommendations to optimize organizational performance and customer relationships.
* Develop training, education and reporting methods.

Develops tentative program proposals. Provides position and decision support for strategic planning. Issues analysis and information retrieval. Performs a variety of research functions separate from statistical analysis, including researching articles, legislative histories, and other types of information that impact department functions. Benchmark federal, state and local best practices.

**Quality Assurance and Compliance:**

* Ensure that statistical methodologies and CRM data practices comply with industry standards, County policies, and regulatory requirements.
* Conduct regular quality assurance checks on data and software systems, including CRM data validation, duplicate record management, and documented change control, to maintain accuracy and reliability.
* Document processes and methodologies to support transparency and reproducibility.
* Coordinates planning and evaluation of data-laden functions.
* Produces regular analytical and informational reports specific to population trends, emerging issues, best practices and evidenced based programing in accordance with industry and county standards, etc.

**Minimum Qualifications**

Master's degree from an accredited institution in Statistics, Research Methods, Public Policy, Political Science, Data Science, Business Administration, Public Administration or a closely related field and two years of experience in statistical analysis and theory or a Bachelor's and four years of experience.  
  
**Preferences**

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in statistical analysis, experience with strategic planning, performance and CRM systems, and the ability to translate data insights into strategic recommendations. A PhD is preferred, along with demonstrated experience in strategic planning, performance management, and CRM systems, including system configuration, enhancements, data management, and reporting.

**Technical Skills:**

* Proficiency in statistical software (e.g., R, SAS, SPSS), database management, and CRM/performance management software (e.g., Envisio). Knowledge of data visualization tools like Tableau or Power BI is a plus.
* Familiarity with Software as a Service (SaaS) solutions for strategic, performance, and CRM management, preferably Salesforce.
* Experience in database construction, report writing, relational database application theory, and extensive MS office application experience.
* Demonstrated experience with CRM administration, configuration, or system enhancements, preferably Salesforce, including custom fields, objects, page layouts, validation rules, workflow automation, Salesforce Flow, and reporting capabilities. Experience with Salesforce Public Sector Solutions, Experience Cloud, or similar systems supporting grants management, constituent services, and case management is highly desirable.
* Experience with Salesforce reporting and dashboard development, SQL, data mapping, data migration, and system integrations is desirable.

**Analytical Skills:**

* Advanced knowledge of statistical methodologies, including regression, hypothesis testing, and predictive modeling for both strategic and CRM application
* Experience in time series modeling and forecasting.
* Ability to analyze complex data structures, business processes, and reporting requirements to identify gaps, recommend improvements, and support data-driven system enhancements.

**Soft Skills:**

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present complex data in a clear and accessible manner for both strategic and customer relationship insights.
* Experience in the public sector or with human services departments is highly desirable.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with division representatives, County technology staff, and external vendors to gather requirements, address technical challenges, and support system improvements.

Join Siemens Healthineers’ Digital Technology & Innovation (DTI) team in Princeton, NJ, a central hub for advancing Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technologies in healthcare.

As an AI/ML Scientist within our Neuroclinical AI team, you will develop AI algorithms and models that power image-guided neurovascular interventions, from procedure planning through real-time navigation in the angiography suite. Our primary clinical focus is acute ischemic stroke and intracranial aneurysm treatment, with other neurointerventional procedures also in scope.

You will work closely with clinical collaborators, imaging scientists, and product development teams to translate interventional workflow needs into robust, real-time AI solutions, spanning model development, validation, and deployment in a regulated medical device environment.

* Developing AI algorithms for real-time detection and tracking of interventional devices (e.g., guidewires, microcatheters, stent retrievers, coils, and flow diverters) in live fluoroscopy and angiography sequences
* Developing 2D/3D fusion and registration methods that bring pre-procedural and intra-procedural 3D imaging (e.g., CTA, MRA, 3D rotational angiography) and planning primitives such as vessel centerlines, aneurysm geometry, and target landmarks into the live 2D angiographic view
* Building foundation models for interventional and neurovascular imaging, and distilling them into compact, efficient models that meet real-time latency requirements on clinical hardware

---------------

You will serve government agencies (including defense and national security organizations), public health and healthcare organizations, and social sector institutions and will partner with clients at all levels, from technical teams to senior leaders.

You will build data science and artificial intelligence (AI) solutions for our clients, and you will advise them on how to use data science well. You can expect half of your work to be hands-on technical work, and the other half will be helping clients decide where data science and AI can create value, what it takes to adopt them, and how to use them responsibly.

On the technical side, you will translate client problems into machine learning problems (for example, classification, forecasting, anomaly detection, or optimization), and select approaches based on the available data, the value at stake, and the solution requirements. This work includes building data pipelines and engineering features from structured and unstructured data, including text and documents. Using appropriate validation methods and metrics, you will train, tune, and evaluate supervised and unsupervised models, such as gradient-boosted trees, time-series models, and neural networks. Your work will also encompass building generative AI and agentic AI solutions, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool-using agents, and multi-step workflows, and evaluating them for accuracy, reliability, and safety.

To move models from prototype to production, you will apply MLOps and LLMOps practices, such as version control, experiment tracking, testing, and monitoring. Throughout this work, you will validate your own results, document assumptions and limitations, and test for bias, drift, and failure modes.

On the advisory side, you will help clients assess their data and analytics maturity, identify the highest-value use cases, and shape data science and AI strategies, roadmaps, and operating models. By explaining technical results to non-technical audiences and translating analytical outputs into recommended actions, you will help clients put insights into practice. Your advisory work will also address data governance, fairness, explainability, and the appropriate use of AI in public-facing settings. To ensure results last after our teams leave, you will help clients build their own data science capabilities.

* Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers love
* Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data
* Build machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation
* Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

**The Ideal Candidate is:**

  

* Customer first. You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers.

* Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms.
* Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning.
* A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science.

* Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:

* At least 1 year of experience utilizing relational databases

Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. About the Role:

The Data Science & Analytics organization at Realtor.com is looking for a Staff Data Scientist to build the scoring and optimization engine behind Lead Intelligence & Revenue Optimization.

This is a revenue management problem at national scale. Our inventory is consumer intent, and every lead is a perishable unit of it. You will determine what each lead is worth, who it should go to, and how the full supply should be distributed across clients, products, and geographies to maximize revenue. That means scoring likelihood to transact, valuing inventory by geography and intent signal, and solving allocation and distribution as an optimization problem rather than a set of static rules.

The constraints are real: product eligibility, client commitments, and the experience of both the consumer and the client. The signal is noisy and arrives continuously. You will define the objective function, build the models that feed it, and work with Engineering to put the results into production decisioning.

You will work at the intersection of lead quality and revenue outcomes, partnering with Product, Marketing, Pricing, Finance, Tech, and Client Engineering to turn models into automated decisions across the Realtor.com ecosystem.

Top Reasons to Apply:

* High-Impact Marketplace Optimization: You will directly influence revenue routing and inventory allocation strategies across a massive, national two-sided marketplace.
* Operations Research Applied to Revenue: Formulate and solve the valuation and allocation problems that determine what each lead is worth and where it earns the most, with pricing as a direct partner at the table.
* Full Ownership of Next-Gen Data Layers: Take full ownership of our predictive close models and Lead-To-Transact pipeline, and set the standard for how these models are built, validated, and deployed.
* Complex Data Problem Solving: Uncover non-obvious revenue streams, such as identifying low-priority land-listing leads that actually convert into high-value single-family home transactions.
* Direct Stakeholder & Executive Visibility: Partner directly with Product, Tech, Pricing, Marketing, and Engineering, and bring your results and tradeoffs to VP and SVP audiences who act on them.
* Scale and Consequence: Work with clickstream, lead, and transaction data across a national marketplace, where the decisions your models make are measured in revenue and in client outcomes.

  What You'll Do:
* Lead Quality & Scoring: Own and advance the predictive close models that score likelihood to transact, as part of the Lead-To-Transact pipeline, so that the leads we deliver generate revenue for the clients who pay us for them. Extend scoring beyond conversion to the expected value of a lead.
* Inventory Valuation: Build the models that value lead inventory by geography, product, and intent signal, and establish that valuation as the common currency for allocation, distribution, and pricing decisions.
* Allocation & Distribution Optimization: Formulate lead distribution as a constrained optimization problem across clients, products, and geographies, using methods such as mixed-integer programming and stochastic optimization, and move the business from rules-based allocation toward optimized allocation.
* Price and Inventory Together: Partner with Strategic Pricing to model how price and inventory interact, including price elasticity and willingness-to-pay, so that allocation and pricing decisions are solved against the same revenue objective.
* Demand and Supply Alignment: Work with the teams that own demand forecasting and marketing acquisition, contributing lead valuation and conversion insight by market so that supply is acquired and committed against where it is worth the most. Perform scenario analysis to maximize outcomes while optimizing the consumer and client experience.
* Impact Simulation: Simulate and report on the knock-on effects of changes to product eligibility, allocation rules, and price across various business units before they are implemented.
* Experimentation: Design and analyze experiments and structured test-and-learn programs to validate scoring models and allocation logic in market, and establish statistical best practices for the function.
* Production and Adoption: Work with Tech and Client Engineering to take models from development into production decisioning, ensure the standardized implementation of rules across the Realtor.com ecosystem, and monitor performance after launch.
* KPI Development & Monitoring: Build and track the KPIs that measure lead quality, delivery, and revenue yield, and build the dashboards that make them self-service for stakeholders.
* Communication: Translate complex statistical and optimization results into clear narratives, assumptions, and tradeoffs for business and executive audiences, and document methodologies through reproducible code.

  What You'll Bring:
* Education & Experience: 8+ years of experience in data science, applied statistics, or machine learning and a Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) in computer science, statistics, mathematics, operations research, or a related quantitative field. (6+ years with a Master's, 3+ years with a Ph.D.)
* Optimization Mindset: Demonstrated experience formulating business problems as constrained optimization problems and delivering solutions with measurable revenue or margin impact. This is the core of the role.
* Inventory and Allocation: 2+ years of inventory optimization, allocation, or capacity and revenue management experience, ideally in a digital marketplace, SaaS, or another industry with perishable inventory.
* Predictive Modeling: Experience building models that score likelihood of an outcome such as purchase, conversion, or churn, and validating them against realized results.
* Technical Mastery: Advanced SQL required. Python proficiency (pandas, numpy, scipy) with 4+ years, and hands-on experience with optimization solvers such as Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools, or Pyomo.
* Analytical Rigor: Strong understanding of experimentation and statistics (hypothesis testing, regression analysis, power analysis, causal inference, statistical modeling) and of modeling and simulation.
* From Model to Production: Experience moving models out of development and into systems that make decisions, and measuring the business impact once they are live.
* Cloud Platforms: Experience working within cloud-based environments such as AWS and Snowflake.
* Data Visualization: Experience with tools like Tableau, Shiny, or Streamlit to create impactful data stories for executive stakeholders.
* Strategic Thinking: Ability to handle operational complexity and move from "what" the data says to "why" it is moving, enabling data-driven decisioning for the entire organization.
* Agility: Comfort working in a highly agile, intensely iterative environment where you must manage multiple priorities and ambiguous concepts.

description:
**Position Title**: Data Scientist, Lupus Nexus

**Reports to**: Lupus Nexus Director, Lupus Research Alliance

**Location**: Remote or Hybrid NYC

**Salary**: $125,000 - $150,000 (based on location and qualifications)

**Background**

The Lupus Research Alliance (LRA), the world’s largest non-governmental funder of lupus research, seeks a Data Scientist to support a critical initiative for the lupus community. Be part of a team of LRA staff, academic and industry experts, and individuals living with lupus who envision and bring to life a unique infrastructure that integrates a patient registry with a linked biorepository and a data analytics platform. This resource, referred to as the Lupus Nexus (LNx), will expedite scientific discovery and clinical development and accelerate precision medicine in lupus, with the goal of transforming lupus care.

**Position Summary**

The Data Scientist will be part of the Lupus Research Alliance’s Research Department and plays an important role in supporting efforts across the Lupus Nexus. This role is responsible for managing and analyzing complex scientific and clinical datasets to enable the generation of high-quality, reproducible research and biological insights by researchers accessing the LNx. The role will build and manage scientific data pipelines while also conducting code-based analyses of multi-omics, clinical, and biomarker data; interpreting findings in an immunological and disease context; and partnering directly with researchers to turn scientific questions into analytical approaches while maintaining high standards of data accuracy and reproducibility. The role may also lead or contribute to the publications and data reports that show what LNx data can answer. The ideal candidate will have strong computational and quantitative skills, demonstrated experience in independently analyzing complex biological datasets, and the scientific expertise necessary to evaluate such datasets relevant to research studies.

**Responsibilities**

**Oversees scientific data analysis and quality**

* Manage and oversee scientific data analysis pipelines, ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and completeness of scientific datasets from vendors and external researchers.
* Oversee metadata management and data harmonization efforts to facilitate standardized data sharing. Contribute to the resolution and documentation of data queries as per the established LNx Data Governance and Management Plan.
* Contribute to the review and quality control assessments of scientific data by the LNx Scientific Review Committee.
* Work with internal staff and external vendors to ensure the seamless integration and interoperability of clinical and research data across multiple platforms.
* Engage with key collaborators and business partners to identify data needs, improve data workflows, and enhance the usability of research data for the scientific community.

**Conduct scientific data analyses and support biological discovery**

* Independently develop and execute code-based analyses of complex clinical, immunological, and multi-omics datasets to support research questions from scientists (e.g., genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic, clinical data).
* Develop reproducible analytical workflows and document code, methods, assumptions, and outputs to support scientific transparency and reuse.
* Proactively identify opportunities to leverage existing datasets and pipelines to answer new scientific questions.
* Use the available clinical and scientific data to support researchers with determining feasibility and refining inclusion/exclusion criteria for research projects.
* Serve as a scientific computational resource for researchers, helping them understand how the available datasets can answer their scientific questions.
* Lead or contribute to abstracts, publications, and an annual data report that show what LNx data can answer.

**Data governance, access, and compliance**

* Manage data access requests and review processes, ensuring compliance with governance policies while promoting responsible data sharing.
* Establish and manage procedures for maintaining scientific data provenance and governance.
* Contribute to the development of policies and procedures to support the ethical and effective release of scientific data to researchers and registry participants, including data sharing compliance, data harmonization, and meta-data management.
* Apply disclosure controls before results are released to researchers or participants.

**Requirements:**

**Credentials & Qualifications:**

* PhD in immunology, biomedical sciences, biostatistics, epidemiology, computational biology, bioinformatics, or a related field, with 3+ years of relevant experience, or MS with 8+ years.
* Experience analyzing both clinical and multi-omic/molecular data. Experience with longitudinal clinical or real-world data strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of R Studio, Jupyter Notebook is required. Working knowledge of Nextflow and Docker a plus.
* Working knowledge of AWS environments, SQL, and GitHub or other version control is preferred.
* Proficiency in at least one programming language commonly used for scientific analyses (e.g., R, Python), with the ability to write, modify, debug, and maintain analytical code.
* Experience with observational research methods and with clinical or real-world data standards (for example OMOP or CDISC) preferred.
* Experience with immunology or autoimmune disease data preferred.
* Experience working with human-subjects data under consent, IRB and privacy (e.g., HIPAA) requirements.

**Skills & Competencies:**

* Demonstrated ability to think strategically when planning and managing responsibilities.
* Hands-on, self-directed, detail-oriented, organized, and conscientious.
* Able to explain data, methods, and limitations clearly to researchers.
* Strong scientific writing, including methods sections for abstracts and publications.
* Must be able to work independently and prioritize and manage multiple activities within tight timelines.
* Team player who can build excellent working relationships both internally and externally.

description:
Blue Marble Space, in partnership with the Earth and Planets Laboratory (EPL) at the Carnegie Institution for Science and the NASA Ames Research Center, is seeking a data scientist with interests lying at the intersection of data science and astrobiology. The successful applicant will join the NASA-funded Interdisciplinary Consortia for Astrobiology Research (ICAR) project on Advancing Multi-Messenger Biosignature Techniques using Machine Learning, and will work on a variety of areas within this effort. Applicants should have demonstrated experience in data science, machine learning, data visualization, and information modeling, and an interest in applying their science skills to planetary science and astrobiological from in-situ sample analysis measurements of chemical/molecular composition. Successful candidates will be supervised by Dr. Anirudh Prabhu and will work with ICAR project members including Dr. Caleb Scharf (NASA Ames) and Dr. Michael Wong (Carnegie EPL).
  
  
**Minimum qualifications:** The applicant must have at minimum an undergraduate degree in any of the areas of computer science, data science, geoinformatics, geoscience, or planetary science and must be proficient in coding languages such as R, Julia, or Python. Experience with data management would be beneficial. An interest in, and ability to work effectively with, astrobiologists, geologists, planetary scientists, informaticians, and data curators is essential. Familiarity with software development best practices, including version control (e.g., Git), is ideal.
  
  
This full-time, 2-year position will commence on or after January 10, 2027 and will be based at the Broad Branch Road campus of the Carnegie Institution for Science in Washington, DC. The starting salary will range from $70,000 to $75,000, commensurate with experience. Interested applicants should submit a CV, contact information for three references, and a cover letter that includes a brief discussion of interests and relevant research experience. We will begin reviewing applications on December 15, 2026. Applications will be reviewed until the position is filled.
  
  
Only applicants with existing authorization to work in the USA will be considered. No relocation funds are available. This is not a remote position.
