title: Data Center Electrical Engineer – Design
description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

Training and serving frontier AI models requires compute infrastructure at a scale and density that pushes past what conventional data center designs were built to handle. Anthropic's Data Center Infrastructure team is responsible for delivering that physical infrastructure — partnering with build partners, equipment manufacturers, and utilities to stand up facilities that can reliably power some of the largest accelerator clusters in the industry.

  

As a Data Center Electrical Engineer – Design, you'll own the electrical architecture of our facilities from the utility service entrance through to the rack — substation interface, medium- and high-voltage distribution, on-site generation and storage integration, UPS, switchgear, busway, and rack power. You'll develop and maintain the basis of design, reference architectures, and technical specifications that our build partners and A/E firms design against, and you'll be the point of technical authority when their drawings and calculations come back for review. You'll run the engineering studies — short-circuit, protection coordination, arc flash, load flow, and power quality — and you'll keep the architecture ahead of rapidly increasing rack densities and the unique load characteristics of large-scale ML training.

  

A central part of this role is speed-to-capacity through prefabrication: you'll shape Anthropic's offsite-manufactured electrical strategy — modular skids, e-houses, and prefabricated power assemblies — and drive its standardization across sites. You'll work closely with colleagues across the infrastructure team, with our hardware and compute teams to translate accelerator requirements into electrical design criteria, and with supply chain to qualify and diversify regional equipment vendors. Expect roughly 10–25% travel for design reviews, partner and vendor meetings, factory witness testing, and site visits to support commissioning and startup.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

### **Electrical design & engineering**

* Lead the electrical design of critical data center infrastructure across the US portfolio, including the utility interface and substation, site medium- and high-voltage distribution, generators, UPS, switchgear, transformers, busway, and grounding
* Develop and maintain Anthropic's electrical basis of design, reference architectures, and technical specifications for critical power distribution — covering switchgear, UPS systems, PDUs, busway, and rack power delivery — producing designs that meet our reliability and maintainability requirements while staying within budgetary targets
* Perform and validate engineering studies — including short-circuit, protection coordination, arc flash, load flow, and power quality analysis — and use the findings to steer topology, redundancy, equipment-selection, and protection-setting decisions
* Design and plan data center hall power distribution layouts for newly allocated spaces in coordination with the telecom, mechanical and cooling design

### **Prefabrication & modular delivery**

* Drive Anthropic's prefabricated and modular electrical strategy — developing modular skids, e-houses, and prefabricated power assemblies, and partnering with external engineering and manufacturing teams on a productization roadmap that accelerates deployment and reduces onsite labor
* Design for offsite manufacture and onsite assembly: define the interfaces between prefabricated components and site-built work, and the electrical interfaces and switchover points for temporary-to-permanent power sequencing
* Drive standardization of modular electrical designs across sites to compress deployment timelines while preserving flexibility for site-specific constraints and evolving hardware generations

### **Partner, vendor & utility coordination**

* Work with regional vendors and manufacturers to specify and qualify major electrical equipment, and partner with supply chain to build a diversified vendor base that mitigates lead-time and single-source risk
* Work with utilities and interconnection/transmission operators (e.g., ISOs/RTOs) to define site utility service and interconnection requirements, and with local authorities having jurisdiction to ensure designs comply with the National Electrical Code (NFPA 70/NEC), NFPA, IEEE, UL/ANSI, and local requirements
* Work with Anthropic's hardware and compute teams to translate accelerator power, density, and power-quality requirements into electrical design criteria, and keep the reference architecture aligned with upcoming hardware generations
* Present findings and design positions to internal stakeholders, build partners, and operations teams through clear reports and presentations, and defend them under challenge

### **Design review & quality**

* Review and approve electrical design packages, calculations, submittals, and shop drawings from build partners and MEP consultants; track clarifications, deviations, and exceptions against the basis of design, and hold the line on capacity, reliability, maintainability, and safety requirements
* Perform technical due diligence and design reviews on data center developer and partner projects — evaluating their electrical single-lines, equipment selections, studies, and specifications against Anthropic's reliability, maintainability, and capacity requirements
* Define project electrical scope and serve as the design authority on RFIs and field changes that affect design intent during procurement and construction
* Support factory acceptance testing, commissioning, and startup — reviewing test procedures and results against design intent, participating on site for key milestones, and closing as-built changes back into the reference design
* Manage concurrent projects across multiple geographies
* Continuously improve Anthropic's internal electrical design standards, tooling, and delivery practices, and act as a technical leader within the engineering group and across the internal and external teams that support our data centers

**You may be a good fit if you**
--------------------------------

* Have 10+ years of electrical engineering experience in mission-critical facilities, with substantial time spent on data center or other high-availability electrical distribution design — from concept through construction documents and into commissioning support
* Have deep familiarity with US electrical codes and standards — including the National Electrical Code (NFPA 70/NEC), NFPA 70E, IEEE standards (e.g., 1584 for arc flash), and UL/ANSI equipment standards (e.g., UL 891, UL 1558) — and with utility interconnection processes
* Have hands-on experience producing and reviewing electrical construction documents, single-line diagrams, and equipment specifications, and can interpret data center floor plans and technical layouts with confidence
* Have strong knowledge of power distribution and cooling infrastructure in high-availability data center environments
* Are fluent in power systems analysis and comfortable running or critically reviewing studies in tools such as SKM, ETAP, or EasyPower
* Understand critical power topologies (2N, N+1, distributed redundant, block redundant) and can articulate the trade-offs between them for different reliability and cost targets
* Have working knowledge of HV/MV substations, on-site generation, and energy storage integration, and how each shapes the overall electrical architecture
* Have hands-on experience with prefabricated and modular data center electrical infrastructure — design for offsite manufacture, modular skids/e-houses, and the interfaces between prefabricated components and onsite assembly
* Have worked directly with electrical equipment manufacturers, A/E consultants, and contractors, and can evaluate products and designs on technical merit, not just datasheet claims
* Hold a bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related field, or have equivalent practical experience; Professional Engineer (PE) licensure is valued but not required
* Communicate clearly with both technical peers and non-specialist stakeholders, and are comfortable defending a design position under scrutiny from partners and internal reviewers

**Strong candidates may also have**
-----------------------------------

* Experience owning the electrical basis of design or reference architecture for a hyperscale or large colocation program, and driving its adoption across multiple sites or by external build partners
* A track record building modular prefabricated products in the electrical or mechanical scope of a data center, and driving designs toward offsite manufacturing
* Background in medium-/high-voltage distribution, on-site generation, or battery energy storage system (BESS) integration, and how those shape the building-side electrical design
* Exposure to liquid-cooled infrastructure and its implications for electrical room layout and load distribution
* Prior work at a hyperscaler, colocation provider, or MEP consultancy serving large data center clients
* Direct project experience delivering data centers in multiple US markets (e.g., Virginia, Texas, Arizona, Ohio, Oregon)

-------------

We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.  
  
**Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

**How we're different**
-----------------------

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

**Come work with us!**
----------------------

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. **About the Role**

As a Mechanical Engineer focused on Data Collection Hardware, you will bridge the gap between human operators and humanoid kinematics. Your time will be spent in fast-paced rapid development of handheld UMI data-collection tools capable of capturing delicate contact dynamics. Later, there will be the opportunity for rigorous, precision engineering as you architect and build a hand and human exoskeletons.

To train robot foundation models at Persona, we will be relying on massive amounts of high-quality, human-demonstrated data, including rich force and tactile feedback. We are looking for a highly capable Mechanical Engineer to own the physical hardware our operators use to collect data. You will initially be responsible for rapidly iterating on agile, handheld Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) devices.

**What You Will Be Doing**

* **Force-Aware UMI Hardware Design:** Design, rapid prototype, and assemble handheld UMI frames, grippers, and mounting rigs that accurately mimic our humanoid’s hand mechanics while integrating load cells and force-torque sensors to capture contact forces.
* **Sensor & Actuator Integration:** Design precise, vibration-resistant mounts for spatial tracking sensors, GoPros, embedded electronics, and force sensors in the UMI. Seamlessly integrate high-resolution encoders and haptic-feedback motors in the console to enable robust, force-aware data collection corresponding with the robot’s senses.
* **Rapid Prototyping & Manufacturing:** Seamlessly shift between rapid in-house 3D printing for UMI iterations and sourcing machined metal components (CNC, sheet metal) for the console structure.

  + Defining PCBA outlines when working with EE (mounting points, outline).

* IP rating considerations for equipment used outdoors (water resistance).
* Human ergonomics when designing for use with human hands.
* Basic thermal analysis for components mounted with hardware.

*Join Blue Origin as we build infrastructure in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re developing a satellite constellation of orbital data centers, Sunrise, designed to transform how compute infrastructure is deployed and leveraged.*

  

**Job Summary:** As part of a hardworking team of diverse specialists, technicians, and engineers, you will serve as the box Responsible Engineer (RE) for our Power Regulator products supporting Project Sunrise. Our Power Regulator product line regulates power provided by our solar array, regulates power to and from our batteries, and converts power from our High Voltage DC (HVDC) bus down to low voltage DC power for our compute hardware.

You will own the Power Regulator as an integrated product, leading a multi-disciplinary team of engineers across custom ASIC design, circuit design, electromagnetic design, board layout, thermal management, mechanical design, firmware development, manufacturing, and test. You will be the technical integrator and single point of accountability for the box from requirements definition through design, qualification, flight, and standing up a production line that initially produces megawatt-scale quantities of power regulators annually while quickly scaling to the gigawatt scale. You will also have programmatic ownership of the Power Regulator and be expected to deliver the product on time and cost-competitive with its terrestrial equivalent.

Sunrise will be produced at constellation scale, which means your design decisions directly impact manufacturing yield, unit cost, test throughput, and schedule. This is not a flagship mission environment where schedule is measured in years and cost is secondary. You will be expected to balance rigorous space-grade reliability with aggressive cost and manufacturability targets, and to deliver a product that is cost-competitive with its terrestrial equivalent.

  

**Responsibilities include but are not limited to:**

* Serve as the single-threaded owner and Responsible Engineer (RE) for the Power Regulator product, leading a multidisciplinary team and owning the product architecture, requirements, interfaces, and budgets from concept through production.
* Lead the hands-on technical design and analysis of high-voltage, high-frequency switching power converters, including topology selection, component sizing (semiconductors, magnetics), control strategy, schematic design, and detailed electrical, thermal, and reliability analyses (WCA, FMEA).
* Own the complete hardware verification and qualification strategy, from developing test plans for prototype and flight hardware to leading anomaly investigations and ensuring the product is fully validated for the space environment.

* **Advanced Power Conversion Expertise:** Deep experience with high-frequency, wide-bandgap (GaN/SiC) converters, advanced topologies (e.g., resonant, isolated), and high-frequency magnetics design.

description:
Headquartered in Houston, Texas, Panthera Grid Partners is a portfolio company of Brookfield, one of the world’s largest owners and operators of renewable power and sustainable solutions.

Panthera Grid Partners delivers reliable, utility-scale solar, wind and energy storage infrastructure to meet America’s growing demand for domestic energy.

With a portfolio exceeding 10 gigawatts, Panthera Grid Partners operates in U.S. power markets where load growth, grid reliability and capital investment are most critical. The company develops, acquires, builds, and operates renewable energy assets with a disciplined, precision-driven focus on execution, performance, and operational integrity.
  
Through responsible land stewardship and strong local partnerships, Panthera Grid Partners delivers energy projects with respect for land, agriculture, and local priorities, working with landowners and communities to support long-term land value and strengthen regional economies.

**Job Summary**

The Performance Data Engineer owns the data architecture, pipelines, performance calculation layer, and reporting processes for Panthera Grid’s operating utility-scale solar and battery energy storage portfolio. The role builds and maintains the governed platform used by performance and reliability engineers and serves as the trusted source for reporting delivered to stakeholders at all levels. This position ingests and standardizes SCADA, meteorological, inverter, tracker, revenue meter, and PPA settlement data; implements fleet KPI definitions as versioned and tested code; and delivers fleet-wide reporting through Microsoft Fabric and Power BI.

The Performance Data Engineer holds decision rights on data tooling and architecture for the team and partners closely with, Reliability Engineering, Asset Management, Operations & Maintenance, Commercial Operations, and IT/OT to ensure that data supporting performance decisions is complete, consistent, transparent, and trusted.

**Responsibilities**

**Data Platform and Architecture**
----------------------------------

* Own the team’s data platform architecture, including the Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse and Warehouse, and hold decision rights on data tooling.
* Design and maintain the asset hierarchy, tag mapping, and reporting-oriented time-series storage model for the operating fleet.
* Integrate SCADA platforms, meteorological feeds, inverter and tracker data, revenue meters, and settlement data through APIs and automated pipelines while supporting existing AWS integrations.
* Own the asset onboarding pipeline so that adding a new site is a repeatable configuration process rather than a custom project.
* Lead the digitization of existing tools, workbooks, and manual workflows into standardized, governed solutions that can scale across the portfolio and various asset platforms.

**Performance Calculation and Analytics**
-----------------------------------------

* Implement standard fleet KPIs—including availability, performance ratio, weather-adjusted expected energy, degradation, and loss attribution—as versioned, tested code.
* Build reusable analytical frameworks for degradation analysis, long-term performance projections, and production-loss attribution for interpretation by performance engineers.
* Validate expected energy production through statistical analysis and comparison with performance models in partnership with Performance Engineering.
* Supply validated data, tooling, and analysis for root cause investigations, incident reviews, performance guarantee evaluations, and contractual testing.

**Reporting and Business Intelligence**
---------------------------------------

* Own the reporting architecture, including Power BI semantic models, KPI definitions, refresh schedules, access, and distribution.
* Deliver daily, monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting against budget, P50 forecasts, and contractual guarantees from a single governed source.
* Develop and maintain dashboards, executive summaries, technical reports, and analytical tools for internal and external stakeholders.
* Partner with Asset Management and Commercial Operations to quantify operational risks, production impacts, and revenue implications.
* Support M&A activities by providing the operating data, cost actuals, and analytical tooling used by Asset Management and Finance to build operating expense (OpEx) models, scenario analyses, and portfolio valuations for acquisitions and due diligence.
* Integrate and maintain day-ahead/real-time (DA/RT) market, settlement, and curtailment data, and provide the data models and reporting that enable Commercial Operations and Asset Management to analyze price, basis, congestion, and settlement exposure.

**Data Quality, Governance, and Operations**
--------------------------------------------

* Define and enforce data quality rules, lineage, monitoring, and reconciliation against revenue meter and settlement data.
* Maintain clear documentation of data flows, calculation logic, KPI definitions, platform architecture, and operating procedures.
* Automate recurring workflows using Python, SQL, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, APIs, and related technologies.
* Monitor platform reliability, troubleshoot data failures, and coordinate resolution with IT/OT, vendors, O&M providers, and internal teams.
* Stay current with data engineering practices and renewable-energy technologies affecting solar PV, BESS, trackers, inverters, and energy analytics.
* Identify opportunities to scale reusable data products, diagnostic workflows, and self-service reporting across the portfolio to improve reporting speed, troubleshooting efficiency, consistency, and program scalability.

 **Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data engineering, electrical engineering, statistics, physics, meteorology, or another quantitative field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* At least five years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, business intelligence, or a related technical role; renewable-energy or utility experience is strongly preferred.
* Advanced proficiency with SQL and Python and demonstrated experience building production-grade, maintainable data pipelines and analytical workflows.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services, lakehouse or warehouse architecture, Power BI semantic models, and data orchestration tools.
* Experience integrating APIs, SCADA or other operational technology data, time-series datasets, and enterprise business systems.
* Strong knowledge of data modeling, testing, source control, documentation, lineage, observability, and data-quality practices.
* Ability to translate business and engineering requirements into scalable data products and explain complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Professional verbal and written communication skills, sound judgment, and the ability to work independently across multiple priorities.
* Demonstrated experience modernizing spreadsheet- or script-based processes into scalable, governed data products that improve reporting and operational troubleshooting.

Location: Hybrid in Houston, Texas (4 days in office, Fridays remote).

**Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Visa sponsorship or transfer visas, including H-1B or L-2, are not available for this position.**

**Preferred**

* Experience with utility-scale solar PV, battery energy storage systems, renewable asset management, or energy markets.
* Familiarity with plant performance metrics such as availability, performance ratio, expected energy, degradation, curtailment, and production-loss attribution.
* Experience with platforms such as AlsoEnergy, Power Factors, OEM monitoring systems, revenue meters, settlements data, or similar sources.
* Experience with cloud architecture, CI/CD, infrastructure governance, machine learning, predictive analytics, or advanced data science.
* Experience working with IT/OT security, NERC or utility compliance requirements, and third-party technology providers.

Experience supporting renewable-energy M&A, technical due diligence, or portfolio valuation through operating expense modeling, cost benchmarking, sensitivity analysis, and scenario development.

 **Benefits**

Panthera Grid Partners offers an exciting benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, health savings account, flexible spending account, company-paid life insurance and short-term disability, voluntary life, and long-term disability, paid paternal leave, and a retirement plan with matching contributions. Full-time position with competitive compensation package, including bonus.

title: Senior Security Engineer – Data Pipeline & Observability - Mid-Atlantic region (Remote)
description:
GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. **General Description**

GuidePoint is both a Value-Added Reseller (VAR) and a professional services organization, and an award winning Cribl partner (Cribl Americas Solution Provider Partner of the Year, 2026). In this role you will work directly with our vendor partners and account teams, see the same problems across many client environments, and keep up with a market that is changing quickly.

Security data is growing faster than security budgets. Clients come to us because their SIEM bill is out of control, their data is inconsistent, or they are moving platforms and need the data to arrive clean. You will design and build the pipelines that fix those problems, and you will explain the cost and security trade-offs to the people who pay for them

**About our Mid-Atlantic SecOps practice**

Our team of data engineers, SecOps engineers, consultants, architects, and platform specialists focuses on data integration, normalization, quality, routing, retention, and platform optimization. We partner with clients, account executives, project managers, source-system owners, security teams, and technology providers to create supportable data services.

Key areas of focus include:

* Establishing reliable and reusable data pipelines.
* Improving data quality, accessibility, and processing efficiency.
* Supporting security, observability, analytics, and operational use cases.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Architect, deploy, and optimize telemetry pipelines with Cribl Stream, Edge, Lake, and Search, and with comparable platforms such as SentinelOne AI Data Pipelines (Observo AI), CrowdStrike Onum, Palo Alto Networks Chronosphere, Datadog Observability Pipelines (Vector), Splunk Edge Processor, and the OpenTelemetry Collector
* Onboard, parse, and normalize data from syslog, agents, cloud provider logs, SaaS APIs, identity (Microsoft Entra ID, Okta), EDR, and network sources into common schemas (OCSF, Splunk CIM, Elastic ECS, Google UDM)
* Build reduction, filtering, enrichment, and tiering strategies that send only high value data to premium analytics platforms, keep full fidelity copies in low cost storage, and support replay on demand
* Quantify the business cases of baseline ingest, model savings, and present before and after results to technical and financial stakeholders
* Brief client senior leadership (CISO, CIO, CFO) on findings, progress, and recommendations, framed around the customer's measured business goals (cost avoided, coverage gained, risk reduced, time to investigate) rather than the technical components alone
* Size and harden deployments, including worker topology, high availability and disaster recovery, queuing and backpressure, and fleet health monitoring, across on-premises, cloud, hybrid, and regulated environments
* Build governance into the data flow with masking and redaction of sensitive data, role-based access control, TLS/PKI, and retention policy
* Lead the data workstream of SIEM and platform migrations (for example Splunk, Elastic, Microsoft Sentinel, Google SecOps, CrowdStrike Falcon Next-Gen SIEM, SentinelOne AI SIEM)
* Deliver pipeline health checks and optimization assessments with prioritized, actionable roadmaps
* Support pre-sales by joining scoping calls with Solutions Architects and account teams, estimate level of effort, and contribute to statements of work
* Work with vendor partner engineering teams on joint delivery, escalations, and product feedback and maintain current partner certifications
* Work alongside Detection & Response and Automation & AI engineers to establish clean and well routed data to help make detection content, automation, and AI SOC agents more effective for our customers.
* Serve as the technical point of contact on engagements, with clear progress reporting, as-built documentation, runbooks, and knowledge transfer to client teams
* Contribute to practice intellectual property, including reusable packs, delivery playbooks, and effort baselines, and mentor other engineers

**Required Experience and Education:**

* 5+ years in cybersecurity, IT operations, or data engineering, including 3+ years building and running production telemetry pipelines
* Hands-on production experience with Cribl Stream or a comparable pipeline platform
* Working knowledge of at least one SIEM or analytics destination (Splunk, Elastic, Microsoft Sentinel, Google SecOps, CrowdStrike, or SentinelOne), enough to know what the data must look like when it arrives
* Client-facing delivery experience as a consultant with a services firm, VAR, systems integrator, MSSP, or vendor professional services team, or an equivalent internal role delivering to multiple business units
* Linux administration and networking fundamentals (syslog over TCP/UDP/TLS, load balancing, firewalls), plus logging services in at least one cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Scripting and data skills: JavaScript, Python, or Bash; regular expressions; REST APIs; JSON, key-value, CSV, and XML formats
* Ability to engage senior leadership and translate technical work into business terms, tying recommendations to the customer's measurable goals rather than to the technical components alone, in writing and in person
* Cribl Certified User and Cribl Certified Admin (Stream), held at hire or earned within 90 days
* Embraces emerging technologies, including AI tools, to work smarter, solve problems, and drive better business outcomes.

**Preferred Experience and Education**

* Experience at a VAR, systems integrator, or MSSP working within vendor partner programs (partner certifications, joint delivery, supporting account teams on deals)
* Technical writing experience: assessment reports, executive summaries, architecture and as-built documents, and roadmaps written for both technical and executive readers (writing samples welcome)
* Delivery experience on more than one pipeline platform, with the judgment to recommend the right tool for the client
* Cribl Certified Admin (Edge); Splunk Certified Admin or Architect; Elastic Certified Engineer; SentinelOne AI Data Pipelines; cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Kubernetes and containers; Terraform or Ansible; Git and CI/CD for pipeline configuration as code
* Kafka, object storage and data lakes (Amazon S3, Azure Blob, Cribl Lake), and Snowflake or Databricks as destinations
* OpenTelemetry for metrics and traces, and IT observability use cases alongside security
* Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK data sources and what detection engineers need from the data

**Travel Requirements:**

**Physical Requirements:**

* Sedentary work
* Substantial movement of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers for a minimum of 8 hours a day
* Required to have close visual acuity to view computer terminal and/or extensive reading for a minimum of 8 hours a day

GuidePoint Security is a rapidly growing, profitable, privately-held value added reseller that focuses exclusively on Information Security. Since its inception in 2011, GuidePoint has grown to over 1,300 employees, established strategic partnerships with leading security vendors, and serves as a trusted advisor to more than 6,200 customers.

**Some added perks….**

* Group Medical Insurance options: Zero Deductible PPO Plan (GuidePoint pays 90% of the premium for employees and 70% for family plans (spouse/children/family) or High Deductible Health Plan with HSA (GuidePoint pays 100% of the employees premiums and 75% for family plans (spouse/children/family). **Location: Remote | Type: Contract**

  

**About Newpage Solutions**

Newpage Solutions is a global digital health innovation company helping people live longer, healthier lives. We partner with life sciences organisations which include, pharmaceutical, biotech and healthcare leaders, to build transformative AI and data driven technologies addressing real-world health challenges.

From strategy and research to UX design and agile development, we deliver and validate impactful solutions using lean, human-centered practices.

We are proud to be a ‘Great Place to Work®’ certified company for the last three consecutive years. We also hold a top Glassdoor rating and are named among the "Top 50 Most Promising Healthcare Solution Providers" by CIOReview. As an organisation, we foster creativity, continuous learning and inclusivity, creating an environment where bold ideas thrive and make a measurable difference in people’s lives.

  

**Your Mission**

Design and build scalable data infrastructure, integration pipelines, and storage systems that power analytics and AI-driven applications. Work closely with teams across Commercial, Manufacturing, and R&D to navigate complex enterprise data landscapes, uncover hidden data needs, and deliver reliable data solutions.

In this forward-deployed role, you will investigate undocumented data sources, establish robust integration patterns, and transform ambiguous data challenges into clear, scalable data strategies. You will also optimize the use of AI tools in data workflows while maintaining strong verification and data quality standards.

As a Staff Data Engineer, you will lead initiatives with cross-team impact — identifying reusable patterns, guiding engineers on data discovery practices, and helping scale validated solutions across the organization.

  

**What You’ll Do**

**Responsibilities:**

* **Business**: Immerse in operations until you think like an insider. Rapidly acquire domain expertise through direct observation, translate between business and engineering seamlessly, and mentor engineers in your area on immersion. Influence senior stakeholders effectively, manage complex stakeholder landscapes with competing agendas, and build trust rapidly with new stakeholders.
* **Delivery**: Lead rapid delivery initiatives across teams in your area, coach on prototype-first approaches for data solutions, and establish trust through consistent fast delivery. Navigate complex enterprise data landscapes, build relationships to gain data access, handle undocumented schemas through investigation, and define clear criteria for prototype-to-production transitions.
* **People**: Build high-performing teams across your area, navigate complex interpersonal dynamics, foster psychological safety, and create environments where diverse perspectives are valued. Influence through communication at all levels — from frontline to executive. Handle difficult conversations skillfully and train engineers in your area on effective communication.
* **AI-Augmented Development**: Optimise AI tool usage across teams in your area, train engineers on AI-augmented workflows, evaluate new AI development tools, and establish practices that balance AI speed with verification rigour.
* **Scale**: Design complex data architectures spanning multiple systems across teams. Make strategic trade-offs between consistency, performance, and maintainability. Establish and enforce quality standards across teams in your area, mentor engineers on effective code review, and drive testing strategies for data pipelines.
* **Documentation**: Define documentation standards across teams in your area, create documentation systems and templates for data pipelines, train engineers on spec-driven development, and ensure data lineage documentation quality across projects. Lead pattern generalization initiatives, defining criteria for when to generalize versus keep custom.
* **Reliability**: Define reliability standards across teams in your area, drive post-incident improvements systematically for data pipeline failures, design capacity planning processes for data infrastructure, and mentor engineers on SRE practices applied to data systems.
* **Process**: Lead lean transformations across teams in your area, design flow-optimised processes for data delivery, coach engineers on lean principles, and balance speed with sustainability. Establish metrics that drive improvement.

  

**Role Behaviours**

* **Own the Outcome**: Drive accountability culture focused on outcomes not deliverables. Own business relationships and impact metrics across your function. Make trade-offs between custom data solutions and generalisable work. There is no "I must run this by X." Ensure verification rigour for AI-generated code — particularly critical for data transformations.
* **Be Polymath Oriented**: Champion cross-disciplinary learning. Create holistic data solutions spanning technical and business domains. Embody the Renaissance Engineer ideal. Translate specialised data engineering knowledge into accessible explanations. Think like a business insider.
* **Communicate with Precision**: Create spec-driven development practices for data pipelines. Mentor others on precise communication around data definitions, quality expectations, and pipeline behaviour. Span C-level executives to frontline workers. Drive clarity as a core value across your function. Represent the organisation externally.
* **Don't Lose Your Curiosity**: Drive team curiosity through challenging questions about data quality and sources. Create environments where exploration and experimentation with data are encouraged. Model problem discovery orientation. Seek out ambiguity in data landscapes rather than avoiding it.
* **Think in Systems**: Shape systems design practices across your function for data architectures. Conduct chaos engineering experiments on data pipelines. Influence cross-team architecture decisions. Create clarity from complexity. Bridge technical data systems with business processes.

  

**Practitioner-level Skills**

* **Data Integration**: You navigate complex enterprise data landscapes across teams, build relationships to gain data access, handle undocumented schemas through investigation, and build robust, maintainable integration solutions. You mentor engineers in your area on data integration challenges.
* **Data Modelling**: You design complex data architectures spanning multiple systems across teams. You make strategic trade-offs between consistency, performance, and maintainability. You mentor engineers in your area on data modelling best practices.
* **Architecture & Design**: You design complex multi-component systems end-to-end, evaluate architectural options for large initiatives across teams, guide technical decisions for your area, and mentor engineers on architecture. You balance elegance with delivery needs.

  

**Working-level Skills**

* **Code Quality & Review**: You produce consistently high-quality, well-tested data pipeline code. You review AI-generated code critically and never ship code you don't fully understand. You identify edge cases and ensure adequate test coverage.
* **Full-Stack Development**: You build complete applications rapidly across any technology stack for teams in your area. You select the right tools for each problem, balance technical debt with delivery speed, and mentor engineers on full-stack development.
* **DevOps & CI/CD**: You build complete CI/CD pipelines end-to-end, manage infrastructure as code, implement monitoring, and design deployment strategies for your data services.
* **Cloud Platforms**: You design cloud-native data solutions, manage infrastructure as code, implement security best practices, and make informed service selections. You troubleshoot cloud-specific issues.
* **Site Reliability Engineering**: You design observability strategies for your data services, lead incident response, implement resilience testing, and conduct blameless post-mortems. You balance reliability investment with feature velocity.
* **AI-Augmented Development**: You integrate AI tools strategically into your development workflow. You review AI-generated code with the same rigour as human code and never ship code you don't fully understand.
* **AI Evaluation & Observability**: You design evaluation frameworks with custom evaluators tailored to your use case. You build golden datasets, establish annotation workflows with clear rubrics, and run experiments to compare prompt and model changes systematically.
* **Problem Discovery**: You seek out undefined data problems rather than avoiding them. You embed with users to discover latent data needs, coach engineers in your area on problem discovery techniques, and turn ambiguity into clear problem statements.
* **Rapid Prototyping & Validation**: You lead rapid delivery initiatives across teams in your area, coach on prototype-first approaches, establish trust through consistent fast delivery, and define clear criteria for prototype-to-production transitions.
* **Business Immersion**: You immerse in operations until you think like an insider. You rapidly acquire domain expertise through direct observation, translate between business and engineering seamlessly, and mentor engineers in your area on immersion.
* **Stakeholder Management**: You manage multiple stakeholders with different interests, navigate conflicting priorities diplomatically, and build trust through consistent delivery. You tailor communication to each audience.
* **Multi-Audience Communication**: You influence through communication at all levels — from frontline to executive. You handle difficult conversations skilfully, train engineers in your area on effective communication, and represent teams across the function.

  

**Foundational-level Skills**

* **AI Literacy**: You evaluate AI solutions critically for specific use cases. You understand bias, fairness, and hallucination risks. You make informed decisions about when AI helps versus when traditional approaches are better.
* **Technical Writing**: You create comprehensive documentation for complex data systems. You write precise specifications that enable accurate AI-generated code, establish documentation practices for your projects, and ensure docs are discoverable.
* **Team Collaboration**: You facilitate collaboration across the team, resolve minor conflicts before they escalate, enable others to succeed, and contribute positively to team dynamics and morale.
* **Pattern Generalization**: You extract reusable components from field data solutions, design appropriate abstractions that balance flexibility with simplicity, and collaborate with FDEs to validate generalised solutions in new contexts.
* **Data Analysis**: You perform exploratory data analysis independently, create effective visualisations, and identify patterns in data. You ask good questions about data quality and context.
* **Knowledge Management**: You create searchable knowledge articles proactively, maintain team documentation, and organise information so others can find it.

  
  

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or related field with 5+ years of relevant professional experience.
* Deep production experience with Python, SQL, and cloud data platforms (AWS preferred — including services such as Glue, S3, Redshift, Lambda, and EMR; Snowflake, Azure, or GCP also valued) is required.
* Proven expertise in large-scale data integration, distributed data processing (such as Spark), and enterprise data architecture is essential.
* Experience with enterprise data platforms (such as Salesforce Data Cloud or similar CRM data systems) is strongly valued.
* Demonstrable fluency with AI coding tools (such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar) and hands-on experience architecting data infrastructure that supports generative AI applications (data preparation for LLMs, vector databases, RAG systems, evaluation pipelines) is essential.
* Experience leading data initiatives across multiple teams, mentoring engineers, and navigating complex enterprise data landscapes with undocumented or messy data sources is required.
* Experience in an embedded, forward-deployed, or consulting-style engineering model is a strong plus.

  

**Additional Notes**

Must have exceptional communication skills and demonstrated ability to influence at senior levels. This role requires comfort leading across ambiguous data environments, building trust-based relationships with commercial stakeholders at all levels, developing junior and mid-level data engineers, and making strategic decisions that balance delivery speed with data quality and architectural integrity. You will shape data engineering practices across your area and be expected to lead multi-team data initiatives.  



**What We Offer**

  

At Newpage, we’re building a company that works smart and grows with agility, where driven individuals come together to do work that matters. We offer:

You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of Amazon Web Services' physical infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that support millions of customers worldwide.  
The Data Center Chief Engineer (CE) is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. The CE serves as an expert technical resource reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager, interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third-party vendors. The **Condition Monitoring Engineer** leads condition monitoring and predictive maintenance for power plants and utility substation equipment to improve reliability, availability, and asset life. The role requires 6-10+ years of relevant experience in power plant monitoring, including gas turbines, reciprocating generators, diesel and natural-gas generation, associated alternators, and balance-of-plant systems.

This engineer combines field inspections, online monitoring, diagnostic testing, and operating-data analysis to detect deterioration, assess equipment health, and recommend timely maintenance. The role partners with operations, maintenance, electrical, mechanical, controls, reliability, and equipment manufacturers to support safe operation and prevent unplanned outages.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and manage condition monitoring programs, asset criticality assessments, inspection routes, monitoring frequencies, baseline measurements, return-to-service activities by establishing baselines and identifying equipment health indicators abnormal equipment behavior for generation and utility substation assets.
* Perform vibration analysis using spectra, time waveforms, phase, envelope analysis, and operating trends to identify imbalance, misalignment, looseness, bearing defects, and other rotating-equipment faults.
* Lead condition monitoring programs for power generation and utility substation assets, establish monitoring priorities, baselines, alarm thresholds, and escalation criteria.
* Monitor gas turbines, diesel and natural-gas reciprocating generators, alternators, and auxiliary equipment using vibration analysis, thermography, lubricant analysis, ultrasound, and operating trends to identify deterioration and developing faults.
* Assess utility substation equipment, including transformers, bushings, circuit breakers, switchgear, and cables, using thermal surveys, oil and dissolved gas analysis, and applicable electrical diagnostic results.
* Interpret transformers dissolved gas analysis, oil quality, moisture, temperature, cooling-system performance, and bushing and tap-changer condition; correlate trends with loading, operating history, and laboratory findings.
* Conduct infrared thermography and ultrasound surveys; assess partial-discharge data where applicable, breaker operating times and contact resistance, insulating-medium condition, and insulation test results with electrical testing specialists.
* Establish and periodically review condition baselines, alarm thresholds, diagnostic rules, and escalation criteria using manufacturer guidance, operating context, equipment history, and applicable standards; coordinate changes through approved controls.
* Analyze alarms and abnormal trends, confirm data validity, assess fault severity and progression, and issue actionable recommendations with urgency, operating implications, inspection needs, and maintenance priorities.
* Translate findings into maintenance work orders, outage scopes, repair and replacement recommendations, and asset-life assessments; track actions to closure and confirm equipment condition after maintenance.
* Support commissioning, acceptance testing, startup and shutdown monitoring, load testing, and return-to-service activities by establishing baselines and identifying abnormal equipment behavior.
Maintain diagnostic reports, asset health dashboards, inspection records, and computerized maintenance management system data; report defect detection, monitoring coverage, action closure, and reliability improvement, and train site personnel.  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Condition Monitoring, Electromechanical Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 6-10+ years of relevant experience in power plant condition monitoring, predictive maintenance, or equipment diagnostics, including practical monitoring of gas turbines and diesel and natural-gas reciprocating generators.
* Demonstrated ability to perform condition monitoring of utility substation equipment, including transformers, circuit breakers, switchgear, bushings, cables, and associated auxiliary systems.
* Strong practical competence in vibration data collection and analysis, infrared thermography, lubricant analysis, ultrasound, and interpretation of operating and performance trends.
* Advanced technical expertise in interpreting transformer dissolved gas and insulating-oil analyses, electrical insulation diagnostics, partial-discharge measurements, and circuit-breaker condition indicators; demonstrated ability to correlate diagnostic results, identify developing failure modes, assess fault severity, and define appropriate specialist testing and corrective actions.

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for global customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft, making us the financial technology platform of choice. We create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by a culture that encourages ownership and provides the support to truly own your career. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team, delivering innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

  

**Data Foundations**

Adyen is building a top-tier data team across San Francisco and Amsterdam. The goal is to accelerate data as our most differentiating and least replicable asset across our company. We are focusing on the foundations: the things that make data work as one thing. We decide how it fits together, what it means, and how anyone, human or AI, can trust and use it.

The team is new and sits at the heart of our engineering organization. You will join as one of its technical leaders. You will architect data and work on complex challenges across the company, multiplying your impact through the teams and people you work with. You win them over with good design, working prototypes and trust. By driving decisions through ambiguity, you will shape the next generation of Ayden's data.

You will be based in San Francisco and work closely with the Data Foundations lead in Amsterdam. You will have a lot of room to run your own week.

### **What you will do**

* **Build greenfield.** The mandate, the architecture and the standards are being written now. You help write them.
* **Design the foundation.** Set the target architecture for shared data models, data contracts and the semantic layer that every domain builds on.
* **Give every metric one clear meaning.** Work with domain teams so each core metric is defined once and owned by the domain that creates it. Variants get their own names.
* **Make data contracts the norm.** Agree contracts between producers and consumers, with owners, versions and automatic checks. Consumers are never surprised.
* **Build lineage in from the start.** Anyone can trace a figure to its source without asking the engineer who built the pipeline.
* **Help teams ship data products.** Guide domain teams to publish datasets with a clear owner, schema and service level. They own the product. You own the standard.
* **Stay hands-on.** Build prototypes, review designs and solve hard problems in the data stack.
* **Partner across Adyen.** Product, Finance, Compliance, Platform Engineering and domain leads. Win the argument with data and a working prototype.
* **Grow other engineers.** Mentor engineers in Data Foundations and in the domains. Help them solve problems with their own ideas, and raise the bar in design reviews.

### **Who you are**

* You have 10+ years in data engineering or data architecture, and you have worked at Staff scope. You have set direction for more than one team, and you are still hands on.
* You pick your own problems. You see what needs to change and drive it to done without being told.
* You have designed shared data models, data contracts or semantic layers that many teams build on, and you can defend the trade-offs.
* You have changed what other teams built without any authority over them. You did it with data, prototypes and trust.
* You explain hard ideas in plain words to engineers, finance people and executives. You write clearly.
* You work well with Engineering, Product, Finance, Compliance and other stakeholders, across time zones.

  

This role's annual base salary range is $258–$367k, plus RSUs. To *learn more about our compensation philosophy, please click* *here**.*

description:
**Overview of the Role**

As one of the first engineers on PowerPlan’s Applied AI team, you’ll build the data foundation behind the AI solutions our own teams use every week, across finance, sales, professional services, and product. Most of the work is finding, cleaning, and defining the data each build needs, then picking the simplest structure that will hold it, and pairing with the team’s AI engineer to put larger solutions into the business’s hands.

PowerPlan builds the financial software behind the companies that keep the lights on, and nine in ten U.S. investor-owned utilities use our platform. The Applied AI team sits inside Strategic Initiatives, works closely with the executive leadership team, and brings that same standard of getting the numbers right to how the company itself runs. The standards you help set early will shape how every build after yours gets done.

**What You’ll Actually Be Doing**

Success will be measured by whether the AI solutions you build data for are in weekly use and run by the business, and by whether new builds start from trusted, shared data instead of fresh exports.

* Learn how the company runs through its data in your first 30 days, deliver an owner-checked first catalog of critical data by the end of your first quarter, and keep it current enough by month 12 that business and technology leaders plan AI work from it.
* Help set the team’s standards for data, connections, and code review from your first 30 days, including how AI tools connect to business systems: read-only by default, no more complex than the job requires, and reviewed by IT and security.
* Pair with the team’s AI engineer on a first build in your first quarter, lead the data on the first larger build into pilot by six months, and by month 12 deliver the data behind at least two larger AI solutions in weekly use and run by the business.
* Agree on the first shared data sets in your first quarter, publish the first one by six months, and have at least two shared, governed data sets in use by more than one team or AI solution by month 12.
* Within your first 12 months, retire hand-built recurring reports by defining the numbers once, so an AI tool can draft the commentary, answer questions, and flag what needs a person’s attention.

**You’re Our Person If…**

* You have two to four years of professional experience as a data engineer, analytics engineer, or in a similar role where writing code to clean and model data was central to the job, or a master’s degree in a related field and at least one year of that experience.
* You’ve turned messy, real data from a business system, a spreadsheet, or a set of documents into something people or an AI tool used, and you can walk us through what broke and how you fixed it.
* Before you build on a number, you trace it through the systems and processes that produce it and find out from the people who own it what it means, and you can tell us about a time a business owner’s explanation changed what you built.

description:

The successful candidate will have a strong background in data engineering on the modern data stack and excellent communication skills to interact with stakeholders and clients. If you have a passion for technology, thrive in a dynamic environment, and possess strong client-facing communication skills, we want to hear from you.

### **RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Working knowledge of Python for data tooling and automation.

* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot data issues and develop effective solutions.
* Comfortable producing written guidelines and recommendations for client and third-party teams.
* Understanding of data privacy and security best practices.
* Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.
* Fluent English.

**Nice to Have**

* Snowflake (SnowPro) or dbt certification; cloud certifications welcome.
* Spark/PySpark.
* Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience with consumer or digital-product data (apps, games, subscriptions).

title: Solution Engineer, Data & AI
description:

**The Solution Engineer, Data & AI** is a hands-on builder who designs, delivers, and operates production-grade data and AI solutions. You will join a team of engineers who bring real software engineering discipline to data work — version control, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and observability are how we work, not afterthoughts. We also expect our engineers to embrace agentic engineering, using tools like Claude Code to dramatically accelerate how software gets built without compromising quality.

Depending on business need and your strengths, you will be aligned to one of two paths:

**Path 1 — Client Delivery:** Support delivery of fixed-price, outcome-based data and AI projects for clients across a wide range of industries and problem domains, on Azure, AWS, and GCP. In a fixed-price model, engineering quality and delivering within agreed scope directly affect client outcomes and project margin.

**Path 2 — Internal Data & Analytics:** Bring order to our internal data on Azure Databricks — integrating, cleaning, and modelling data from our business systems so the organization has trusted analytics and reporting and helping automate core business processes such as quote-to-cash.

Both paths share the same technical foundation, and engineers may move between paths over time as priorities and interests evolve.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Data Pipeline Engineering**
* Design, build, and maintain reliable, scalable data pipelines for batch and streaming workloads
* Apply proven lakehouse architecture patterns, with clear data contracts and well-managed schema evolution
* Build data quality checks, testing, and monitoring into every pipeline from day one
* **Data Modelling & Analysis**
* Design analytical data models that reflect business requirements and perform at scale
* Profile, explore, and analyze data to validate assumptions, surface quality issues, and share meaningful insights with stakeholders
* Apply sound data governance practices so data assets are secure, traceable, and discoverable
* **AI & Machine Learning Engineering**
* Build, train, and evaluate machine learning and generative AI solutions — from classical ML to LLM-based and agentic applications
* Establish rigorous evaluation approaches tied to clear, business-aligned success criteria
* Take models from experimentation to production, ensuring they are reliable, observable, and maintainable
* **MLOps & DevOps**
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for code, data, and models
* Manage cloud and platform resources through infrastructure as code
* Implement full model lifecycle management — versioning, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, and retraining
* Champion engineering best practices across the team: code reviews, branching strategies, automated testing, and documentation
* **Agentic Engineering**

* Provide AI agents with effective context through clear specifications, project instructions, and reusable workflows
* Apply rigorous review, testing, and validation to AI-generated code — you own the quality of what ships, regardless of who or what wrote it
* Share effective agentic workflows with the team and help codify them into repeatable practices and accelerators
* **Path 1 — Client Delivery**
* Deliver engineering workstreams on fixed-price client engagements, from technical discovery through outcome acceptance
* Work across client environments on Azure, AWS, and GCP, adapting patterns to each client’s cloud, security model, and constraints
* Partner with Architects and your Engineering Manager to deliver solutions within agreed scope, timeline, and commercial constraints
* Participate in client workshops, demos, and technical working sessions, building credibility with client technical teams
* Identify scope creep, technical risks, and blockers early — and raise them promptly and constructively
* Leave clients better off: document solutions clearly, transfer knowledge, and help build client-side capability
* Contribute to reusable accelerators, templates, and patterns that make future engagements more predictable
* **Path 2 — Internal Data & Analytics**
* Integrate data from our core business systems (e.g., CRM, PSA, finance/ERP, HR) into our Azure Databricks environment
* Clean, reconcile, and standardize messy internal data — resolving duplicates, aligning definitions across systems, and establishing a single source of truth for key entities such as customers, projects, contracts, and revenue
* Coordinate with internal teams to identify, prioritize, and resolve data quality issues at the source, and put processes in place to prevent them from recurring
* Build trusted, well-documented data models that power internal analytics, KPIs, and executive and operational reporting
* Partner with Finance, Sales, Operations, and leadership to understand reporting needs and translate them into reliable data products
* Help design and automate quote-to-cash workflows, connecting data and handoffs from opportunity through quote, contract, delivery, invoicing, and collections

  

**Qualifications:**

  

* 4+ years in software and platform engineering, including meaningful time on a collaborative software development team
* Hands-on experience building production data and ML solutions in the cloud
* Strong, demonstrable experience with the Databricks platform in production environments
* Practical experience using agentic coding tools to accelerate software development — with examples of how it has changed the way you work

* **Software Engineering & DevOps**
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL
* Solid software engineering fundamentals: Git workflows, code review, unit and integration testing, modular design
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD tooling and infrastructure as code
* Comfortable with containerization, environment management, and automated deployment
* **Cloud Platforms**
* Working knowledge of all three major clouds — Azure, AWS, and GCP — with deep hands-on experience in at least one
* Understanding of how data platforms are deployed and integrated on each cloud, including storage, identity, networking, and security
* Familiarity with each cloud’s native data and AI services and when to use them alongside Databricks
* **Databricks**
* Deep, hands-on experience across the Databricks platform, including data engineering, governance, and ML/AI capabilities
* Experience deploying and managing Databricks solutions using software engineering and DevOps best practices
* **Data Engineering & Modelling**
* Proven ability to design and build scalable batch and streaming pipelines
* Strong data modelling skills across dimensional and modern lakehouse patterns
* Experience with data quality frameworks, testing, and observability
* **AI / ML & MLOps**
* Practical experience building, evaluating, and deploying ML models to production
* Experience with generative AI patterns such as retrieval-augmented generation, agents, and LLM evaluation

* **Agentic Engineering**

* Sound judgment on where AI-assisted development adds leverage and where it introduces risk, with a disciplined approach to reviewing and testing its output

description:
**Location**

**Compensation**
----------------

* $155K – $165K • Offers Equity

  

Alt is unlocking the value of alternative assets, starting with the $5 B trading-card market. We let collectors buy, sell, vault, and finance their cards in one place and we are backed by leaders at Stripe, Coinbase, Seven Seven Six, and pro athletes like Tom Brady and Giannis Antetokounmpo. Our next frontier is real-time pricing at scale—the Alt Value that powers every trade, loan, and product on the platform.

**The Role**
------------

Alt Value is our moat. It is only as good as the data underneath it — and that data lives on dozens of external marketplaces and auction houses that have no interest in making it easy for us to get.

That's this job. You own the pipelines that scrape, normalize, and land every transaction and listing that feeds our pricing model. When a comparable sale closes on eBay or at a major auction house, how fast it shows up in Alt Value, and whether it shows up correctly, is your call and your consequence. Pricing decisions, cash advance terms, market analytics, and every dashboard in the company sit downstream of you.

**The metric you own: Data Coverage.** Supporting KPIs are pipeline latency, uptime, and source coverage.

**What You'll Own:**
--------------------

* **The ingestion layer.** Design, optimize, and own the pipelines that scrape, process, and ingest transaction and listing data from major auction houses and marketplaces. Scraper to orchestrator to warehouse, end to end.
* **Build for reuse first.** Most of the ingestion stack — auth handling, retries, session and proxy management, monitoring — should generalize across sources. Go deep and custom only where a specific source's structure actually requires it.
* **Knowing before we do.** Build the monitoring and alerting that tracks latency, uptime, and coverage across every source. A source going quiet should page you, not surprise a pricer three days later.
* **Making it cheaper and steadier.** Modernize storage and processing, cut manual intervention out of the loop, and optimize for cost, performance, and reliability.
* **The consumers.** Partner with pricing, ML, product, and analytics to deliver data clean and standardized enough that nobody downstream is writing defensive code around your output.

**How You'll Use AI Here:**
---------------------------

We don't want to hear that you use Claude every day. Everyone does. We want to know what you've built with it. Concretely, in this role:

* Point an agent at a **site that just changed its markup** and have it propose the parser fix, run it against a fixture set, and open the PR
* Build a **triage loop over the orchestrator** — cross-reference a failed DAG against logs and warehouse state, diagnose the cause, and hand you a ranked list instead of a wall of red
* Use **LLM extraction for the long tail** of low-volume sources where a bespoke scraper will never pay for itself
* Put an **MCP server over the warehouse** so a coverage question is a sentence, not another one-off query
* Use **Claude Code or Cursor** as the default way you work through a migration or a backfill, not as autocomplete

If you've built agents, written skills or MCP servers, wired up connectors, or shipped internal tooling your team actually depends on — lead with that.

**What You Bring:**
-------------------

* 3-4 years in data engineering or a closely adjacent seat.
* Modern web scraping at scale — Playwright or comparable, plus the ability to impersonate a real browser at the network layer (TLS/request fingerprinting) when a plain HTTP client gets flagged. Selenium alone doesn't cut it anymore.
* Strong Python, 3+ years hands-on. Solid SQL for analysis and transformation.
* A pipeline you owned end to end in the past two years. Not a pipeline you contributed to. One that was yours when it broke.
* Judgment on when to generalize and when to go bespoke — you don't rebuild the same infrastructure per source, and you don't force a one-size-fits-all approach onto a source that needs custom handling.
* Orchestration in your hands, not your resume. Airflow, Dagster, or a comparable DAG system — you've built on it, been paged for it, and cleaned up after it.
* Cloud development experience (AWS, GCP).
* LLM-based extraction and processing at scale (e.g. LLM-as-a-Judge, Agent loops), not just UI-based Q&A and simple Skill building.
* Startup experience. You understand the pace, and you've worked somewhere the roadmap changed under you.
* A pragmatic bias. Value delivered incrementally over the perfect rebuild.

**Bonus:** large-scale dataframe processing (Pandas, Polars, PySpark). You collect, or you have opinions about the collectibles market.

**How We'll Interview You:**
----------------------------

We'll be specific so you can prepare. *Before any of it: download the app, put a card up, make a bid, or put a card up for sell. Every round assumes you've used the product, and we expect your point of view to sharpen as you go.*

**1. Recruiter screen - 30 minutes** Come ready to talk about the metric you own today, why Alt specifically, and how you're actually using AI. We'll answer your questions and align on comp.

**2. Hiring manager with Dae, Head of Data — 30 minutes.** Be ready to go deep on one pipeline you owned end to end: the systems design, what you owned versus the team, where it broke, and what came out the other side.

**3. Coding screen — 45 minutes.** A working session on a data problem close to what this role actually does.

**4. Systems design — 60 minutes.** Design an ingestion system under real constraints. We'll push back on at least one of your choices on purpose — how you take that matters as much as the design.

**5. Cross-functional — 60 Mins** How you work with the people downstream of your data.

**6. Leore, our founder and CEO — 30 minutes.** Everyone who joins Alt meets Leore. Come with a point of view on what you'd go after first.

**7. Reference check(s) — 15 minutes** with a former manager(s)

**Compensation:** $155,000 - $165,000 per year, plus equity for all full-time employees.

**What we offer:**
==================

***For full-time Employees***

* We cover 85% of your medical, dental, and vision, and up to 50% for dependents. HSA/FSA available
* Generous PTO that people actually take
* Parental leave at full salary
* $200/month wellness + $100/month home office stipend
* Free DoorDash Pass membership, because dinner shouldn't be a decision
* Remote-first (for most positions), with WeWork access when you want a room with other humans
* 401(k)
* Alt Equity to all full-time employees

Compensation Range: $155K - $165K
