The position works extensively with Microsoft Fabric and Power BI and provides expertise in data science and advanced analytics when institutional needs require statistical, predictive, or machine-learning solutions. The Data & Analytics Engineer partners with Data Engineering, Data Governance, Institutional Research, Application Engineering, and business stakeholders to transform institutional data into trusted, scalable, and actionable analytical products. The position contributes to shared standards and reusable approaches while continuing to develop expertise across the institution's data and analytics ecosystem.

**Essential Functions**
=======================

The employee will demonstrate TSTC’s Core Values of **Excellence, Accountability, Service, and Integrity** with internal and external stakeholders, customers, students, and community members.

  

**Data & Analytics Engineering**

Designs, develops, and maintains scalable data and analytics solutions using Microsoft Fabric, SQL, Python, and related technologies. Transforms raw and complex source data into well-structured, analytics-ready datasets to support institutional reporting, business intelligence, advanced analytics, and data science initiatives. Develops and maintains analytical data models, data transformations, automated pipelines, notebooks, and reusable data assets while partnering with Data Engineering to manage Silver and Gold architectural layers. Applies robust software and data engineering practices, including version control, testing, technical documentation, code reviews, and deployment management, while troubleshooting and optimizing solutions for peak performance, reliability, and maintainability.

  

**Business Intelligence & Power BI**

Designs and delivers enterprise Power BI dashboards, reports, semantic models, and analytical tools that drive institutional decision-making. Builds and maintains reusable semantic models, standardized measures, and institutional performance metrics using Power BI, DAX, Power Query, and Microsoft Fabric. Implements best practices for data visualization, dimensional modeling, performance tuning, row-level security, and report lifecycle management. Partners closely with Data Governance and Institutional Research to ensure calculations, metrics, and institutional data definitions are consistently executed across all analytical deliverables while supporting and mentoring team members in utilizing shared analytical assets.

  

**Advanced Analytics & Data Science**

Serves as a key technical resource for data science, predictive analytics, statistical modeling, and machine learning across the institution. Evaluates complex business problems to determine where advanced statistical or machine-learning methodologies deliver actionable value beyond traditional reporting. Designs, develops, validates, and operationalizes predictive and analytical models supporting critical institutional priorities, including enrollment forecasting, student retention and completion, program alignment, financial optimization, and operational capacity planning. Executes feature engineering, exploratory data analysis, regression, classification, clustering, and time-series forecasting, collaborating with Data Engineering and Application Engineering to integrate model outputs into enterprise platforms and workflows.

  

**Data, AI & Governance**

Evaluates and prototypes emerging capabilities in analytics, machine learning, and generative artificial intelligence to address institutional challenges and enhance operational effectiveness. Ensures all data and analytics solutions adhere strictly to institutional data governance, security, privacy, and data-handling standards. Collaborates with Data Governance to maintain data quality, lineage, metadata dictionaries, data classification, and responsible data usage. Embeds responsible AI and data science principles across all deliverables, ensuring transparency, explainability, reproducibility, and appropriate oversight while maintaining comprehensive documentation of data sources, transformations, calculations, and analytical methodologies.

  

**Collaboration & Continuous Improvement**

Engages directly with institutional stakeholders to translate complex operational needs into robust data and analytics solutions. Partners across Data Engineering, Data Governance, Institutional Research, Application Engineering, and academic and administrative units to deliver integrated, high-impact data products. Effectively communicates analytical findings, methodology, and technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Actively participates in technical design reviews, peer code reviews, and standard-setting initiatives while monitoring advancements in Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and AI technologies to drive continuous improvement across the Data & Analytics ecosystem.

  

**Education & Experience**
==========================

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.
* 3 to 5 years of experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, business intelligence, data science, data engineering, or a related field.
* Experience with Microsoft Power BI or comparable business intelligence and visualization technologies, developing analytical data models and transforming source data into analytics-ready datasets.
* Experience working with data warehouses, lakehouses, data pipelines, or modern cloud-based data platforms with software development practices such as source control, testing, documentation, and code review.
* Understanding of data visualization, dimensional modeling, business intelligence concepts, statistical analysis and data science concepts.
* Proficiency in Python or a comparable programming language used for data analysis, automation, or data science.
* Strong SQL skills and experience working with complex analytical datasets.
Ability to translate business requirements and questions into data and analytical solutions.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, business intelligence, data science, data engineering, or a related field.
* Experience with Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, notebooks, pipelines, or semantic models.
* Experience with Power BI, including semantic modeling, DAX, Power Query, performance optimization, and deployment practices.
* Experience with Azure data and analytics services.
* Experience developing predictive models or machine-learning solutions.
* Knowledge of statistical modeling, forecasting, regression, classification, clustering, and other advanced analytical techniques.
* Experience with machine-learning frameworks such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar technologies.
* Understanding of MLOps concepts, including model versioning, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
* Experience with Microsoft Purview or similar data governance and lineage technologies.
* Experience with CI/CD or DevOps practices for data and analytics solutions.
* Experience working with higher education, student, financial, workforce, or other complex institutional data.
Knowledge of data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements such as FERPA.  

  

*Relevant experience may be considered in lieu of formal education where appropriate, consistent with TSTC’s equivalency philosophy.*

  

**Skills & Abilities**
======================

* Ability to design, develop, and maintain data and analytics solutions using Microsoft Fabric, SQL, Python, and related technologies, applying sound data modeling, software engineering, version control, testing, documentation, and deployment practices.
* Ability to develop Power BI dashboards, semantic models, and analytical products using DAX, Power Query, and Microsoft Fabric.

description:
### **About Switch**

At Switch, we don't just design, build and operate data centers—we are enabling the technology of the future. Led by Founder & CEO, Rob Roy, we believe in revolutionary innovation, operational excellence and the principle of karma. Switch is where talented people come together to EVOLVE the digital world.

We believe that innovation isn't just about technology—it's about the people, culture, and purpose that make it happen. Every Switch team member contributes to a mission greater than themselves: to create the world's most advanced digital infrastructure that powers the progress of humanity.

**The Role: Regional Data Center Electrical Engineer**
------------------------------------------------------

As a Regional Data Center Electrical Engineer at Switch, you will be part of a world-class team that operates in excellence, delivering mission-critical solutions that redefine what's possible in AI, cloud and enterprise data center needs. Your work will directly impact the future of technology and the sustainable growth of the Internet.

In this role you will support and optimize the operations of the critical infrastructure supporting IT loads in Switch Data Centers, including power, water, and cooling systems. You are also involved in developing solutions for continuous improvement in system performance and utilization, managing utility resourcing, capacity management, change management, efficiency, root cause analysis, design feedback, condition-based maintenance, end-of-life management, and various other data center lifecycle programs. Additionally, you are an on-site equipment and system expert, directly supporting continuous improvement, optimization, operations, and capital projects, and may also coordinate efforts globally.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Troubleshoot, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and create Corrective Actions (CA) documentation for equipment failures, including electrical critical systems.
* Directly support operational teams as the subject matter expert for issue resolution, event response, and complex procedural review, including ad-hoc training and critical equipment support.
* Perform availability, capacity, efficiency, and sustainability analyses for the electrical critical systems in the Switch data centers in your region. Produce reports outlining risks with recommended mitigations and remediation solutions.
* Monitor and interpret data center performance trends for continuous improvement and capital projects.
* Develop innovative solutions for Switch data centers, then function as the owner of conceptual designs for existing data center upgrades that improve capacity, availability, efficiency, and sustainability.
* Provide performance feedback of innovative Switch infrastructure solutions to Design Engineering.
* Function as resident engineer for construction and retrofit projects for critical environments.
* Interface with internal data center operations team, data center design engineering team, field engineering team, and environmental health and safety team to promote standards that maintain consistency and reliability in delivered services.
* Build trust and relationships with different stakeholders (e.g., Operations, Commissioning, Construction, and Engineering).
* Work on concurrent projects, sometimes in multiple geographical regions.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* Innovators & Builders – You see challenges as opportunities and thrive in uncharted territories.
* High-Performance Thinkers – You have a relentless drive for excellence and a passion for pushing the envelope. You thrive in high impact environments where execution is key.
* Integrity-Driven Leaders – You operate with honor, responsibility, and purpose, recognizing that the energy you put out into the world will return to you.
* Tech Pioneers – You understand the power of technology to change the world and want to be at the forefront of that transformation.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* A Bachelor of Science in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or higher with a certification as a Professional Engineer (PE) preferred.
* An understanding of electrical and mechanical systems that may be employed in a data center environment. This may include electrical feeders, transformers, generators, switchgear, UPS systems, power systems, ATS/STS units, PDU units, air handling units, cooling towers, pumps, and fire suppression systems.
* Ability to interpret P&IDs, wiring diagrams, schematics, Sequence of Operations, submittals, and MEP drawings packages.
* Strong Outlook, Publisher, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint skills.
* An understanding of data analysis methodologies, statistical techniques, and business acumen.
* Excel in analyzing datasets and providing strategic guidance to leadership.
* Ability to analyze and implement solutions for problem resolution.
* Easily able to work well under pressure while also being flexible, proactive, resourceful, and efficient.
* Leadership skills that promote team development and support the Switch Culture.
* A strategic mindset with the ability to balance long-term vision with operational execution.

### **Why Switch?**

* A Culture of Karma – We are self-motivated by karma, ensuring our actions contribute to a positive, supportive and forward-thinking environment.
* Industry Leading Designs – Work with the most advanced data center technology on the planet and be a part of emerging technology development.
* Flexibility & Remote Opportunities – Whether in-office, hybrid, or fully remote, we offer the technology and support to keep teams connected and productive.
* Career Stability & Growth – In this expanding industry, we invest in our people, providing opportunities & advancement in a stable, growing company.
* Generous Benefits Package - Switch provides comprehensive coverage for you and your family that can be tailored to fit your personal needs, and more!

### **Join Us & Make a Difference**

This is more than a job—it's a mission. If you're ready to be part of a culture that values innovation, karma, and limitless potential, we want to hear from you.

Apply Now and Let's Build the Future Together.

Your privacy rights may vary by location. Learn more in our Switch Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice https://www.switch.com/applicant-and-candidate-privacy/ to understand how Switch collects, uses, shares, and protects your personal information during the recruiting process.

**Safe Hiring Notice**

title: Sr. Data Engineer
description:
Our Senior Data Engineer is a hands-on, client-facing technical lead. You’ll own data pipelines and integrations for several clients at once. You’ll step into established client work, get up to speed quickly, and keep delivery moving while improving what’s already there.

You’ll be the trusted technical voice with clients. That means translating their business goals into data solutions, setting clear expectations on scope and effort, and bringing a point of view on how their data should work for them.

This is an individual contributor role reporting to the SVP of Tech and Data. You’ll lead through expertise and influence rather than direct reports, keeping engineering work on agreed architectural paths.

We’re looking for a modern-day ETL/ELT developer who works comfortably in today’s analytical environment and understands the marketing landscape, where disparate data is everywhere. You build with AI-assisted coding tools every day and help the team use them well. We do whatever it takes to solve problems, while embracing change each day.

**What you will do**
--------------------

**Lead client work**

* Own data engineering for multiple clients and projects at once, from requirements through delivery and ongoing support
* Work directly with clients to understand their business goals, and give them a clear, specific point of view
* Negotiate scope and level of effort with clients and internal teams so everyone agrees on what gets delivered and when
* Collaborate closely with analysts, engineers and managers across the agency
* Look past day-to-day tasks to the business results the work needs to deliver

**Build and own data platforms**

* Design, build and maintain data pipelines and integrations with complex source data and API services
* Take ownership of established client pipelines: reverse engineer existing SQL and pipeline code to understand its business logic, and document it as you go
* Move and model data across platforms using established ETL/ELT patterns, orchestrated with Apache Airflow
* Recommend and design database solutions, and handle performance tuning, troubleshooting and capacity estimation
* Keep engineering work on agreed architectural paths and follow our data warehouse development standards
* Maintain documentation for data movement and transformation processes, including process flows and data mapping

**Manage priorities, access and quality**

* Set priorities for your projects and tasks, and push back when needed to protect the right priorities and workflow
* Set the criteria for who is added to or removed from client data services and systems
* Create and manage audit reporting and quality checks so data is delivered accurately and consistently

**Solve problems**

* Identify challenges and limitations in the tools we use, and propose fixes
* Spot roadblocks early that could affect deadlines
* Break complex work into clear tasks and coordinate them with the team
* Work with teammates and external partners to troubleshoot quickly and keep delivery on track

**Stay ahead**

* Use AI coding assistants as a core part of your development work, and contribute to the team’s AI best practices
* Identify relevant new technology and share what you learn with the team

**What you should have**
------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience preferred, in computer science or information systems
* 4–5+ years of hands-on data engineering experience
* Experience with RDBMS and cloud data warehouses such as PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Snowflake and Google BigQuery
* ETL/ELT development in SQL and Python, with orchestration in Apache Airflow; familiarity with dbt is helpful
* Experience with AWS and GCP, with strong hands-on experience in at least one
* Advanced SQL, including stored procedures, indexing and database IO performance tuning
* Solid understanding of data warehouse design principles and relational and non-relational data models
* Regular use of AI-assisted coding tools in your development work, with sound judgment about reviewing and testing what they produce
* Experience working directly with clients or business stakeholders on requirements, scope and timelines
* Proven ability to own several projects at once through delivery
* Ability to proactively identify, troubleshoot and resolve complex data integrity issues
* The ability to leverage cut and paste proficiently
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to explain technical details to non-technical audiences
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to work with minimal supervision in an agile environment and pivot quickly as analytical needs change

**A big plus if you have any of the following**
-----------------------------------------------

* Agency and marketing data experience
* API development
* DBA duties and responsibilities
* Experience taking over and documenting systems someone else built

**Here is a little bit about us**
---------------------------------

Tandem Theory is an agency with a winning culture. We believe that when the agency wins, Theorists win too. Winning happens through collaboration, personal growth, industry recognition, and operational excellence that makes our work stronger and more efficient. Most importantly, a winning culture thrives on feedback - helping each other improve so we can all achieve more together.

We’ve built our culture around three core behaviors: Teamwork, Transparency, and Trust. They’re not just words on a poster. We apply them every day to guide our internal and client relationships, and our clients tell us they feel the difference.

Headquartered in Dallas, Texas, Tandem partners with several leading brands. These brands value working with an agency led by a proven team that provides simple but impactful solutions, transparent pricing, and performance-based compensation.

**Working Conditions**

You'll set technical direction for how data flows through Greenlight Rent, from the application services and APIs that generate it to the warehouse, models and tools the business runs on. You'll partner with product, finance and operations to turn rental-housing problems into reliable software and trustworthy data.

**What you bring**

**Data Engineer II**

At Lewis Energy Group, we are a vertically integrated exploration and production (E&P) company and a leading natural gas producer in South Texas and across the nation. The **Data Engineer II** will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the organization’s data platform on Microsoft Fabric. This includes developing data pipelines using Data Factory, Dataflows Gen2, and PySpark notebooks; writing and optimizing T-SQL. Assists with the migration of on-premises SQL Server databases and ETL/ELT processes to Fabric. Build semantic models that support Power BI reporting, ensuring data quality and governance, and managing changes through source control and deployment pipelines. Works closely with business users and stakeholders, communicating technical information in a clear and accessible way.

Responsibilities:

**Data Pipeline Development**

* Design, build, and maintain data pielines in Microsoft Fabric using Data Factory pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, and notebooks to move data from source systems into Lakehouses and Warehouses.
* Develop data transformation and processing logic in Python and Pyspark within Fabric notebooks, including working with Delta tables and handling large or complex datasets.
* Develop and optimize T-SQL code, including stored procedures, views, and transformation logic, to support data processing and reporting needs.
* Apply data modeling best practice, such as medallion architecture and star schema design, to organize data in OneLake for performance and ease of use.
* Monitor pipeline runs, troubleshoot failures, and put alerting and error handling in place so that data is delivered on time and accurately.

**SQL Server to Fabric Migration**

* Assess existing on-premises SQL Server databases, SSIS packages, and scheduled jobs to plan their migration to Microsoft Fabric.
* Rebuild or refactor legacy ETL processes as Fabric-native pipelines and PySpark notebooks, improving performance and maintainability.

**Semantic Model Support**

We are not interested in making legacy processes slightly better. We are interested in building the operating model that mortgage insurance should have had all along.

**About the role**

As a Data Quality Engineer embedded in Anza MI’s Data Science & Engineering practice, you will be the primary guardian of data integrity for our mortgage-related datasets. Our team leverages a cloud-native technology stack and uses Databricks for data pipelines to analyze data and automate operational processes. Your primary responsibility will be to design, automate, and monitor data validation frameworks that support our predictive models and analytics workflows. You will adhere to engineering best practices established by the wider Technology organization. A Data Quality Engineer will work autonomously and in partnership with senior team members and business partners to ensure trust in our data assets.

**What you'll do**

**Data Validation & Monitoring**

* Build, maintain, and scale automated data quality checks natively within our Databricks environment.

**Pipeline Integration**

* Implement robust testing and validation gates within our ETL/ELT pipelines to support analytics and modeling workflows.

**Anomaly Detection**

* Investigate, diagnose, and resolve data discrepancies or pipeline failures impacting mortgage credit risk reporting.

**Team Collaboration**

* Facilitate the Data Science & Engineering team’s goals by enforcing data governance standards and following engineering practices of the Technology team.

**Continuous Learning**

* Improve engineering skills and deepen your understanding of the mortgage and housing finance markets.

**Qualifications**

**Minimum Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related fields.

**Preferred Education**

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related fields.

**Minimum Experience**

* 3 to 4 Years

**Preferred Experience**

* 5+ Years

**Minimum Skills**

* Proficiency in Python and SQL, with a strong emphasis on writing optimized queries. Solid understanding of data quality dimensions, cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Azure), and core data modeling concepts. Must have hands-on experience implementing data validation using standard test frameworks and Spark testing techniques.

**Preferred Skills**

* Deep proficiency in Apache Spark and the Databricks ecosystem. Experience with additional data validation frameworks (e.g., dbt tests, Great Expectations, Soda, Deequ, Monte Carlo), software engineering, and CI/CD practices. Experience with data analysis in a business setting.

**Preferred Certification(s)**

* Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional or Associate

* Minimum **10 years of experience** designing and implementing IP telephony systems.
* Minimum **10 years of project management experience**, preferably within a client-facing technical services environment.
* Strong understanding of telecommunications infrastructure, network architecture, and carrier-provided transport services.
* Knowledge of LAN/WAN and VoIP technologies, including MPLS, BGP, SIP, IMS, and related network protocols.
* Experience with telecommunications routers, switches, carrier services, and supporting network infrastructure.
* Experience evaluating multi-carrier service architectures, telecommunications pricing models, and operations support systems.
* Demonstrated experience conducting telecommunications billing audits, identifying discrepancies, and preparing management reports with findings and recommendations.

* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to resolve complex telecommunications and network challenges.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with customers, telecommunications carriers, vendors, and cross-functional technical teams.

  

**WHAT SETS** ***YOU*** **APART**

  

* Master's degree in Telecommunications or a related technical field.
* Experience designing, developing, and implementing telecommunications networks supporting public transit environments.
* Advanced knowledge of multi-carrier telecommunications architectures, service provider offerings, pricing structures, and operational support systems.
* Hands-on experience developing and delivering training and customer support for VoIP implementations.
* Experience leading complex telecommunications modernization initiatives involving multiple carriers, technologies, and stakeholders.
* Ability to translate complex technical requirements into practical, scalable, and cost-effective telecommunications solutions.

Iron Bow Technologies reserves the right to fill this role at a different level, depending on qualifications and organizational priorities. This range represents only one component of Iron Bow's total compensation package. An overview of our benefits is available on our careers page.

description:
**Data Platform Lead**
----------------------

Horizon AI is building the operating system for how organizations run themselves. The first step is autonomous data centers. A fleet of AI agents senses the state of STN’s GPU infrastructure, reasons about what it finds, and increasingly acts on it. This is running in production against real fleet data, not a prototype. Agents already take action where the risk is bounded and the outcome is verifiable. Everything riskier arrives as a recommendation for a human, and the work is moving decisions from the second category into the first, one class at a time, on evidence rather than optimism.

Data centers are the proving ground, not the destination. We start here because infrastructure is measurable and unforgiving: an agent is either right, or the fleet tells you it was wrong. What we build here generalizes, and we know where it goes next.

**Level:** Principal (MTS 5) · **Reports to:** Chief AI Officer

**The role.** Build the data foundation the platform reasons over. Today our agents assemble a picture of the fleet by querying several separate systems, and we cannot prove wider autonomy because we do not systematically capture how humans decide. You fix both.

**The problems you inherit**

* Fleet state is scattered across a relational store, a DCIM system, and multiple time-series and monitoring systems. Each has its own query path. There is no unified model. - No decision-capture pipeline exists. We record what agents did, but not what operators saw, concluded, and chose. That record is the evidence base for granting agents wider autonomy.
* Our retrieval pipeline is document-oriented rather than fleet-state-oriented.
* We consume telemetry from systems other teams operate, where retention and granularity are tuned for dashboards rather than for learning from history.

**You will**

* Design and build the fleet knowledge model: assets, topology, configuration, and current state, queryable by an agent in one call rather than five
* Build the decision-capture pipeline, and instrument the operator workflow so we accumulate labelled human decisions from day one
* Own the data access layer that abstracts telemetry sources, so we can keep consuming today and build our own collection if that stops scaling
* Negotiate our requirements with the teams who own the telemetry: signals, granularity, retention, raw event access
* Own the scale path, including vector index behaviour and the analytics separation a growing schema will eventually need

**You have**

* Strong data modelling judgment, particularly modelling physical or infrastructure domains as something queryable
* Experience with time-series and event data at scale, including cardinality and retention trade-offs
* Depth in PostgreSQL, including vector search, and comfort with a large evolving schema - Enough infrastructure literacy to know what a fleet actually is: nodes, GPUs, fabric, schedulers, power. Familiarity with DCIM tooling is a strong plus
* A bias toward shipping a usable model early over designing a complete one

**Nice to have:** GPU fleet or HPC exposure, DCGM, Slurm, entity resolution across inconsistent sources

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space. AWS Data centers have multiple components such as generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, etc. All these components have local control systems that interact with each other via open and/or proprietary communications protocols. The BMS is the primary method of control of all mechanical systems within a data center. The EPMS is the primary method of monitoring all electrical systems within a data center.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Train and assist internal customers and stakeholders with the creation, design, configuration, validation, installation, commissioning and operation of BMS and EPMS systems.

• Provide technical assistance and support to operations during life cycle of the data center. • Review results and action items from the quarterly maintenances for BMS and EPMS and take actions to get them resolved.  

* Develop BMS & EPMS projects scope of work, schedule, budget, and level of efforts (LOE) to projects requested by customers and stakeholders.
* Manage scope, schedule, finance and execution of BMS and EPMS improvement projects in AWS data centers.
* Assist in procurement related activities including request for quotation/proposals, responding to request for information, review of vendors proposal and issuance of purchase orders.

• Participate in AWS global on-call schedule to provide immediate BMS and EPMS technical support to in-service data centers. • Attend project related meetings, coordinate with project leaders and regularly report status to Controls and stakeholder’s management.  

* Support Controls projects related commissioning activities in the data centers.
* Review, implement, troubleshoot and iterate on the controls sequence of operation (SOO) and provide necessary feedback to the design team.
* Develop and modify controls logic programming and graphical user interfaces.
* Manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements and navigate challenging situations.
* Financially manage BMS and EPMS service contracts.
* Frequently visit (locally) assigned in-operation data centers to troubleshoot, meet customers, supervise vendor’s work to ensure compliance with the scope, design, SOO and applicable local codes.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
* Experience carrying new design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
* Experience in MS Excel, Word, and Windows Operating Systems
* Experience with power management and power monitoring systems

* Knowledge of critical data center equipment
* Knowledge of engineering documentation, electrical diagrams and standard operating procedures
* Knowledge of building codes and regulations including Life Safety, BOCA, NFPA, NEC, or OSHA

* Experience in Data Center Engineering Operations, with a deep understanding of electrical and mechanical data center infrastructure
* Experience reading and interpreting construction specifications and drawings for all domains

* Partner with engineers so that new pipelines ship with checks built in, and give engineers, stakeholders, and project managers timely feedback on quality issues and risk.

Velocity: You are relentless in asking the right questions to set direction. Once you find the right direction you go all-in.

Excellence: You obsess with being the best. For you, excellence is a non-negotiable standard rather than an aspiration.

Trust: You only work with people you can trust because it's the only way to do truly extraordinary things.

Yield: You have a burning need to see a result on every action you take and you're always looking for routes to do more with less.

**What we offer**

description:
### **About PrePass**

PrePass® is North America's most trusted weigh station bypass and toll management platform. We’re transforming how the transportation industry operates—creating solutions that keep trucks moving safely, efficiently, and compliantly. This means making bold decisions and building systems that support not only fleets but the broader economy. It all starts with enabling commercial vehicles to keep rolling with seamless toll management, weigh station bypass, and safety solutions. It’s what we do best, and we do it to meet the demands of the road every day.

That’s why people join us: our solutions are implemented in real-time, on highways and interstates across the nation, helping fleets go farther, faster. This work challenges and rewards, presenting complex problems that need ambitious answers. We hire bold thinkers with a heart for impact, a passion for progress, and the optimism to shape the future of transportation.

### **About the Role**

PrePass is seeking a Senior Data Engineer to architect, build, and scale our core data platform. In this role, you will lead the design of high-throughput data pipelines and lakehouse architectures while mentoring fellow engineers in modern software craftsmanship. We are looking for a technical leader who treats data engineering with the rigor of software engineering—relying on strict Test-Driven Development (TDD), extreme programming (XP) practices, and AI-augmented workflows to deliver reliable, observable, and mission-critical data systems in Databricks.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Build & Scale Production ETL:** Design, build, and operate scalable ETL/ELT pipelines on Azure that ingest, transform, and integrate data from multiple sources. Use advanced SQL, Apache Spark, and Lakehouse technologies such as Databricks and Delta Lake to support analytics, reporting, and real-time operational workloads.
* **Modernize Legacy Integrations:** Partner with the team to define and execute a strategy for re-architecting legacy SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) workloads into modern, cloud-native pipelines. Lead proof-of-concept and prototyping work and turn the findings into clear recommendations.
* **Champion TDD & XP Practices:** Lead by example in writing clean, modular, and maintainable code using strict Test-Driven Development (TDD), pair programming, continuous refactoring, and automated CI/CD pipelines.
* **Drive AI-Augmented Engineering:** Leverage AI-assisted development tools to accelerate code generation, automate unit and data-quality test creation, streamline legacy refactoring, and enhance pipeline anomaly detection.
* **Own Production Reliability & Data Quality:** Operate and monitor mission-critical data systems against strict SLAs for data freshness, uptime, and reliability. Diagnose and resolve integration and data-quality failures, build end-to-end traceability and observability, and tune pipeline and compute performance for cost and scalability.
* **Elevate Engineering Standards:** Define and evolve team-wide data engineering standards, architectural documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives within an Agile environment.

  
**Requirements**

### **Qualifications**

* **Senior-Level Data Engineering Experience:** Proven track record of designing, building, and operating distributed data pipelines and cloud data platforms at scale.
* **Mastery of Test-Driven Development (TDD):** Demonstrated hands-on expertise in TDD for data pipelines—writing unit, integration, and data-contract tests prior to implementation—alongside XP practices such as pairing, refactoring, and continuous integration.
* **AI Augmentation Proficiency:** Practical experience integrating AI coding assistants and LLM-based tooling into daily engineering workflows to accelerate delivery, improve test coverage, and automate documentation.
* **Production Operations & Observability:** Strong experience operating high-availability systems in production with clear uptime, reliability, and observability expectations.
* **Technical Leadership:** Experience driving engineering standards, architectural reviews, documentation, and mentorship within an Agile team.

**Bonus Points For**

* Experience in Data Science or Machine Learning, particularly in MLOps, model deployment, Feature Store management, or feature engineering on Databricks.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform / Bicep) for managing Databricks workspaces and cloud resources.
* Familiarity of event driven architecture – queues, batches, and pub/sub models.
* Databricks Expertise:Production experience with the Databricks platform (Delta Lake, PySpark/Spark SQL, Databricks Workflows, and Unity Catalog)
* Background in high-volume IoT, telematics, or transportation industry data.

* Paid Time Off, to include vacation, sick, holidays, and floating holidays.

* Culture that focuses on employee development initiatives.

We invest in relationships. We challenge ourselves to innovate and improve. We win together. Simply put, we live our Core Values.

**Ready to help move the transportation industry forward? Join us and let’s drive progress—together.**

Submit both a cover letter and resume as one file (because of system limitations).

**Who We Are**
--------------

**About the Center for Academic Innovation**
  
  
Through curricular innovation, tools for student success, and educational research and analytics, the University of Michigan Center for Academic Innovation is building the future of education. Our vision is a future in which education connects and empowers learners everywhere to reach their full potential throughout their lives. To realize our vision, we make it our mission to collaborate across campus and around the world to create equitable, lifelong educational opportunities for learners everywhere.
  
  
**About the Data and Business Intelligence Team**

The Data and Business Intelligence Team within the Center for Academic Innovation (CAI) at the University of Michigan drives CAI's data strategy, ensuring that data is used responsibly, ethically, and securely. Our team of data engineers, scientists, and analysts powers internal operations and the Michigan Online platform by leveraging data as our universal language for analytics, insights and decision-making. We strive to democratize access to data while upholding strong standards for governance, security, and privacy. Through collaboration and communities of practice, we share innovations, learn from peers, and help foster a culture of data-informed decision-making across CAI and the broader campus.

For more information, please visit our website: Academic Innovation.

**Responsibilities\***
----------------------

**Data Strategy & Architecture Ownership**

* Evolve CAI's data architecture strategy to support reporting, analytics, AI/ML, and operational needs
* Architect and oversee implementation of end-to-end data warehousing solutions integrating diverse institutional and platform data sources
* Establish and enforce standards for dimensional modeling (e.g., Kimball methodology, Star and Snowflake schemas), pipeline design, documentation, and engineering best practices
* Ensure cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks) are optimized for scalability, reliability, cost efficiency, and long-term sustainability
* Design and maintain complex ELT frameworks and scalable pipeline patterns

**People Leadership & Team Development**

* Directly manage and mentor Data Engineers and Senior Data Engineers, including performance management, coaching, hiring, and career development
* Foster a culture of shared ownership, technical excellence, and continuous learning
* Provide technical guidance and architectural oversight across projects, ensuring high-quality delivery and consistency
* Plan for team growth and capability development to support CAI's long-term data vision

**Governance, Risk & Compliance**

* Establish and operationalize scalable data governance practices, including standards for data quality, metadata, lineage, and access controls
* Ensure compliance with institutional and regulatory data privacy requirements (e.g., FERPA, GDPR) within a higher education environment
* Promote strong data stewardship and responsible use of institutional and learner data

**Cross-Functional Leadership & Strategic Alignment**

* Partner with Engineering, Online Learning, XR, and campus stakeholders to translate complex business and academic needs into cohesive data strategies and solutions
* Lead discovery sessions with stakeholders and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences
* Align team priorities with CAI's strategic objectives and contribute to roadmap planning within the data domain
* Oversee service delivery and stakeholder engagement to ensure responsive, high-impact data support

**Innovation & Community Engagement**

* Evaluate and thoughtfully incorporate emerging technologies, including AI-enabled tools, into engineering workflows and team practices
* Co-lead or sponsor initiatives such as the BI + AI Community of Practice and Data Hours to strengthen campus-wide data literacy and collaboration

**What You'll Do**
------------------

The Center for Academic Innovation (CAI) at the University of Michigan is seeking a Lead Data Engineer to guide and scale our Data and Business Intelligence function. As we expand our Data, BI, and AI/ML capabilities to support innovative educational solutions, the Michigan Online platform and CAI internal operations, you will step into this newly created leadership role and lead the design, governance, and evolution of our enterprise data ecosystem.

This role combines deep technical expertise with people leadership. You will establish architectural standards, design and build secure, scalable, high-performing data solutions, and ensure they advance CAI's priorities and mission. As the senior technical authority, you will also lead a team of data engineers and cultivate a collaborative, service-oriented, and innovative culture.

**Required Qualifications\***
-----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree required. Degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or related field preferred
* 7+ years of progressive experience in data engineering, data architecture, or related technical roles
* 1+ year of direct supervision of professional staff experience with demonstrable servant leadership of technical teams
* Expert-level knowledge of dimensional modeling (Star and Snowflake schemas) and enterprise data warehousing best practices
* Deep experience with modern ELT frameworks and cloud-based data platforms like Snowflake
* Proven ability to design and scale complex data ecosystems integrating numerous source and target systems
* Demonstrated success leading and developing high-performing technical teams
* Experience aligning technical roadmaps with organizational strategy
* Ability to independently manage large, cross-functional initiatives from concept through delivery
* Strong project management discipline and experience using enterprise collaboration tools such as Asana
* Experience establishing data governance frameworks and ensuring regulatory compliance
* Proven ability to lead stakeholder discovery sessions and communicate effectively with non-technical audiences
* Strong collaboration skills in a matrixed, mission-driven organization

**Modes of Work**
-----------------

Positions that are eligible for hybrid or mobile/remote work mode are at the discretion of the hiring department. Work agreements are reviewed annually at a minimum and are subject to change at any time, and for any reason, throughout the course of employment. Learn more about the work modes.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Candidates must have legal authorization to work in the United States.

The mode of work for this position is **Hybrid** with a minimum of 4 days in the office per week, Monday through Thursday, with an option of remote work on Fridays. On occasion, you may be required and must be available to work onsite on Fridays if necessitated by our center's policy and domain leadership or by your job requirements.

Factors used to determine salary include education level, experience, knowledge and skills for the position and salaries that are currently established within the unit. All candidates are encouraged to discuss salary questions to honor alignment and transparency throughout the recruiting process.

description:
Amphenol Communications Solutions (ACS), a division of Amphenol Corporation, is a world leader in interconnect solutions for Communications, Mobile, RF, Optics, and Commercial electronics markets. Amphenol Corporation is one of the world’s largest designers and manufacturers of electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and sensor-based products and coaxial and high-speed specialty cable. ACS has an expansive global presence in research and development, manufacturing, and sales. We design and manufacture a wide range of innovative connectors as well as cable assemblies for diverse applications including server, storage, data center, mobile, RF, networking, industrial, business equipment, and automotive.

The **Reliability Engineer (Data Analytics)** will apply reliability testing, statistical modeling, design of experiments (DOE), and data analytics to improve cable backplane assemblies for AI and hyperscale data centers. Working across design, manufacturing, and quality teams, this role will translate test, process, and field data into actionable insights that reduce risk, strengthen product robustness, and improve launch readiness. This position is based in Etters, PA; Raleigh, NC; or Nashua, NH. Some remote work may be considered based on the candidate’s qualifications. Approximately 30% travel is expected.

* Develop data-driven reliability and robustness strategies across the product life cycle.

* Design and analyze experiments to identify critical factors and optimize product and process performance.
* Lead Six Sigma and structured problem-solving efforts using DMAIC, DOE, MSA, SPC, 8D, and root-cause analysis.
* Build reliability and life models using Weibull, Arrhenius, and physics-of-failure methods; correlate accelerated test results with field performance.
* Automate analyses and dashboards that communicate reliability metrics, variation, leading indicators, and emerging risks.
* Lead failure analysis and present clear technical conclusions and recommendations to cross-functional, executive, and customer stakeholders.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, reliability, statistics, data science, or a related quantitative field; advanced degree preferred.
* 5+ years of experience in reliability, validation, quality, data analytics, or failure analysis; cable, connector, or high-speed interconnect experience preferred.
* Proficiency in reliability statistics, life-data and accelerated-test modeling, sampling methods, confidence bounds, and regression.
* Experience with Six Sigma methods and tools; Green Belt or equivalent practical experience preferred.
* Proficiency with JMP, Minitab, Python, R, SQL, MATLAB, or comparable analytics and visualization tools.
* Hands-on experience with electrical, mechanical, and environmental testing and with diagnosing mixed failure modes.

* Ability to travel up to 30%

description:
**Company Description**

**Work with Us. Change the World.**

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**

AECOM is seeking a **Senior Plumbing Engineer/Designer** specializing in Hyperscale Data Centers to act as a Data Center Plumbing Lead. The job incumbent will be responsible for designing plumbing systems in large scale data centers. This position could be based anywhere in the US, can be done remotely, with occasional site visits as needed.

This position offers the flexibility of a remote work schedule and can be based from a variety of locations in the US where AECOM has an office

Although the position is primarily remote periodic travel may be required for client meetings, key project milestones, onsite collaboration sessions, or other business‑critical activities. Travel is expected to be occasional and scheduled in advance

**AECOM** is a leader in the global data center consulting industry with robust teams in the Americas, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Australia. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with our teams around the world on high-profile, fast-paced data center projects for global clients. This is a hands-on, client-facing role with an opportunity for upward career mobility.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Serves as lead engineer on hyperscale data center projects.
* Provides specialized technical input to studies and design for staff's specific area of expertise.
* Approves and signs off on work.
* Collaborates with other engineers and stakeholders to develop specifications and design criteria.
* Provides technical expertise for studies and design efforts.
* Presents complex technical solutions to clients.
* Performs quality control reviews of work developed by others.
* Participates in development of technical proposals.
* Provides estimates for the engineering budget and schedule to meet requirements on large projects.

  
**Qualifications**

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field
* 6+ years of experience in building systems engineering, with a primary focus on plumbing system design on large buildings.
* Familiarity with AutoCAD and Revit
* Working knowledge of applicable local and national building codes
* Proficient in making engineering calculations, spreadsheets, and report writing
* Must have well-rounded background in plumbing project design and delivery to meet various challenges
* Willing to travel as required.
* Knowledge of sustainable plumbing design and basic LEED building practices.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of relevant experience
* Licensed Professional Engineer
* Certified in Plumbing Design (CPD)
* Strong written communication, presentation, and client interface skills

  
**Additional Information**  

* Relocation is ***not*** available for this role
* Sponsorship for U.S. employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position.
* **THIS POSTING IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND AECOM INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY JANUARY 11, 2026.**

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

**About AECOM**

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

**What makes AECOM a great place to work**

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

**Redica Systems** is the Intelligence Cloud for life sciences, transforming regulatory complexity into connected, proactive intelligence. Redica's platform helps the world's leading Pharmaceutical and MedTech companies stay inspection-ready, manage supplier risk, and keep pace with evolving global regulations. Built on the Redica Catalyst Platform and powered by Redica ID, Redica unifies the industry's most complete regulatory and inspection datasets, sourced from hundreds of global health authorities, into trusted intelligence for quality and regulatory teams. The Redica Intelligence Cloud brings data together to anticipate risk, accelerate compliance, and enable smarter, faster decisions across the enterprise.

More information is available at redica.com.

 **Job Description**

We're looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to take a hands-on role in designing, building, and optimizing our core data platform. You'll work on challenging technical problems, help shape architectural decisions, establish engineering best practices, and build scalable, high-quality data pipelines. You'll also have opportunities to mentor fellow engineers, contribute to code reviews, and provide technical guidance as the team grows.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Data Pipeline Development: Design, build, optimize, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines, APIs, and microservices for high-volume regulatory and health agency datasets.
* Data Reliability & Integrity: Troubleshoot data quality issues and implement automated testing, monitoring, and validation to ensure data accuracy and reliability.
* Architecture & Design: Contribute to technical design and architectural decisions, building scalable, maintainable solutions that support our evolving data platform.
* System Integration: Integrate data pipelines with downstream NLP/ML services and search technologies, including the ELK stack.
* Production Operations: Support production deployments, troubleshoot pipeline and database issues, and resolve complex technical incidents.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Engineering and Product teams to translate requirements into practical, well-designed technical solutions.

  
**Qualifications**  

* **Tech Savvy:** You effectively anticipate and adopt innovations in business-building technology solutions, staying up-to-date with data advancements and incorporating them into work processes.
* **Manages Complexity:** You actively synthesize solutions from complex information by identifying patterns and developing effective problem-solving strategies to solve data-related problems effectively.
* **Decision Quality:** You consistently make good and timely decisions that propel organizational progress and maintain data integrity.
* **Collaborates:** You actively engage in collaborative problem-solving by leveraging diverse perspectives and finding innovative solutions to achieve shared goals and data engineering initiatives.
* **Optimizes Work Processes:** You actively seek opportunities to enhance and streamline current work processes for managing data pipelines, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes, and data warehousing.
* **Drives Results:** You strive to continuously improve performance and exceed expectations to contribute to overall success and meet data-related deliverables.
* **Strategic Mindset:** You consistently demonstrate a strategic mindset by envisioning future possibilities and successfully translating them into breakthrough data strategies, contributing to the organization's long-term success.
* **Engaged:** You not only share our values but also possess the essential competencies needed to thrive at Redica, as outlined here.

  
**Additional Information**

Top Pharmaceutical Companies, Food Manufacturers, MedTech Companies, and Service Firms from around the globe rely on Redica Systems to mine and process government inspection, enforcement, and registration data. This enables them to quantify risk signals from their suppliers, identify market opportunities, benchmark against peers, and prepare for the latest inspection trends.

Our data and analytics have been cited by major media outlets, including MSNBC, *The Wall Street Journal*, and *The Boston Globe*.

title: Data Engineer
description:
**Summary**

  

The Data Engineer is an individual-contributor role responsible for building, maintaining and improving reliable data engineering solutions that enable trusted data, analytics and AI across Pharming. The role translates defined business and data requirements and architectural direction into practical data pipelines, integrations, data models and reusable components that support data-driven decision-making and scalable delivery across global functions.

  

Reporting to the Head of AI, Data & Analytics, the Data Engineer works independently on assigned data engineering activities of moderate to high complexity within the AI & Transformation domain. The role applies established engineering standards, contributes to technical design decisions, resolves day-to-day engineering issues and collaborates with data owners, data stewards, architecture, cybersecurity, privacy, quality, compliance, applications and business stakeholders to ensure data solutions are secure, governed, maintainable and fit for purpose. More complex architectural, cross-domain or high-risk decisions are escalated through the appropriate technical and governance channels.

  

This is a hybrid role based in our Warren, NJ office with an expectation of 2-3 in office days in office each week and the flexibility to adjust schedules depending on business needs.

  

**What you'd do**

  

* Data engineering and platform delivery
  + Build, maintain and enhance scalable batch and real-time data pipelines, ingestion workflows and transformation processes that integrate data from enterprise, scientific, operational and external sources.
  + Develop and maintain data models, curated datasets and reusable data components that provide trusted, well-structured data for analytics, reporting, AI and machine-learning use cases.
  + Translate approved enterprise architecture and data-platform direction into practical engineering implementations using established patterns for storage, processing, orchestration, integration and access.
  + Support reliability, performance and maintainability by implementing automated testing, monitoring, observability, error handling, documentation and operational support practices.
  + Apply modern software-engineering practices to data solutions, including version control, code review, CI/CD and automation; use infrastructure-as-code where appropriate and established by the platform standards.
  + Contribute to continuous improvement of data-engineering methods, reusable components and platform capabilities to reduce duplication and improve delivery efficiency.
* Data quality, governance and integration
  + Implement data-quality controls, validation rules, lineage and monitoring that improve confidence in data used for business decisions, analytics and AI.
  + Work with data owners, data stewards and business subject-matter experts to translate data definitions, quality expectations and governance requirements into practical technical controls.
  + Build and maintain secure data integrations across applications, platforms and external data sources using approved APIs, interfaces, event-driven or file-based patterns.
  + Apply privacy, cybersecurity, access-control, retention and compliance requirements in data pipelines and platform solutions in collaboration with the relevant control functions.
  + Support metadata, master/reference data, interoperability and lifecycle-management practices that improve discoverability, consistency and reuse of data across functions.
  + Support regulated and GxP-relevant data needs where applicable by ensuring engineering solutions are traceable, controlled and aligned with Pharming's quality and validation requirements.
* Technical delivery and collaboration
  + Contribute technical expertise to data initiatives, follow established engineering standards and guardrails, and raise design risks or exceptions for review where appropriate.
  + Partner with AI, analytics and business teams to ensure data foundations support analytics, AI and automation use cases and can be transitioned from development into reliable production use.
  + Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Enterprise Applications and Global IT Operations & Service Delivery to align data solutions with application, integration, cloud, infrastructure and service-management requirements.
  + Assess data-engineering technologies, tools and vendor capabilities and provide practical input on technical fit, scalability, risk and lifecycle considerations.
  + Contribute to knowledge sharing, technical documentation, communities of practice and team capability development through active collaboration and peer support.
  + Other duties as assigned

**What you'd need**

  

* Relevant bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Information Management or a related field, or equivalent demonstrable professional experience.
* At least 4 years of progressive experience in data engineering, data platforms, software engineering or related disciplines, with hands-on experience delivering production data solutions.
* Experience designing, building and operating scalable data pipelines and data-platform solutions in complex environments
* Experience in biotech, pharmaceutical or another regulated industry is preferred.
* Working experience with modern data architectures and platforms, including data lakes, data warehouses or lakehouse patterns, ETL/ELT, orchestration, APIs, batch and/or streaming integration, and cloud-based data services.
* Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, version control and deployment practices for data products and pipelines; infrastructure-as-code exposure is an advantage.
* Strong practical skills in SQL and a general-purpose programming language commonly used for data engineering, such as Python, together with sound software-engineering practices.
* Good understanding of data modelling, data quality, metadata, lineage, observability, security and access-control principles, with the ability to apply governance requirements in technical implementation.
* Demonstrated ability to explain technical decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders, collaborate across functions and resolve data-engineering problems with appropriate guidance and escalation.
* Fluent English required; ability to collaborate effectively across global teams and time zones.
* Commitment and alignment to Pharming's mission, core values and behaviors.
* US work authorization - please note that visa sponsorhip is not available for this position.

  

**Who we are**

  

We’re built on a simple belief: people living with rare diseases deserve more. Pharming is a global biotechnology company taking on some of the toughest rare disease challenges. We develop and commercialize innovative therapies for rare and ultra-rare immunological and genetic diseases with significant unmet need, where our scientific and commercial expertise, long-term commitment, and real partnership can help advance care.

  

We put patients at the heart of our work. Their insights, along with those of caregivers, clinicians, scientists, and parters, shape our strategy, guide our decisions, and help turn science into meaningful progress. We keep it simple, act with urgency, and get it done – expanding access to approved therapies, advancing high-value pipeline programs, and building a leading global rare disease company.

  

Our vision is simple: a world where people living with rare diseases don’t wait for progress or care. Together with the communities who inspire us, we’re opening new possibilities – proving that breakthroughs aren’t just discovered. They’re created together.

  

Ready to make a difference? Join us.

  

**What it’s like to work here**

  

At Pharming, every role helps move rare disease therapies closer to the people who need them. We make it happen together, across teams, disciplines, and borders, because breakthroughs don’t happen in silos. Rare diseases are complex, and meaningful progress takes people who ask better questions, challenge each other, and turn insight into action. Here, you won’t work on the sidelines. Pharming is a place for builders, problem-solvers, and bold thinkers who move with urgency, take ownership, and stay focused on what matters most: improving the lives of people living with rare diseases. Advancing rare disease care isn’t the work of one team or one leader. It’s all of us, building what’s next together.

  

This is also an important moment of transformation for Pharming’s digital and technology capabilities, as they evolve from a traditional support function into a more integrated, enterprise-wide enabler of business value. You will have the opportunity to influence how applications, data, technology, processes, and ways of working develop across the organization, helping to build scalable, resilient, and future-ready capabilities that support Pharming’s continued growth.

  

**Salary range**

  

Pharming takes into consideration a combination of candidate’s work experience, training, and education, as well as the scope of the role, complexity, and external market and internal value when determining a salary level.

  

The base salary range for this job is from $115,000 - $155,000 per year.

INEOS was founded in 1998 by Sir Jim Ratcliffe with a single site and has grown into one of the world's largest privately owned manufacturing groups. We have grown by buying good assets and running them better with small, empowered teams, minimal bureaucracy and a relentless focus on performance.

INEOS Energy is building a global energy business, and our US Onshore team in Denver currently operates approximately 2,000 wells in the Eagle Ford shale play of South Texas. We are a small team with a big mandate: grow the business through disciplined development and acquisitions.

**About the job**

**Job Title: Data Platform Engineer**

**Department: Information Technology**

**Summary of Position**

We're seeking a skilled Data Platform Engineer to own the models that turn raw operational data into decision-ready analytics. We're a data-driven, AI-enabled energy company, and the quality of our decisions depends directly on the quality of the data layer you'll build. In this role, you'll design, develop, and maintain scalable data models and analytics solutions, working directly with stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into efficient models using dbt, SQL, Python, and other modern data stack tools. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in data modeling methodologies, data governance, and modern data architecture, with a strong focus on building reliable, production-grade data solutions.

**Primary Job Responsibilities**

* Design and implement robust data models using established methodologies (e.g., Kimball, medallion, etc.) to support analytics, research, and AI agent workloads — balancing accuracy, performance, and ease of adoption by downstream consumers.
* Build and maintain dbt models with disciplined testing, documentation, and version control, using Jinja and macros to keep transformation logic modular and reusable.
* Integrate high-volume telemetry and SCADA data, handling the time-series characteristics of field measurement — irregular intervals, late-arriving and backfilled records, sensor gaps, and unit and tag standardization — so operational data is as trustworthy as financial data.
* Write and optimize complex SQL transformations that meet reporting and analytical requirements while holding up under production load, on cost and on time.
* Build the semantic and context layers that sit between raw models and their consumers — certified metric definitions, business-friendly naming, documented lineage, and the descriptive context that lets both analysts and AI agents resolve a business question to the right data without guesswork — partnering with stakeholders to keep governance and documentation standards applied across every solution the platform delivers.
* Own the orchestration and CI/CD pipelines behind the platform, defining job dependencies and schedules and automating testing and deployment so changes reach production safely, repeatably, and without manual intervention.

You'll work at the intersection of data, product, and platform engineering, partnering closely with Data and Product teams to make our data reliable, accessible, and useful for internal decisions and for our customers. This role partners closely with the Data and Product teams.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Build & own the data platform**

* Architect, build, and maintain the infrastructure that moves and transforms Spoiler Alert's marketplace data reliably and at scale, effectively incorporating AI coding tools to build with quality and velocity

* Design and enforce data quality standards across the stack, defining what trusted data means at Spoiler Alert and developing the monitoring and testing that upholds it
* Make intentional architectural decisions with the appropriate level of abstraction, documenting decisions and tradeoffs so the team can build confidently on your work, including data infrastructure for effective product applications of AI/ML
